description:
This apartment, which stands out with its central location, is located in Merter, one of the most vibrant and prestigious neighborhoods in Istanbul. Merter, the heart of the textile industry, is within walking distance of all means of transportation. Metro, Metrobus, bus stops and taxi stands are only a few minutes away.
Our apartment is right next to Zoe Hotel and stands out with its cleanliness and well-maintained condition. As you can see in the pictures, it is spacious, modern and comfortable. It is located in the most central point of Istanbul.

reviews.text:
Mr Mehmet was very responsive and an attentive helpful host. The apartment was as described with all necessary amenities and more. The apartment was spacious, clean and comfortable to stay in. Internet was very reliable and the location of the apartment is very close to a major transport hub which is extremely helpful, there are many restaurants and shops in the surrounding area.
I would recommend. Thank you.

As seen in the photos of the house, very clean towels and sheets, clean and sufficient detergent for the washing machine, shampoo, selpak towels and cologne, monitoring water, water dispenser, available in the house, there is a large air conditioner in the house, it is cooled very well, also there are fans in the rooms, it is sufficient. First of all, the location of the house is very good, all transportation options are available. The owner of the house, Mr. Mehmet, lives on the opposite side where the vehicles do not walk, he is close to the house and is in communication and if there is any problem, it is solved. Mr. Mehmet, we thank you and your marriage very much.
I'm happy to come back and refer my friend and family.

We stayed in an Airbnb in Istanbul for two months, and overall, it was a great experience. The space is very spacious, exactly as shown in the photos, and it had everything we needed for a long stay. The location is fantastic, close to the metro and bus lines, which made it easy to get around. The owner was generally responsive and helpful when we needed, and we felt comfortable during our winter stay. We would definitely recommend this place.

Many thanks to Mehmet for his hospitality. There were six of us, including children and grandchildren. There were enough beds for everyone, and even one sofa remained free. Everything was good, except for the weather, but the apartment was very warm. The apartment is located in a good area, next to a large park. Excellent transport links: metro, metrobus, buses, tram and a taxi stand. There are many grocery stores and clothing shops nearby. The furniture is not luxurious, but everything is clean. The apartment has a water cooler. There is no microwave oven, which makes heating food difficult. There is an oven for cooking and baking. There is no electric kettle, but there is a small Turkish teapot; since there were many of us, some had to wait. There is a washing machine and a metal clothes dryer. There is enough crockery. Plenty of bed linen and towels. Shampoo and toilet paper are also provided. Next time we will definitely stay with Mehmet again.

First of all, the Mehmet's flat is in a great location when it comes to moving around as it's very close to buses, trams and underground to easily reach the city centre as well as other historical places. The flat itself consists of 3 medium sized bedrooms, a bathroom as well an additional toilet, is spacious and in good condition, equipped with all necessary amenities including drinking water dispenser. In kitchen, we could easily prepare our meals as there was enough cooking pans and other utensils to feel comfortable and like at home. I can definitely recommend Mehmet's place as it's a good value for money

description: This unique place has a style all its own.

reviews.text: Overall the stay was really nice and with good location , very close to Galata Tower and Taksim and Istiklal street . The stay was nice, clean and well designed . Everything was amazing but there were few things that I hope were mentioned in the description that are that you can't use the lift to access the terrace through lift and you have to take the stairs which are for 4 floors up. I would like to suggest a few changes, like the water heater could have been in the washroom floor instead of the bedroom to reduce the noise and lastly the door and the windows could have better sound proofing to reduce the noice from the street considering the apartment door opens to the road and its quite a busy street. Overall the stay was pretty good and you can definitely consider and the host is also very responsive and helpful, the only thing you should keep in mind is the noise if you are a light sleeper.

I had a lovely stay here, the apartment is super close to some really cool neighbourhoods and there’s plenty of cafe and restaurant options in very short walking distance. the rooftop terrace was gorgeous! Both hosts were really friendly and went out of their way to help me when I didn’t know how to fix a problem with the hot water - I would 100% stay again

Her şey için çok teşekkür ederiz 😊 Konaklamamızdan gerçekten çok memnun kaldık. Daire çok temiz, rahat ve çok güzel dekore edilmişti. Konumu da bizim için çok uygundu. Teras özellikle harikaydı, atmosferini çok beğendik. Ayrıca ilginiz ve hızlı iletişiminiz için de teşekkür ederiz. İstanbul’a tekrar gelirsek memnuniyetle tekrar burada kalırız. Kesinlikle tavsiye ederiz!

I had an amazing time at the Karay House. The host was very responsive when I had questions about the shower and late checkout, and the apartment itself was cool and unique. The location was fantastic as well, you could arrive to Galata tower in less than 5 minutes; which also meant that there was an abundance of fun stores and delicious restaurants nearby as well

The place was so lovely! I absolutely loved the design and I technically had 3 floors to myself!! Be aware that you would have to deal with a steep circular staircase to get to the bathroom/bedroom! Also, mind that you have your own entrance to the apartment from the street, and you live on the first floor, so like people are basically walking next to your windows and door.. you can’t really open the blinds unless you don’t care about pedestrians staring at you haha. Not a disadvantage but definitely something to consider🤗 the location of this airbnb is perfect!! Oh AND!! Forgot about the rooftop! You’d have to go to the apt building right next door but you do have access to a shared rooftop which is pretty spacious and has some lounge chairs/couches to chill on!

description:
Alex is located on Moda Street in the heart of Istanbul. The Bull Statue and the Rıhtıma (Port) are only a few steps away. You can walk to the Seaside in 5 minutes. Our apartment has new, well-equipped furniture. We try to think of everything for your comfort.

Entertainment Centers are here.
Nazım Hikmet Cultural Center is here.
Metro, Metrobus, Tram, Bus, Taxi Stops are very close by.

reviews.text:
+ The place is in a great location. Check-in was easy, instructions were clear, and host was responsive.
- The place is not clean. I had hairs in my bed and on my pillows, so I think that the sheets had not been changed. When I dried my toothbrush on the towel, I had a short black curly hair stuck on it ... So I'm not sure whether I got clean towels. The carpeted floor looks like it hasn't been vaccuumed for the past years.
What bothered me the most was that on top of that, the listing wasn't honest/accurate. I had chosen this place because I needed a kitchen. There was only a working fridge. The kitchen sink had no running water. There were no utensils to eat with and no pots or pans, only a few plates and a bowl. Also other amenities like hairdryer, warm water were not available. When I asked the host whether I could get a spoon, I got no response. I ended up eating my yoghurt with my fingers.
I would consider staying here again for the location and bring my own linnen.

Duvarlar göçüktü. Ve ev sahibi binanın göçük olduğundan bir haber olacak ki, bina bu şekilde diye fotoğraf atma tenezülünde bulunabiliyor! Evet biz süpermanız duvarları göçerttik deprem potansiyeline sahibiz(!) Sanırım para almak için yapılan bir komplo. Odada girdiğimizde kahve vardı içilmiş ve masaya konmuş, leş gibi kokuyordu oda. Yatak örtüleri nevresim takımları kirli ve özensizdi. Klima eski ve nefes almanızı zorlaştırıyor. Tek iyi yanı konumu. Çok merkezi. Ama tavsiye etmem.
hızlı iletişim sağlandı. her yere cok yakın mesafede . biraz daha temiz olabilirdi sadece yatak örtüleri . duştada sadece soguk su akması dısında bir sorunu yoktu tesekkürler

Konum olarak tam anlamıyla merkezi. Fiyat fayda dengesini karşılayan bir deneyimdi. Odada tamir olarak yapılması gereken bir kaç unsur gözlemledim. Onun dışında yatak temiz oda düzenliydi.
Giriş kolay ve iletişim anında ve doğru yapıldı.

Eksiler ve artılardan bahsetmek istiyorum.
Artılar : konum olarak çok iyi , prizleri çalışıyor ve yatak rahat.
Eksileri: tuvaletin oturağı kırık , duştan bazen su geliyor bazen gelmiyor gelirse sıcak su bazen akıyor bazen akmıyor . Duş alırken tavandaki yağmur duş mekanizmasından buz gibi su damlıyor, oda tozlu ve duvarda kocaman bir delik vardı biri yumruk atmış gibi. Verilen havlulardan biri yırtıktı. İki tane kahve fincanı vardı ama su bardağı gibi birşeyler olsaydı iyi olurdu. Keşke başka bir yerde kalsaydık. Fotoğraflara aldandık. 4.1 puanı iyi bile almış . Özetle güzel konum berbat deneyim. Param boşa gitmiş gibi hissediyorum.

description: Welcome to our perfectly located brand new spacious bright home in the heart of desirable Cihangir. Located on the 2nd floor, our home consists of 2 bedrooms and 1 bathroom with an elevator and a large comfortable living room and a fully equipped kitchen. Close to all tourist attractions, cafes & restaurants! A lovely international neighborhood were you feel like a local! Easily accessible to all public transportation! The perfect home away from home! Comes with A/C and free parking.

reviews.text: It was my second time getting an airbnb in Istanbul and I was not sure about the location of this apartment, however, I am so glad I chose this apartment. It is under 5 minutes walk to Taksim Square and from there you can get the metro or bus to anywhere. Just down your road, you have many family owned shops, coffee shops and bars which felt like we were experiencing the real Turkish culture. The first thing we noticed when we walked into the apartment was how clean, modern and spacious it was. The flat is extremely clean and it makes you feel comfortable. You have everything you need to stay there and the team is very quick to respond to your texts. During our stay there were multiple times that we required more towels, blankets, kitchen utensils etc and the VNG Property team delivered them in the day time. Me and my family would definitely stay at this airbnb again.

We had a lovely stay at this beautiful home. The house was clean, comfortable and had everything we needed during our visit. The host was friendly, helpful and easy to communicate with, and we really appreciated their hospitality.
One thing to be aware of is that there are quite steep hills leading up to the house, which may be difficult for elderly guests or people with mobility issues or disabilities.
There is also ongoing construction in the area, and we experienced some noise after midnight during our stay. This may be temporary, but it is worth keeping in mind if you are looking for a very quiet stay.
Overall, we enjoyed our time here and would happily stay again. Thank you to the host for having us!

We had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb in Cihangir. The building is new, very clean, and has an elevator — which made a huge difference for us. The location is perfect, close to everything that Cihangir and Taksim have to offer, and also very convenient for public transportation.
Handan was an exceptional host — extremely responsive, kind, and proactive. We had a couple of small issues with the bathroom during our stay, but she addressed them immediately and everything was fixed very quickly.
Having a private parking spot in this neighborhood is truly a blessing. It made our stay so much easier and stress-free.
Overall, we were very happy with our experience and would absolutely stay here again. Highly recommended!

The place is exactly like it looks on the picture, the location is amazing, 5 min walk from taksim square. The apartment is very modern and clean. The host was amazing and responsive! I will definitely book again in this location when i go to istanbul !
Good location but also be prepared to walk a bit if you intend to catch public transport. Very clean & accurate photos.

description:
We have a complimentary breakfast service from 8 am to 10 am.

Experience a comfortable and stylish stay in our hotel located in the heart of Ataşehir, on the modern side of Istanbul.

Our hotel is close to shopping malls, restaurants and entertainment venues.

We had to book the Rise Inn very last minute, but the staff were so friendly and the room was clean, pretty and comfortable.

description:
This flat located in the Beyoglu district is a 10 minute walk to Istiklal Street, the heart and soul of Istanbul's cultural life with many cafes, bars, shops, cinemas and cultural centers.

The flat is found in a historical Greek building. There are three bedrooms and a living room with TV. There are 3 ACs.

reviews.text:
Garen is a great host, always responsive, helpful, and easy to communicate with. He also arranged transportation for us to and from the airport, which was very convenient.
The heater worked very well for both room temperature and hot water.
Unfortunately, there were several issues that affected our stay. The building right next to the property is abandoned and appears to be collapsing, which was worrisome. The rooms were much smaller than they appeared in the photos, and the mattresses were extremely uncomfortable.
The bathroom had visible issues: the shower fixtures had bluish moldy residue, and the cabinets showed black mold and water damage. The washing machine smelled very bad and was extremely dirt, I wouldn’t have considered it a usable amenity.
Noise was also a major problem. The upstairs neighbors were very loud at night due to heavy footsteps, and there was no mention in the listing of a body shop directly downstairs that made loud noises while working.
2 out of 5!

Thanks for a great stay. The flat was as shown in the photos and Garen was very helpful. We were 4 people and had adequate space for all of us. We are light sleepers and had to close the windows at night, but otherwise all was good.
The neighbourhood was maybe not the cleanest but we had no problems and felt absolutely safe walking home at night. It’s very central which is great. Definitely good value for money. Thank you.

Good apartment! There are many rooms, and it was comfortable for 4 of us. Very clean, cozy, and exactly as described. Everything needed for a comfortable stay is available. The host was always in touch and helped with all questions, thank you very much! We stayed in winter, and the apartment was very warm ✨
The location is convenient, you can quickly reach Istiklal Street, walk to the old city through the Bosphorus, and get to Taksim Square.
I recommend it! ☺️

We stayed at Garen’s flat for 10 days. The flat is spacious, clean, and reasonably priced for a 3-bedroom in Istanbul. Its location is convenient, just a 10-minute walk to Istiklal Street and close to a bus stop. Garen was also accommodating with an early check-in.
However, the surrounding area feels less tourist-friendly and can be unsettling at night. Some guides mentioned it isn’t considered the safest. Unfortunately, we were without electricity for two full days, which was a significant inconvenience. Additionally, a streetlight shines directly into one of the bedrooms, and the curtains don’t block it well, making it hard to sleep.
While the flat itself is nice and well-located for exploring Istanbul, future guests should consider the neighborhood and comfort issues.

Me and my friends really enjoyed staying at Garen’s place! It looked just like the photos, everything was clean and had all necessities, location wasn’t too far from the center, we found it all in pleasurable walking distance. We had good sleep, thanks to well working AC, we also felt safe in the apartment. Garen himself was very communicative, very helpful and we really felt taken care of. I can’t recommend him enough because it made our trip to Turkey fantastic and left nice memories. :)

reviews.text: Arkadaş grubumuzla hafta sonu çok keyifli vakit geçirdik. Sahibi Ayça Hanım çok ilgiliydi, eve ilk girerken bizi karşıladı ve evle ilgili detaylı bir aktarım yaptı. Ev tertemizdi bunun dışında evle ilgili aklınıza gelebilecek ihtiyaç duyulan her şey fazla fazla mevcuttu. Hem evin hem de bahçenin atmosferi fotoğraflarda olduğu gibiydi.
Her şey anlatıldığı gibi ve güzeldi. Ayça hanım tüm sorularımızla ilgilenip bize yardımcı oldu. Ev tertemiz ve düzenliydi. Bahçede konaklayan iki tatlı köpek ise tatilimize neşe kattılar.

Eve giriş anından itibaren herşey mükemmeldi. Ev yeni yapılmış bütün malzemeler mükemmel kalitedeydi. Evin dekoru ve konforu bizi büyüledi diyebiliriz. Ailemizle mangal yaktık şömine eşliğinde filim izledik ve bahçe okadar büyük ve güzeldi voleybol bile oynadık. Evde temizlik ve malzeme olarak eksiksizdi. Herşey için teşekkür ederiz.

Ayca's place is decorated with elegant taste has everything you need and an amazing garden.
We will definitely book again.

reviews.text:
I had a great stay here! The location was excellent — close to everything I needed, yet quiet and comfortable. The host was welcoming and helpful throughout, making check-in and communication very easy. It is a hotel apartment with a 24/7 front desk. It was clean, cozy, and exactly as described in the listing.
I’ll definitely recommend this place to others and would stay here again. Thanks for the great hospitality!

The place is located at the heart of the city, near several shopping centers and Şişli subway station. We stayed for two nights. Our room was clean and comfortable. The service was quite sufficient and the host was easy to communicate with. Overall, our experience with the place is pretty good.

The residence is managed by a hotel, placed in a safe neighborhood, centrally located, close to the metro station, bus stop and mall. It is well maintained, with very helpful staff, round the clock assistance and amenities that make it very convenient for a long term stay. I would definitely recommend.

The apartment was clean, and tidy. Is managed by a hotel. The custumer service was great, very responsive, attentive, and make you feel at home.
Definetly recommend this stay.
Professional staff,central location, free parking,washing machine,kitchenette…..everything you need to for a longer stay in one of the hospital districts of Istanbul.

description: This spacious studio offers one double bed and a spacious living area. The living area has one large sofa which can be used as a bed for the additional guest. The studio offers a private kitchenette and a private bathroom with mid size Jacuzzi (140cm*80 cm). There is 24 hours door man and once every 2 days room service. The Turkish bath need to be booked upon arrival for free entrance.

reviews.text:
Location is great and there are many restaurants and cafes in close proximity. The size of the room is really good and accurate per the photos. Bathroom is a little outdated though. Bed is comfortable and kitchenette is sufficient for basic meal prep. The sauna downstairs is also nice and is private use only which is great. Room was cleaned well and done every 2nd day. Hotel staff are very friendly and helpful, and Yusuf and Errol are also very friendly and responsive to questions.
All channels on the tv are in Turkish. Wifi is slow and wasn't always working at night, but is ok for basic use. The fridge in the room was a little loud. You will likely hear noise from neighbouring apartment above, and will definitely hear noise from the corridor, so definitely bring earplugs!
If I could suggest some improvements, would be to improve the wifi and tv service, and get a quieter fridge in the room. Overall very happy with my stay and will be back again.

It’s such a joy staying at Yusuf’s place. Yusuf, his brother Yunus and their colleagues, Erol and Amir are gracious hosts. They are warm and friendly, and speak English fluently, so communication is not an issue. Yusuf is very prompt when replying to messages and he will answer any questions to the best of his ability. Yusuf has a newly opened restaurant, which is just a stone’s throw away. My partner and I had a hearty breakfast and Yusuf gave us a discounted price for being his guests. Thank you Yusuf for your kind gesture.
The apartment is cozy and clean, and tastefully furnished. It comes equipped with a kitchen, which has all the basic cooking utensils and crockery if you want to do simple cooking.
There is a 24-hr reception, managed by Yunus, Erol and Amir for the different parts of the day. They never failed to offer us tea/coffee and cookies every time we returned from our sightseeing trips. We want to specially thank Erol too for helping us to collect our Champions League tickets. He is indeed very knowledgeable and recommended us relevant tours as part of our day trip. Thanks Erol!
The apartment is strategically located - there are so many shops nearby, like sundry shops, cafes and restaurants, and department stores, among others. Istanbul is naturally hilly, so a little hiking and climbing up the hill is needed. Just make sure your wear comfortable shoes.
The apartment is also accessible to major places of interest like the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Grand Bazaar and Topkapi Palace Museum (about 5-10 mins walk). You need to alight at the Beyazit tram station to get to the apartment, which is about 5 mins walk.
Overall, my partner and I certainly enjoyed our 5-day stay and we will definitely come back here for our future Istanbul trips.

We had the most memorable stay in Sultanahmet thanks to Erol and Farhad. The hotel is in the most perfect, central location to all the important sites. Cleanliness is a top priority, we found our room to be spotless upon arrival and the rooms were cleaned every 2 days.
We traveled with our 10 month old baby and were provided with a playpen/crib along with bedding for him. It was great to find a place with a kitchenette (within a reasonable price frame) as that helped with washing bottles and preparing baby meals. When it came to throwing out diapers, the staff was very helpful in directing us to a dumpster right outside the hotel that we could dispose our garbage of daily.
We used a carrier for our entire stay. There's no way you can use a stroller up the steep cobble steps or through the busy markets. We also highly recommend dining at Mivan Restaurant - they have the most fantastic Iskender Kabab! Istanbul was a beautiful experience thanks to our hosts. We will be back!!!

My wife and I stayed at this location in room 201 for 5 nights.
Besides the friendly staff and fast check-in, there’s nothing else to go for and I’ll break the list down:
- Location is somehow okay-ish, hidden between other buildings and easy to miss sometimes.
- The studio was horrible!!! Natural light was close to none!!! The only window of the studio faces the backyard which is a 20 sqm of space shared with other buildings. Additionally, that window is blocked by an emergency ladder. The bedroom is located behind the livingroom that contains the only window.
- Cleanliness: there is mold everwhere! The smell of infiltration and moldy humidity is unbearable. The pillows are extremely stained and dirty. The bathtub (nowhere close to jacuzzi) is out of a horror movie, stained, poorly repaired and falling off.
- Comfort: there’s wires or the TV hanging from the wall in the bedroom. The mattress is absolutely painful by all means: hard as a rock. The pillows are just a chunky piece of plastic shreddings and dust, I still have neck pain and back pain from them, couldn’t sleep for 2 straight hours without waking up.
- Climate: the controller for the AC was missing and eitherway it was very cold at night. We wanted to turn on the heat but there is no climate control. We’ve even tried to open the radiators but they are locked in wooden cases. We had to sleep with socks and two pairs of long sleeved shirts not to catch a cold.
So to sum it up, if there’s a better option available nearby, just go for the alternative.
This location should be avoided.
Bonus: on Google there were guests previously complaining about people drilling and banging in the walls and that was months ago. Apparently it’s still going on.

An apartment unlike any other, with a real concept of urban and grovy art, this family business will get your imagination going straight from the get go.
An always warm and welcoming atmosphere with Turkish tea or coffee on the house to quench any thirst you may have.
Great service all round
Comfortable beds, clean bathroom and a cleverly designed kitchen
You can't go wrong with its location, in the heart of the European tourist side, close to every ammintie possible
All in all
Image 9/10
Price 10/10
Location 9/10
Customer service 10/10

description:
Our studio apartment is suitable for short or long stays. Identity information is obtained at the entrance and a written rental contract is made for each rental.

We pay attention to the cleaning rules; our apartment is cleaned thoroughly before check-in.

We expect our guests to respect the environment and neighbors during their stay.

Basic expenses such as electricity, water, internet are included in the price.

reviews.text:
We had a great time at this apartment, it was convenient for two Erasmus students for 5 weeks. Altin was very friendly. We had enough space for our clothes, we had two separate beds, the apartment was the same as shown in the pictures. The air conditioning was a good solution for the high summer temperatures. One difficulty we faced was the lack of clothes drying rack, but everything else was fine.
Thanks for the host!

+Great communication,
-some thing were worn out,
+OK price for the flat,
+relatively clean
-smoking neighbours

The house was comfortable, cute, and had everything you need for a pleasant stay. It’s small but well-equipped, and overall a nice experience. The only downside was that the host was a bit slow to reply, but everything else went smoothly. Thank you!
Nice for the price
I stayed there for 9 days with my boyfriend and it was a good place with accessible food and buses.

description: Welcome to our third flat. It's located 2 min. from Taksim Square on a quiet street in Cihangir. It's 3 min walk from the subway and everything you need is very nearby. You will feel very comfortable here. Our place is 70sqm in the heart of the city.

reviews.text:
Pros: Berna is a very nice host, responsive, provides clear instructions for check-in, was also helful with the parking details. Lots if parking places around, which offer security for your car for a fair price (we paid around 230 TL/day).
Also the position of the flat is nice, the street is not too crowded, but the noise can be heard from the popular Taksim Square. If you want to stay in an area full of restaurants, night clubs and shopping opportunities, this is a great choice, the neighborhood is alive all week long from early in the morning ‘till late at night.
Cons: The first impression was that the pictures of the flat presented on Airbnb are a little bit outdated, maybe from some years ago. The flat was rather clean, but especially the bathroom was poorly maintained (shower/ window/ sink were cleaned only on the surface and the saddest part was the mold on the walls - we kept the windows open, but it was still very unpleasant).

Berna's place is sparkling clean, comfortably located nearby Taksim square, and comfortable. It's look exactly like the picture. Their welcome message and direction to location and to access the key is clear and professional. If you driving there's otopark nearby however we were parked in road nearby. The house located in the middle of hilly residential area with one way road, and flat situated in first floor so recommended to just pack whatever necessary for duration of your stay rather than to drag all your luggages to the house (if you drive as we did). There's grocery shop nearby so if you would like to cook then you could cos kitchen utensils are complete. Overall we were happy with our stay.

The pictures are real , the information is true , and big enough apartment for 2 guests. Very near from taksim square only 300 meters but it’s in a sharp slope, it’s too hard to carry your luggages if you are walking. It could be cleaner , the bed not comfortable. Need to replace the pillows and the mattress ( they are not comfortable at all ). The toilet is old and small. The bath chair is not stable. Building and apartment is a little bit smelly. Overall the apartment was OK but not worth the value of money for sure. I have tried several apartments in taksim with much better values and easier locations and more helpful hosts.

I was staying with my friend for 4 days. Berna is a great host, she helped us a lot with everything that we needed. For this price apartment was good. But unfortunately, for January-February it’s cold, we used only living room with AC in a heating mode, because a bedroom was cold and there was a balcony. I’m sure, that for summer period it’s much more comfortable, because the bedroom is quite calm and quiet.
The location is really great, you can walk to many beautiful places and metro station is very close. Also if you don’t have heavy luggage, you can easily get from the airport using a direct bus, the stop is 10-15 minutes walk. But if you have a luggage, don’t do it, because it would be very hard to get to the building, there are slopes and stairs. In this case it’s better to get a taxi, Berna also helped us to organise it, we are very grateful to her.

the most accurate and perfect apt matching with the pictures shown here, host is very humble, reply on time ,and helpful . Needed a 2 hours extension, due to flight late in evening, i requested host if there is a possibility i could stay for 2 hours more, she said yes, it made my day as i had no where else to go. Also on asking she suggests places in and around , the flat had all the maps and travel guides on the centre table, living room Aircon was very good and helpful during the day, bed was comfortable, neat and clean kitchen and bathroom, and also explained how to come via metro from airport and also offered a taxi ride directly to flat, choice is guests. So overall everything mentioned is there, honest and nice people.
Only one thing, the balcony is in the backyard in the bedroom, not street side, street side there are huge windows, but sitting area balcony is practically of no use.

description: Welcome to your renovated historic house at the heart of Istanbul, where city's attractions are just steps away. Master bedroom has a double bed, second bedroom has a single bed. Living room includes a convertible couch for extra sleeping space for two. Seperate bathroom and toilet offers multiple use at once. Enjoy light cooking and fresh filtered coffee in the open kitchenette. Keep it in mind that the flat is at 4th floor and these historic buildings do not offer an elevator.

reviews.text:
Apartment looked exactly like photos, it is clean and cozy. We found the beds very comfortable. Check-in with a safe box is super convenient.
The only thing I should mention is that surroundings (last 200-300 meters to the building) can look a little bit worrying to a person first visiting Istanbul, but everything is safe. Easy access from Taksim or Beyoğlu Tunnel (upper station), so you don’t need to climb 😊

It’s the best place for staying in Istanbul!
The apartment was very clean, cozy, and exactly as described. The location is perfect, everything you need is nearby, and it’s easy to get around the city.
The host was friendly, responsive, and gave clear instructions for check-in and check-out.
We truly enjoyed our stay and would definitely come back again. Highly recommended!

Great location, just a short walk from Istiklal Street and close to all amenities. There are plenty of bus lines only 2 minutes away on foot, and the metro station is a 10-minute walk.
The place was spotless and exactly as described in the listing. The host was very kind and extremely responsive to all our requests, and she even allowed us a late check-out. I highly recommend staying here!

We had a wonderful time staying here for a week.
Itir is a very nice host, easy to contact at any time. She makes sure that her guests have a pleasant experience.
The apartment was big enough for three of us and you can find all the essentials for your stay.
Beds are comfortable and I loved the wood floor.
I would say that a few things are in need of renovation, but that didn't bother us much and the cleanliness was at a very good level.

Cafés and famous istiklal st. are just 5min away.
The only thing we were really missing is a bigger grocery store near the apartment.
Thank you for your hospitality:)

We had a great stay in Itir’s apartment. The apartment was comfortable, clean, and well located. Itir was very responsive and we appreciated being allowed to check in early as the apartment was ready.

description: We are Mayer Property Mngmt company with over 110 apts in our portfolio. Our Studio apt is located in Kuyulubag sokak, Sisli. Located in 1st floor, it is within walking distance to cafes and restaurants. 400 meters away from Bomonti Ada w/ easy access to all attractions and hip restaurants & cafes in its neighbourhood. The apt is 20 sqm and well designed for our guests needs: 1 bedroom, a bathroom, a shared kitchen with all appliances and utilities. We look forward to hosting you here.

reviews.text: I had a great stay at this place. It was as described and clean and equipped with towels, sheets, and even slippers. It is similar to a hotel room with a significantly better price. My favorite part of the place was the location. It's located on a corner in Osmanbey surrounded my commerce and activity and a stones throw from the train station. Great for anyone visiting Istanbul and want to see the city as soon as they step outside. The host was also very accommodating with my schedule and quick to respond to any questions I had.

Lovely stay in Istanbul! Apartment matched the photos, super clean, nice and comfy. The apartment is close to the bus/metro station, is on the street with local food, shops, sweets, all you might need. Close to lovely neighborhoods and pretty walkable. Made our stay in Istanbul easier and cozier.
They have all my recommendations!

I had to shorten my stay to 1 night due to the following listed but missing amenities:
1. Internet (host sent instructions to look for login credentials on the modem, which was missing).
2. Shampoo, shower gel
3. Mosquito net
4. TV (no aerial channels, no internet)
5. Carbon monoxide alarm
6. Fire extinguisher
7. First aid kit
8. Dedicated workspace (unusable since no electrical sockets were available in close vicinity of the desk).
The apartment looks like a small hotel room where the bed occupies 90% of the room's space. There are few restaurants around, most places available are traditional Turkish kebab shops.
Check-in was difficult to to incomplete/unclear instructions.
The host was not willing to assist with the found issues and turned their back on me by telling me to "...get in touch with Airbnb about the situation. They will help you about it". They would either ignore my messages or respond very slowly, would not answer the phone.
Oceral, an awful experience. Stay away.

Kerem was helpful and accommodating upon checkout. I’d recommend staying here if you need a convenient base to navigate,
The area is bustling so if you want quiet time it’s difficult if the windows are open, especially at night if you don’t like using the AC. Otherwise the bed is exceptionally comfortable which is most important. The apartment layout could do with basic kitchen utensils just to make living habits slightly easier. Overall I enjoyed my stay, thanks for having me

Overall I did enjoy the apartment. The location was great- outside of the city center but still bustling with markets, close to food and the mall. The apartment itself was also lovely, everything was new and clean.
The area is very loud so if you are a light sleeper I would advise you to find another location.
The biggest negative and something that is very important is the WiFi. It mostly did not work. Sometimes it would work for an hour but usually you have to rely on data. Even when the WiFi is connected it does not really work.

description:

It is a beautiful small boutique hotel with all the amenities listed on it. reviews.text: We had a fantastic stay! The apartment is lovely, clean, and very centrally located, close to restaurants, parks, and easily accessible transport, including the metro and buses. The host was friendly and helpful throughout our stay. Highly recommend!

Alper hızlı yanıt veriyor. Lokasyon olarak sanayi içi olduğundan akşam çıkıp birşey yapamazsınız ama metro, metrobüs’e çok yakın. Toplu taşıma ile gidebilirsiniz. Alper is a very nice and helpful host. The accommodation is modern with an ac and a big window. The bathroom is really small but still fine.
2 minutes away from a metro station is perfect in Istanbul!
I enjoyed my stay and would definitely come back!

Alper is responsive and flexible. The room is compact, rather new and clean. Good for 1 person. Very close to M7 metro and many buses. A bit far for M2, dont walk from there if big lugguage. Many supermakets and few local resturants.

Kesinlikle önermiyorum öncelikle, sakın aklınızdan geçirmeyin. 8 günlük rezervasyonumun 4. gününde terk ettim hijyensizliğe, olumsuzluklara, gürültüye dayanamadığım için. description: This stylish 1+1 apartment in Fatih combines comfort with security. Situated close to main attractions like the Fatih Mosque and Hagia Sophia, it's in a lively, safe area with security cameras in the building. The apartment offers a fully equipped kitchen, a relaxing living area, and a comfortable bedroom, ideal for both short and long stays. Explore local markets, restaurants, and cafes with ease, and benefit from convenient access to public transportation.

reviews.text:
Great stay in a prime location right near Fatih Camii! The location is fantastic, with excellent transport links, easy bus access to major tourist sights, and plenty of shops and restaurants nearby.
What truly made our stay special was the host, Bilal, and his brothers. Their hospitality was exceptional, they were so warm, supportive, flexible, and even treated us to coffee and chocolates.
The apartment is comfortable, with convenient sofa beds in the living room and a standing fan in the main bedroom to complement the living room AC. With a few minor maintenance updates (like securing the bathroom sink, refreshing the kitchen cabinets, and routine upkeep) this place would be absolute perfection.
Despite no lift (which was fine for us!), we thoroughly enjoyed our time and would gladly recommend Bilal’s place. We would definitely stay here again when back in Istanbul!

Friendly & kind host however the bathroom was not clean, mould in areas and toilet seat broken so it rests on your back. What looked like black mould all over the windows. Kitchen was unusable due to the lack of utensils and old saucepans. Overall quite run down. Location is ok- 7min walk to bus connections.
With some work could be good value for money.

The place is in a great location. In less than 5 minutes, you can reach Fatih Mosque and the bazaars around it. Our room was on the second floor, there was no elevator, but it wasn't a problem, even for my elderly parents.
Also, since the house is located on a higher part of Istanbul, you'll save yourself a lot of uphill walking. Instead, you can visit many places by simply walking downhill. And it is 5 mins walk to the bus stop that takes you to major attractions.
Bilal is a great host with a very likable personality. He made an effort to communicate with us in our own language, especially with my father, who doesn't speak English.
If you feel like anything is missing from the house, he will be more than happy to provide it, just send him a message.
I would definitely recommend the place!

Although the area was great and Bilal is a very good , friendly and helpful host, the apartment does need some maintenance, and the photos do not match the real experience. I’m sure that once a few issues are addressed it will be a great apartment to stay at, directly over a fabulous little coffee shop called FROVEL which is run by Bilal and his brothers. They serve fabulous coffee, tea and delicious parties, and are always available for helpful advice and a chat.

Sparking cleaning and state-of-the-art unit that is very secure and close to the amenities.
Great and very responsive host. This is one of the best apartments I have been to, in Istanbul.
I will book again when I visit Turkey in the future.

reviews.text: Very well located hotel with lots of restaurants and bars nearby. Despite busy area room was quiet at night. Very rustic old hotel, but linens and towels were clean and overall it was great value and would absolutely stay here again

location is amazing. even though its very busy area, near Galata tower, parallel to Istiklar street, surrounded by bars and restaurants, there was no noice in the room. reviews.text:
The apartment is in a great location, near Istiklal cd., near the T1 station and within walking distance of the Galata bridge. Around the apartment there are a couple of small grocery shops, cafes and places for turkish breakfast.
The apartment looks like in the photos, but lacks maintenance and cleaning. Half of the chairs were ripped off, there was dust on the floor and there was a lot of mold in the shower. A thorough cleaning and some minimal investment is required to make the apartment perfect. Also, we expected at least one roll of toilet paper in the apartment, that's a minimum standard, at least in the west.

We stayed at this place for 10 days and had a good experience overall. Mücahid is a very responsive and caring host, always available and quick to help with any questions or issues — 24/7 support was truly appreciated.
We really liked the apartment, but keep in mind that it can be quite noisy outside at night, and the windows need to stay open since there’s no air conditioning in the bedrooms. Other than that, we were happy with the location and condition of the apartment — it had everything we needed for a comfortable stay.
Thank you!

The apartment was barely inhabitable. The only reason we stayed there was that we didn't have the time to move elsewhere. Several pieces of furniture were broken, the fridge door didn't shut properly, the toilet barely flushed and there was a lot of mold in the bathroom. We didn't have any towels when we arrived, so they were provided by the host only two days later. There was a noticeable amount of dust. The washing machine had rust and the handle was broken as well, but we still managed to use it after all.
On the upside, the area is pretty nice and close to the tram station, with a lot of shops and restaurants nearby. However, the street is quite steep and loud at night, so earplugs were a must for some of us. There is one AC unit and a fan, but they can't really handle the 24 °C nights (we had to put the fan on and leave the doors open all night). The piano is a very nice addition!
The host conveniently offered airport shuttle service for a reasonable fee (60 eur).
Pictures don’t do justice to how amazing this place is. Great location for the price. Would recommend 100%. Mucahid has been a very responsive and kindest host.

The place is very well located, you have access to everything. However during the night there are noises from the streets and that made us uncomfortable so we couldn’t sleep.
The house is great for 4 people but it needs some maintenance.
Mücahid was so nice to offer us coffee and an early check in. Overall amazing good experience

reviews.text:

Based on other places I looked at as well as places my friends stayed in Istanbul, this was by far the best value if you’re looking for your own place that is air conditioned. description:

reviews.text:
The room here is very beautiful, even nicer than in the photos. The location is close to the main tourist area, and getting around is easy, with the Metro nearby. We highly recommend this place. Just note that you’ll need to walk up the stairs to reach the room with your luggage, but it’s not difficult. The host is very kind, friendly, and gives great recommendations.
We accidentally checked in to the wrong room because we misunderstood the floor numbering (1st floor and 2nd floor) here, but the host calmly solved the problem and found the best solution for us. We want to apologize and also thank them for their kindness.
The apartment was in a great location, nice clean bedroom and bathroom. Exactly what I needed. Check-in and out were smooth and easy. Would recommend.
Everything was great! We stayed for a short period of time, so location was excellent! The apartment was clean, AC was working great and there is a public parking located very close.

Pros: responsive host, flexible check-in, great location
Cons: sewage smell on rainy days, bad cleaning, broken/stained furniture, bad insulation - sound/warmth wise
Overall, okay for a night, it’s not too bad. But not worth the money for a week’s stay.

Ev resimlerdeki gibiydi.İç alan oldukça geniş ve ferah.Daire yüksek tavan olduğu için oldukça güzel.Sadece yatak biraz daha rahat olabilirdi.Onun haricinde konumu ve temizliği gayet iyi.Kendisinin de iletişiminden memnun kaldım.Tekrar kalmak isterim.

description: My apartment is located on the street adjacent to Istiklal Street. It is also on the same street as the famous French Street. Our neighborhood (Galatasaray) is a train-like place with many nice cafes and restaurants. All major tourist attractions can be reached within minutes from the apartment. This spacious space has 4 Bedrooms and 1 Bathroom, making it rare among Istanbul apartments. Our building is a protected historical monument with characteristic high ceilings.

reviews.text: This place is definitely not worth the money. Especially for elderly people and those who have luggages. It’s located on the fourth floor with stairs . It’s not easy even for a healthy person to climb all those stairs. Water heater is located INSIDE one of the bedrooms which makes it impossible to use due to noise and smell and humidity… of course it’s not mentioned and photos not provided… timber floor looks very old . We left the premises on first inspection even though we pain in full, we ended up getting another place

The house is 15-20 minutes away from Taksim metro. Getting there with suitcases is far and uncomfortable because of the hilly terrain and steep stairs. The house itself is old, the streets are dirty, the streets look dangerous but are actually safe. The entrance is a steep spiral staircase, which is poorly lit. I had to use my phone's flashlight. The owner met me at the entrance, was very friendly, helped me to lift my suitcase. But it is very hard to climb such stairs to the 4th floor even without suitcases. The apartment needs renovation, needs more thorough cleaning (mirrors are not wiped enough, curtains should be washed and hung neatly. 2 rooms have air conditioning that is not adjustable, but just turns off, and the other 2 rooms have fans. Bad wi-fi, even rebooting doesn't help. Noisy drains, but that's because the house is old. Bed linen and towels are clean. The host is very friendly and always in touch. Upon check in - there was bottled water, fruit plate, cookies.

The apartment matched the description perfectly. It was in an amazing location, very clean, and my friend and I had a wonderful time staying there. I highly recommend this place. Diyar was a fantastic host—very responsive and helpful throughout our stay.

Ev ilanda belirtildiği gibi temiz ve düzenliydi, ev ihtiyaçları su, kraker, çay, kahve gibi ürünler mevcuttu. ahşap zemin basıldığında pek güven vermiyor, Bina çok eski ve buna has bir kokusu var. Konum olarak merkezi yerlere cok yakın herhangi bir sorun yaşamamama rağmen semt pek tekin değil. Ev sahibiyle iletişim kurmak çok kolay ve yardımsever biri
Bu yer harika bir konumda. Fiyat çok uygun ve ev sahibi çok özenli. Bu bölgede bu fiyata böyle bir daire bulmak çok zor. 4 odalı konforlu bir daire kesinlikle tekrar geleceğim🌸☺️

description: Step into the charm of history in this beautifully preserved Galata apartment, where breathtaking Golden Horn views meet timeless elegance. Nestled on a quiet street yet moments from Galata Tower, it offers the perfect balance of tranquility and central convenience. Explore vibrant Istiklal Street, trendy Karaköy, and lively Taksim Square—all within easy reach. A true retreat blending history, comfort, and an unbeatable location.

reviews.text:
Apartment is in prime location with beautiful views over the golden horn.
It has plenty of space and very good ac.
Host is amazing, very responsive, trying to resolve the issue that you might have.
Although, apartment needs some love. Has some stains, some dust, or in visible areas, but under the bad (lost an earring so took a glimpse).
Shower sink seemed stuffed, water was going out very slowly, so you have to be quick with shower.
Kitchen equipment is fine, but missing some parts and essentials, but that’s ok as you have plenty of restaurants.
There was the issue with the noise after midnight that came out of cocktail bar nearby. Although, host investigated and last night was super quiet, it did affected us. But host was very kind to suggest a solution.
All in all worth the money spent, but needs some maintenance.

I had a fantastic experience staying at this apartment! The location is perfect - close to all the main attractions, cafes, and public transport. The place was exactly as described: clean, stylish, and very comfortable. The bed was great, and the AC worked perfectly, which was a big plus during the summer heat.
The host was incredibly responsive and helpful, offering great local tips and making check-in super easy.
Highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul!

Beutifully decorated apartment, with nice wooden flooring in a great location. Close enough to the heart of beyoglu, but just away from it to not be in a very noisy place. The view is stunning (which makes the 5 sets of stairs to get to it worth it). Yigit was very responsive when we had a brief lapse in wifi connection he was able to solve it immediately. Would definitely recommend!

Great communication from the host, very responsive and checkin/checkout instructions were clear.
The area is a great location, lots of cafes, supermarkets nearby. Flat was exactly as described.
Thanks, would stay again.

We spent a weekend in Yigits place and their recommendations really helped us navigate around in very touristic area. Communication was very good, place is nice and have a lotof necessary amenities. Climbing stairs to the apartment after hard day of walking is quite exhausting, so if you arent ready for that, it will be painful :D

description:
The apartment is located in the center of Beyoğlu, within walking distance to Karaköy coast, Taksim Square and Galataport, in one of the most tourist-attracting districts in the world.

It is in an area where 24/7 transportation is easily available, you can reach all personal needs within walking distance, and you can access all social areas according to your preferences.

I can help my guests with 24/7 reception service to keep your comfort at the top, where they can stay like their own home.

reviews.text:
great stay , best location ever , the room was very spacious , clean with good air conditioning , the mini kitchen so practical , the hotel smells nice and the staff was very helpful ,
the next time i visit Istanbul i will stay at ROYS HOTEL .

The hotel generally met our expectations. The bed was comfortable, with a good mattress and clean bedding. We stayed for 3 days, and housekeeping was done once. It was unclear how the air conditioning worked, but the heating worked well. There was hot water, and the bathroom was convenient.
On the downside, the area was a bit noisy, although everything is close by. It was somewhat noisy to sleep, but we couldn’t close the windows because the air conditioning wasn’t working—probably because it was off-season. There is also a café downstairs where you can eat.

Our apartment was very oriented to the street. Very clean and everything was as described. Location is also very convenient, just few minutes walking to tram station, who will bring you to tourist city center. Also very nice restaurants & breakfast restaurants in neighborhood of few minutes walking distance. I would definitely recommend and Happy to accomodate again.
The place was amazing! Staff was very kind and helpful. The place is very close to everything and exactly as described. It was clean and everything we needed.

Comfortable apartment hotel. Staff always helpful and responsive. Very close to T1 tram.
I was disappointed to see there was no washing machine as shown in the photos. They provide a laundry service which is chargeable but when booking an apartment hotel I expect the washing machine to be included as was shown in the pictures and description.

description:
* Our place is in the center of Akaretler.
It is within walking distance to Beşiktaş Bazaar, the Coast, the Stadium, Dolmabahçe Palace and Nişantaşı

* Our room is for 2 people and we have a paid breakfast service

* Wifi and Air Conditioning Available in Our Rooms

* Our place is in the center of Akaretler.
It is within walking distance to Beşiktaş Bazaar, Bosphorus, Stadium, Dolmabahçe Palace and Nişantaşı.

* Our room is for 2 people, we have a paid breakfast service.

* Wifi and Air Conditioning are Available in All Our Rooms

reviews.text:
The accommodation was located in a hostel; initially, I had some difficulty finding it due to its location in a small side street.
On arrival, the people I met in the downstairs reception area ignored me completely when I asked them if they knew where my room was located - not a very welcoming experience. However, the host explained that there were other guests, albeit ones who were rude and unfriendly.
The room was functional, although some aspects seemed incomplete, and the bathroom was showing signs of disrepair.
The bed was comfortable and I slept well.
I had expected that my accommodation would include breakfast, as advertised by the host, but I never received one during my stay.

Konum direkt Akaretler üzerisinde irfan beyle de iletişim kurmak kolaydı hemen mesajınıza dönüş sağlık banyo da temizdi odanın fakat yerler o kadar temizlenmemiş ki bir vileda atmak bu kadar zor olmamalı saat olmadan bembeyaz çoraplarım simsiyah oldu bu konuda dikkat etmelerini öneririm

Giriş yapmadan önce ulaşmaya çalıştık ama dönüş sağlanmadı. Tahmin yürüterek konumu bulduk. Bizi karşılayan beyefendinin de bilgisi yok gibiydi ama sağ olsun yardımcı olmak için elinden geleni yaptı. İlk verilen odadaki yatak çok kötüydü. Oturduğumuz anda altındaki tahtalar düşmeye başladı. Girişte yardımcı olan beyefendi bizim için başka oda verdi. O odadan memnun kaldık fakat ısıtmasını yeterli bulmadım. Bir de giriş kapısında bir güvenlik sorunu vardı yemek sipariş ettik kapı açık olduğu için lobiye bıraktılar. Market siparişimizde de kurye kapının açık olduğunu belirtip direkt odamızın önüne getirdi. Açıkçası sorunlu bir Airbnb tecrübesiydi.
Fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibi, oda temizdi konumu da güzel. Benim için tek problem ses yalıtımının olmayışı kapıda konuşulan bütün sesler içeri geliyordu.
İrfan bey ilgiliydi, evin konumu çok iyiydi. Fotoğrafta ne görüyorsanız birebir aynısı. Sorunsuz bir deneyim

description: ou'll have a great time at this comfortable place to stay.

reviews.text:
The apartment was very clean and exactly as shown in the photos. The host was extremely friendly and even allowed us to check in early, and the apartment was equipped with all the essentials a guest might need.
The only reason I gave a lower rating is the surrounding area. One night there was a fight in the neighborhood, and I do not recommend walking there at night. In addition, a local market is held on Sundays, which leads to the street being closed, meaning you will need to reach the main road to order a taxi via Uber or other apps.
Also, for me, since I was with a child and using a stroller, getting around was exhausting due to the steep and uneven streets. I know this is common in most areas of central Istanbul, but I wanted to point it out for those with strollers or accompanying people with disabilities.
Finally, the electricity in the building was cut off one night and did not return until the early hours of the morning, while the neighboring buildings were not affected.

The house was exactly as shown in the pictures clean and comfortable. We stayed here for a girls’ trip, and it was a perfect choice for us. Although it’s located on a quieter side street, getting there was very easy, as taxis/Ubers could drop us right at the door. The neighborhood was peaceful and, in my experience, very safe.
The location is also very convenient, with the bus station just a 2 minute walk away and Taksim Square around 10 minutes on foot.

Alemdar harika bir ev sahibi. Eve erken giriş konusunda çok yardımcı oldu bu yüzden kendisine buradanda teşekkür etmek istedim. Evin tek eksi yanı bulunduğu konum itibariyle dik bir yokuşta olması ama otobüs durağına yürüyerek 3-4 dk. Taksime çok yakın sayılır. Ev resimlerde görüldüğü gibi harikaydı. Tüm eşyalar çok yeniydi, sanki ilk defa biz kullanıyor gibi hissettik. Ev tertemizdi. Evde ihtiyaç duyulan tüm eşyalar fazlasıyla var. Kalacak kişiler gönül rahatlığı ile kalabilir. Sadece bir şeyde sorun yaşadık. O da ütü. Ütü yapacak arkadaşlar dikkat etsinler çünkü ütünün alt kısmındaki kaplama ütüden ayrılıyor ve elbiseye yapışıyor. Bu yüzden ütüyü kullanmamanızı tavsiye ederim. Ama Alemdar bunu dikkate alıp önlem alacaktır

Easy to get to and close to Taksim, but quite a steep way down from the bus station and narrow stairs inside the building when carrying a suitcase.
The apartment was spacious enough for two people, but the bathroom is on the small side (door doesn't open all the way).
Kitchen utensils are enough for takeout.
Very local, there even was a market right in front of the apartment on Sunday.
Comfortable accomodation with all needed equipments in addition that it is near to taksim and bus station.

description:
This room, which is within walking distance to popular areas and metro bus stops in the center of Istanbul, is suitable for long and short-term stays, and we always have an open garden.
Access information is automatically displayed in the arrival information 48 hours before the reservation, and everything is as specified in the system.

reviews.text: Apart istiklale 5 dakika konumuyla bizim icin oldukca verimli bir deneyim sundu ancak odanın kacıncı kat olduğunu özellikle sordum ve 1. Kat bahçe katı dendi fakat apart eğimli bir arazide olduğu icin girişi üst kattan yapılıyordu. Yani oda -1 de aslında belki bilmiyorsunuzdur fakat fotoğraflarda da anlaşılmadığı için bu konuda yanıltılmış olduk. -1 de kalmak istemezdim. Manzaramız istinat duvarıydı maalesef. Ve yolun dibinde olduğu icin biraz titreşimli ve sesli bir odaydı onu düşünerek seçersiniz. Ben depremden korktuğum icin biraz gerildim. Bunlar haricinde bir yastıkta kıl vardı. Bir sürü yastık olduğu icin sorun etmedik. Banyo temizdi. Oda büyük ve rahattı. Genel olarak her yere yakınlığı ve rahatlığı sayesinde fiyat performans bir deneyim oldu.

Konaklamamızdan çok memnun kaldık. Oda temiz, düzenli ve fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibiydi. Konumu da oldukça iyiydi, ulaşım açısından hiç zorlanmadık Şişhane metroya 5 dakika yürüme mesafesindeydi . Ev sahibi ilgili ve hızlı dönüş yapıyordu. Tekrar tercih edebileceğimiz bir yer, gönül rahatlığıyla öneririm

We stayed here 3 nights. We booked half a month before our trip and talked with them for the room we wanted and they told us ok. When we came they told us the room we booked wasnt available, and gave us a room in -2 floor, while telling us we will go to the room we book, which was in the 2nd floor, the next day. The next day they told us that they gave the room to another couple and gave us the key of a room in 1st floor. The rooms weren’t clean, there were hairs in the sheets, the bathroom smelled damp, had to ask the receptionist for towels cus they didnt left any in the room. In the bathroom wasn’t well equipped. The hotel was at the side of the road and we could hear the noises of the cars. Had to close the window and stay during night with ac.
The only good things were that you could do the check-in in any time. The receptionists were positive and answered us. The ac works.

Nice apartment close to Galata. Also everything was clean and as described. The apartment is close to a busy street. If you can handle noise in the night this is not your perfect stay. Also the reception was not staffed and we had to wait most of the times if we wanted something. In the end it was okay for the price

Très belle expérience !
Nous avons passé 10 jours au Kaira hôtel, tout était parfait ! La chambre est conforme à la description et aux photos.
Propreté du lieu, très bon accueil, wifi, climatisation, facile d’accès et proche de tout … tout pour un séjour parfait !
La rue isiklal est a 5 minutes à pied, les bus sont à 2 minutes à pied.
La tour Galata, la place Taksim, le quartier de Karakoy qui donne sur le Bosphore … tout ces sites sont accessibles a pied car proche de l’hôtel.
Le petit déjeuner est compris, il y a un service de laverie payant à la demande (300 lyra la machine ) et l’hôtel dispose d’un ascenseur.
Merci encore pour votre accueil aussi professionnel qu’amical. Je n’hésiterai pas à revenir chez vous en cas de retour à Istanbul.

description: My apartment is located at the neighboring street with Istiklal Avenue. It is also at the same street with famous Galatasaray hammam. Our neighborhood (Galatasaray) is a treny place with many nice cafes and restaurants. All the major tourist attractions are accessible within minutes from the apartment. This big place has 4 Bedrooms and 2 Shower and 1 wc which makes it a rare-find amoung Istanbul apartments. Our building is a protected historical monument which has characteristic high ceilings.

reviews.text: If you have a lot of language and elders with you , this unit will be a struggle. It is at 4th floor without lift and narrow stairs. Unit hasn't been maintained good. Old furniture create some dangerous incidents. Broken chairs, kitchen drawers are not possible to open or close. Kitchen awfully dark, small and usable easily. View on picture is visible just from bedroom, don't expect from living room. It is smaller then picture but location is good. Owner responsive and she allow us 1 hour late checkout. But over all for that price I wouldn't rent the place.

Yedi kişiydik, konaklamamızdan çok memnun kaldık. Ev hem temiz hem de çok güzeldi, fotoğraflardaki gibiydi. Konumu oldukça merkezi ve birçok yere kolayca ulaşabildik. Ev sahibi çok yardımsever ve misafirperverdi; mesajlarımıza her zaman çok hızlı cevap verdi ve iletişim kurmak çok rahattı. İstanbul'u ziyaret etmek için tavsiye ederiz.

Very clean the host was friendly and was very understanding
Towels clean
Kitchen clean
Bedrooms clean
Washing machine clean
It is a very good place for a family
Thank you for hosting us
Fatima
Just as described, fantastic location, helpful host, comfortable place.
Great place in a great location. Walking distance to shops and restaurants. The apartment was clean and spacious. Host was helpful and friendly. Would recommend!

description:
Elegant 1BR in a beautifully restored 19th-century building, just steps from Galata Tower!

This charming apartment offers a cozy bedroom, full kitchen, modern bathroom, and a stylish living room that blends historical character with modern comfort. High ceilings, soft natural light, and carefully selected decor enhance the timeless feel.

Enjoy a warm, refined stay in the heart of old Istanbul, where every detail echoes the building’s graceful past!

reviews.text: Was a good stay. The water in the shower kept going cold then hot again. There is no elevator but the location is very convenient and walking distance to many sites. The place was clean and nice. The hosts also had new toothbrushes and toothpaste for us and two large bottles of water. Good experience!

First of all, very clean, very new, very good location, very good service.
The only small points:
First, there’s a door connecting bedroom the stairs, so when someone smokes in the stairs, we can smell the smoke.
Second, the water temperature of shower might be slightly hard to adjust. Not big problem.
Totally worth the price. A nice stay!

The host was great and the overall experience was very positive. The highlight for us: the bed was very comfortable. A couple of important details to take into consideration: the apartment is located right in the middle of a high-traffic tourist area and it is loud. The noise in the bedroom is tolerable; however, there is a wooden door that faces the stairwell, so there is no noise isolation in the bedroom from the internal noise. The last night, we had some very noisy neighbors downstairs who blasted music until 2AM. The apartment is also located on the 3rd floor without an elevator. The heating, which was via air conditioning split units, didn't always work well enough to warm up the rooms. There is no heating in the bathroom, which was always cold. There was really hot water available; however, the temperature was not always constant (and had to be adjusted often). All of that said, the host was very welcoming and we had a pleasant stay!

This is a very nice apartment, located very close to the Galata Tower. It’s clean and comfortable for two people. The living room faces the street and can get a bit noisy until midnight, but the bedroom is on the opposite side and very quiet. Just keep in mind that there’s no elevator—so be prepared if you have a heavy suitcase (mine was around 23 kg). The host kindly offers help with luggage, but I was too shy to ask. Other than that, everything was wonderful!

IM DEFINITELY COMING BACK! this place was perfectly located close to the galata tower and everything on the street. The apartment was squeaky clean with fresh towels, sheets and candles. The amenities in the kitchen were so nice to use as well. At first, I was worried about the noise level from the street, but it turned out that you could barely hear anything in the bedroom. Daria was responsive and gave us clear instructions and extra blankets when we asked for it. Long story short, IT WAS FABULOUS.

description: Located in the heart of Ortaköy, this stylish and spacious detached apartment is newly decorated with a modern twist. Thanks to its large windows, plenty of natural light, high ceilings and comfortable living area offers you a comfortable stay. You can enjoy preparing meals in the fully equipped kitchen and relax in the stylish living room. You can enjoy your stay in a peaceful environment. An ideal venue for both business trips and vacations

reviews.text: I had a fantastic and comfortable stay in this flat. The house was clean and cozy, had all the necessary amenities. The location was great, several bus stops near the house, lots of great cafes and restaurants to explore. Wifi was great as I was working remotely for a few days. But what made the stay even more pleasant was the host’s friendliness and responsiveness since the first day, always there to help and going above and beyond. Thank you so much Alihan for everything, would definitely come back again.

We had a great stay! The check-in and check-out were very flexible, and the host was extremely understanding and quick to respond. The apartment was clean and comfortable, located on a nice street, and we didn’t experience any problems during our stay. Highly recommended!

This house is located right under the bridge (no traffic noise, though). The neighborhood is one of the most authentic Istanbul sectors that has historical charm. Super central, yet, there is almost no street noise. While I was there, the carbon monoxide sensor in the apartment malfunctioned for no reason. Alihan is located upstairs and came to take care of the issue in minutes. He is very kind and makes you feel at home. The apartment is very tastefully decorated. It is impossible not to like your stay here.

Ev konum olarak Ortaköy Meydanı'na yakın, yürüyerek ulaşabiliyorsunuz. Otobüs durakları çok yakın. Ev genel anlamda temiz ve ihtiyaç duyulan her şey vardı.
Ev sahibi cana yakın, her sorunuza hızlı ve pozitif cevap veriyor. Memnun kaldığım bir konaklamaydı.

Alihan beyin dairesinde 2 kişi 5 gece konakladık ve bu süre zarfında her şey bizim için çok keyifliydi. Daire düzenli ve temizdi. Konum olarak Ortaköy sahile çok yakın olduğundan çevresinde bir sürü market ve gezilecek yer vardı. Giriş işlemleri de çok kolaydı. Alihan beyle de her zaman iletişim kurabildik. Teşekkür ederiz :)

description: Enjoy easy access to popular shops and restaurants from this charming place to stay.

reviews.text: güzel ve rahattı ve temiz teşekkürler

Ich war das erste mal in dem Hotel mit meiner Familie (Baby 10 Monate alt). Wir hatten etwas günstiges, sauberes und zentrales gesucht (nah an Öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln)
Das LaSera Hotel hat’s wirklich perfekt getroffen! Wir hatten tatsächlich nicht allzu hohe Erwartungen aber wurden wirklich positiv überrascht. Die Lage ist gut um öffis zu erreichen. Es gab 4 angebotene kostenlose Parkplätze was für uns sehr wichtig war da wir mit dem Auto gereist sind. Wir hatten genau das Zimmer wie auf dem Foto. Da wir mit Baby gereist sind hatte ich angefragt ob ggf. Ein Baby Bett verfügbar wäre und mir wurde sofort geantwortet mit „Ja klar“. Also super freundliches Team > sei es unten im Eingang oder auch die Putzkraft. Alle super höflich und nett.
Der Eingang hatte einen etwas zu starken Duft was mich beim eintreten des Hotels manchmal gestört hat. Das Zimmer war wirklich sauber und frisch gereinigt. Das Bett, die Bettwäsche alles war sauber und auch bequem.
Nachts war es leicht laut draußen.
Oda çok temiz geniş ve güzeldi. Teşekkürler
kolay ulaşım temiz ve huzurlu
gayet güzel ve rahat bi konaklamaydı

description: If you stay in this centrally located place, you will be close to everything as a family. Within walking distance to Marmaray, Yedikule train station, bus stops, markets and restaurants.

reviews.text: Ev temizdi ulaşım çok rahat ve yakın fotoğraflardaki gibi evde ihtiyaç olabilicek her şey mevcut.

Had a comfortable stay here. The location is very convenient, just about a 2-minute walk from the train station. We usually made sure to be back by around 10pm so we wouldn’t miss the last train, but there are buses available if you’re coming back later.
The neighbourhood is convenient too, with plenty of grocery shops, bakeries and local food options nearby. We also really appreciated being allowed to check in early. Overall, a convenient and pleasant place to stay.

Really enjoyed our stay here. The place was clean, well-maintained, and had everything we needed. The host was responsive and helpful throughout. Location was convenient too. Would definitely recommend.
very good location near to public transport clean and comfortable apartment
The place matched the description and photos. Its was also near the sea! Orbay was also very hospitable.

description: Our apartment is on the 2nd floor. The rooms have an electric stove, kitchen utensils, Smart TV, air conditioning and a heater. It is centrally located within a 5-minute walk to Istiklal Avenue.

reviews.text: Overall, we had a pleasant stay. The location is excellent, and the host is very responsive and helpful with any requests or questions. One thing to keep in mind is that the space feels a bit smaller in person than it appears in the photos, especially the bathroom, which is quite small. Other than that, it’s a nice place in a great location.

Arkadaş grubu olarak konakladık ve mennun kaldık. Binaya giriş-çıkış çok kolaydı. Extra kolaylıklar sağlandı...
Wifi harika, modemin odanın içerisinde olması sinyal kalitesinin %100 olmasını sağlıyor. Android Tv var ve Çalışıyordu.
Mutfak biraz ufak ama kısa süreli konaklamalarda gayet yeterli. Tava, tencere ve kaşık-çatal mevcut. Bölge güvenlik konusunda sıkıntılı değil, ana caddeye ve polislere yakın. Odanın boyası yeni, temiz ve ferah. Tek sorun pencereler, dışarıdan fazla ses gelmesi oldu, başka hiç bir sorun yaşamadık. Ayrıca gardolabında yeteri kadar askılık vardı. Yaz mevsimi olduğu için fazla duş almak zorunda kaldık bunun için fazladan havlu istedik ve hemen tedarik ettiler. İhtiyaçlarınız konusunda irtibata geçtiğinizde ilgili ve alakalı bir ev sahibi.
It is a great place for its price! The location is very nice, and the host is very responsive and friendly

description: The Deluxe Triple Room is a spacious and comfortable room option for groups of three or small families. It offers a comfortable stay with extra beds, a modern bathroom and free Wi-Fi. Couples must have a marriage certificate!

reviews.text: Great hotel closeby to the airport. Really modern and clean building, rooms and bathrooms. Great for an overnight stay to catch a flight for a great price. Its closeby to the airport but I would recommend catching a taxi and uber to the hotel as the surroundings arent convinient for walking or public transport. There are some small local restraunts and groceries nearby but no shops. Staff were welcoming and helpful. Would recommend!

Wonderful, simple hotel near the airport, served our needs just right. I’ll stay again, it was a great value. The room was very clean and matched the photos and description precisely. We had a good stay!

It’s worth it place to stay
Neat and clean and very responsive host
Most recommended place if u need a hotel near air port
But if you are coming as a tourist then u should directly be moving to Central places like Taqsim or Istaqlal street

Eşim ve annemle beraber konakladık. Ailenizle hiç düşünmeden konaklayabilirsiniz. Odalar fotoğraftakilerle aynı. Her şey tertemiz ve kusursuzdu. Fiyat olarak çok uygundu. Resepsiyondaki arkadaşlar ilgili ve güler yüzlüydü. Havalimanına yakın bir konaklama arıyorsanız hiç düşünmeyin burayı tercih edin.
Perfect location! 15 mins from airport. Looks exaclty like the photos! Check in was seemless. Very hospitable! Will be back on my next layover

description: You can have a peaceful stay in our 3-bedroom apartment located 50 meters from Pierre Loti Hill. Pierre Loti Hill is one of the most important hills of the seven-hill city of Istanbul. You can reach the wonderful view in a few steps. You can also go down to the coast with the cable car located on Pierre Loti Hill and reach the Eminönü-Sultanahmet tram line. For guests with a car, there is a free parking area nearby.

reviews.text:
The apartment was exactly as described—very spacious and exceptionally clean, which we truly appreciated. Check-in was easy, and the host was kind and responsive.
A few practical notes for future guests: the apartment is on a steep, narrow street with a tight turn, so loading and unloading luggage requires care. Free parking is available about a four-minute walk away. The stairs leading up to the apartment are also narrow and may be difficult for older guests or anyone carrying heavy bags.
The location is convenient for Pierre Loti, although other tourist areas require more travel. Inside, the flooring makes noticeable noise with almost every step, so movement can be heard throughout the apartment and may wake light sleepers. We also noticed a slight bathroom odor and occasionally heard neighbors moving above or below.
Overall, we appreciated the cleanliness, space, and helpful host.

The place was exactly as described and was really clean. We stayed there for 20 nights, and as we were travelling with a baby, we also cleaned and sanitised everything ourselves during our stay.
The owner and their team were excellent with communication and were always very helpful, especially whenever we needed cleaning supplies or anything else during our stay.
The only thing worth mentioning is that the apartment is located in an older, more traditional neighbourhood, so you will see quite a few older buildings and houses nearby. However, the neighbourhood itself is beautiful and has a charming, historic feel. The apartment is quite new and in very good condition. I would just say that it is not located in a modern part of Istanbul; it has more of an authentic atmosphere, which can actually be very nice if you enjoy this type of neighborhood.
Overall, everything was perfect and we had a very good stay.

Her anlamda puanlama 10/10. Ev çok geniş ve bütün eşyalar yeniydi. Zerre kadar toz ve kir yoktu. Abartısız mükemmel temizlenmişti.
birebir normal ev düzeninde ankastresinden, ütü masasına herşey eksiksizdi. Pierre Loti ve Eyüp mezarlığına 1 dk yürüme mesafesinde. Konum harika. Özel otoparkı mevcut. Bütün herşey düşünülmüş. Bundan sonraki İstanbul seyahatlerimizde burayı evimiz gibi kabul ettik yine geleceğiz inşallah :) çok teşekkür ederiz

I have been an Airbnb customer for more than a decade.
Stayed in tens of places in many countries.
I can confidently say this by far the most caring and professional host I’ve ever seen.
The amount of genuine care and the way things are handled are just top notch.
I honestly cannot say enough good things about this host :)
