One of my favorite Airbnb experiences ever!
Wonderful stay in Istanbul. Very clean and spacious!

description: Stay in the heart of historic Istanbul! Our clean, modern, family-friendly apartments on the historic peninsula are the perfect base for your city adventure. Each bright space features contemporary furniture, flexible sleeping arrangements, and a kitchenette for a comfortable stay. Explore Istanbul's vibrant culture right from your doorstep in a space that comfortably accommodates families and groups.

reviews.text:
Zafer is very friendly and responsive. Check-in was very smooth, he was waiting for us at the door to welcome us.
Even people around the area, which is full of nice restaurants, know him and can easily guide you if needed.
The apartment is neat and clean. It felt slightly smaller than expected since it looks bigger in the photos, but this was not an issue for our stay.
Since the apartment can accommodate a group of 4–6 people, it would be preferable to have more than one key available.
The neighborhood is great, with many restaurants and supermarkets just a few steps away. The seaside walk is only a few meters away, and the Fatih tourist attractions are around 1 km away.

I stayed at blue mansion with my family for 9 nights and it honestly couldn’t have been better. The accommodation was clean, had everything we needed, and the location was great for exploring Istanbul as it was close to the main tourist attractions.
I was mostly in contact with Ermullah, who was extremely responsive, helpful and welcoming. He even gave me recommendations and helped arrange guided tours before we had arrived in Istanbul. During our stay, he would also check in to make sure everything was going well and that we had everything we needed.
We really enjoyed our stay and felt very comfortable as a family. I would definitely recommend this place and would definitely stay here again if I ever return to Istanbul.
Thank you Ermullah!

Thank you Zafer for hosting us. There were some fixes needed in home but nothing that impacted our stay in negative way. We loved the clean space, location as well as the service in helping with the cruise and ride to airport. Would definitely recommend others. We stayed here with 4 kids and all loved how everything was accessible on foot. We would book again if we come back in the city!

We had a wonderful stay at this place and would absolutely come back again. The home is very spacious and thoughtfully laid out, making it perfect for relaxing and feeling comfortable right away. The two bedrooms were especially great—both were cozy, well-decorated, and had very comfortable beds that made it easy to get a good night’s sleep.
The kitchen was fully equipped with everything we needed, which made cooking simple and enjoyable. We also really appreciated how clean and well-maintained everything was; it truly felt like a home away from home. There was plenty of space to spread out, whether you wanted to unwind, work, or spend time together.
The overall atmosphere was quiet and welcoming, and it was clear that a lot of care went into making this a great place for guests. We really enjoyed our stay and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a comfortable and relaxing getaway.

This Airbnb was excellent.
The immediate area was off the main road and peaceful.
The place was within easy walking distance to Istanbul historic sites such as The Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia Mosque & The Grand Bazaar. It was on the ground floor so great for older people.
Accommodation was exceptionally clean, spacious and just right for our family of 7. It had plenty of body/cleaning products and pillows/duvets etc.
There are many shops, restaurants & takeaways very close by and priced very competitively.
I WOULD DEFINITELY HIGHLY RECOMMEND THIS AIRBNB - YOU WILL NOT BE DISAPPOINTED.

description: You'll love this unique and romantic getaway.

reviews.text: Around an 8 min walk to Taksim Square. My rating was based off the inaccuracy of the listing. Apparently the place I was supposed to stay was having “issues” but the host didn’t relay that information to me. I ended up at the Yellow Mansion Hotel. Room was a bit on the smaller side, no microwave or kitchen.

A nightmare
I thought I had booked a small studio apartment, but when I arrived I discovered it was actually a very small and unpleasant hotel room. Ok I must have not read well ….but big problem for me since I have friends in Istanbul and I was planning to invite them for a dinner which was not allowed in a hotel room
The property is located in a narrow, noisy alley with a very unpleasant atmosphere. The photos are misleading because they were taken with a wide-angle lens, making the room appear much larger than it really is. In reality, it is just a tiny room with very limited space.
When I opened a drawer above the refrigerator, I found a couple of dirty cutlery items and noticed that the area was not clean.
By mistake, I went up to the third floor instead of the second and saw a small room with the door open, where people were sleeping on the floor. The atmosphere was extremely depressing and uncomfortable.
I contacted Airbnb customer support and explained the situation.

The place was super nice, it even exceeded my expectations! very close to metro station and bus stops, 2-3 minutes from the main street. It was incredibly clean and quiet, I would definitely stay there again if I were to return to Istanbul.
Çok temiz konumu merkezi yerde ilgililerdi tekrar geleceğiz👍
Fiyat performans için ideal

description:
Welcome to stay at this awesome 1-bedroom apatment in a newly renovated historical building, faces the historical tourist attraction of Galata Tower. This unit is very centrally located next to major tourist attractions, right in the center of Istanbul.

It has every basic comfort you need and is designed to make you feel like you're "Your home away from home" from the moment you step-in.

Wish you enjoy a wonderful stay HERE !

reviews.text:
The photographs are the most misleading I've experienced in 15 years with Airbnb. Disgusting black mold is everywhere in the shower. The living room area is broken down. The whole place has a dreary and run down feel compared to the photos.
The shower is disgusting! The mold is worse than I've ever seen anywhere in the world. I grew up in India. The shower will give you piping hot or ice cold water. No in between. If you touch the walls you feel like you need to be bleached yourself.
The living room AC shuts off after 3 hours. In the dead of summer.
The noise transference from the upstairs unit is dreadful. You hear every step. Every furniture movement. And when they run the washer you think there a chopper landing on your unit.
The street noise is to be expected. You're literally next to a popular monument. Ear plugs work fine for this noise.
They're responsive but can't fix this level of broken. Find a differently location - no one needs to stay next to Galata.

I loved the location — the views of Galata Tower were amazing, and the apartment looked exactly like the photos. Check-in was easy and flexible, which made arrival very smooth.
One thing to be aware of is that the area can be quite noisy at night, as many of the shops and restaurants on the Galata Tower street stay open until around 2am. Light sleepers may want to keep this in mind.
The only other issue was that the bathrooms could benefit from a deep clean, as there was quite a lot of black mould visible in the grout.

Very easy to check-in, they work with the hotel next door so we were able to leave our bags with the lobby despite arriving before check-in time.
The area is close to everything and easy to navigate. The apartment itself was easy to get up to on the second floor and had everything we needed for our stay. We didn’t see that the apartment is pro smoking so there was a smell from the other units but we were able to air out the apt with the windows. Very helpful that there was a washer for our clothes after a long trip. We appreciated how responsive and helpful the hosts were. They offered to receive a package I was waiting on to be delivered and answered within a few minutes.

This apartment is great. Well located down the block from the Galata tower with awesome nearby cafes and restaurants. The only hiccup was that the washing machine was broken but our host was super responsive and helped us get the laundry done. Highly recommend the apartment.

The location is great, 1 min walking distance to Galata tower and there are lots of restaurants , cafeterias around.
Apt is well equipped l find everything l need, and the host is always there when l ask anything.
I recommend Galata Masion to everyone.

description: A wonderful building within the historical Fener District. You will be in a building with both the texture of centuries ago and with the most modern facilities. And it is located very close to the Patriarchate and the Red School...

reviews.text:
Honest review
The moment I entered the building, I immediately felt confident that the unit was exactly as shown in the pictures because the common areas were very clean. That was my first impression.
Excellent unit for anyone , the bed and bathroom were super clean, and the kitchen was very spacious and well-equipped with accessories. There were also enough towels provided. Mr. Salih made my check-in and stay very smooth and easy, he was quick responsive to my message.
The bonus of this unit is the sky view. I really enjoyed watching the sky, the birds flying, seeing the stars at night, and the golden morning light. I can imagine how enjoyable it would be during the winter season when it rains.
Comments / Suggestions:
- I wish there had been a towel available for drying dishes after washing.
- Wet wipes or kitchen tissue were missing to clean the kitchen countertop after cooking.
- After washing dishes, there was no large enough dish rack (dish drainer)
- The wifi was so slow.

Deha and Salih have been excellent hosts. The flat is quite comfortable and convenient. I also enjoyed the design in its simplicity, a mix of contemporaneity, kitchen, bathroom, and the presence of the old, like the doors.
It is true that it can be hot on sunny days, but with a good use of air-conditioning, like keeping it on all day, the flat remains cool when you return after a full day exploring the city.
I would definitely recommend this accommodation and return there myself should the occasion present itself.
very bright apartment with lots of sunlight. looks just like the photos. located in a great neighborhood and just few minutes of walking to the ferry pier. will come back again :)

Great view and a truly unique experience. It’s a rare opportunity to fall asleep while looking at the sky through the roof — something I won’t forget.
The place was warm and comfortable even in April, and the air conditioner was sufficient for heating.
The atmosphere was absolutely unforgettable.
Thank you for your help with the laundry drying rack and for the overall pleasant and responsive communication!
İş seyahati için geldik ve gerçekten çok memnun kaldık. Ev fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibiydi; temiz, rahat ve konforluydu. Tekrar yolumuz düşerse hiç düşünmeden yine burayı tercih ederiz. 😊

description: A beautifully designed apartment in historic Galata that perfectly blends timeless historic character with modern elegance. Located in a **safe and central, perfect neighborhood**, just 2 minutes from Galata Tower, it offers a stylish stay on a charming cobblestone street surrounded by cafés, restaurants, and galleries—ideal for experiencing Istanbul with both authenticity and comfort.From here, you are perfectly connected to the city: just 5 minutes walk to metro station

reviews.text: I had a wonderful stay! The apartment looked exactly like the photos—clean, stylish, spacious, and very comfortable. The location was perfect; we walked everywhere, including Galata Tower, Karaköy, and Istiklal Street. There are plenty of great cafés and restaurants nearby, yet the apartment was quiet at night. Check-in was easy, and the host was friendly and quick to respond whenever we had a question. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Istanbul.

I loved the apartment, the location, and the overall experience. It was tastefully arranged, very clean, and had everything one would need. The location was fantastic; while it was located near shops, restaurants, and Galata tower, it was very quiet. Steps away from best food, corner shop and Metro.
Murat, the host, was very helpful and responsive, and kind. Thanks for an unforgettable stay.
One thing to note is that it is a historic building so doesn't have elevators. The apartment is on the 3rd floor with narrow spiral stairs. So, if you have difficulty climbing stairs with luggage, you may have to reconsider. Having said that, my 80 yrs old parents made it up there, although with a few breaks along the climb, and enjoyed staying there.

Let's start with location. Six out of 5 stars! This area heaves with tourists. And justifiably so. But somehow Elif's place is located in a quiet and peaceful nook just a few steps away from the action. The apartment itself has been stylishly renovated. It is very comfortable with modern facilities yet oozes with old word charm. Elif is the ever responsive and helpful host, only too happy to provide all the recommendations and advice you might need. We thoroughly recommend this accommodation and we thoroughly enjoyed our stay.

This flat has an excellent location and manages to be very calm and quite, a rare combination in Beyoglu. It is a charming historical apartment with one proper bedroom and a nice living room. The host is responsive and helpful. I was very happy with its quality and location.
Excellent location, clean, the apartment has everything you need as well. Owner was responsive and helpful

description: Spacious 25 m² studio in Istanbul's Old City, sleeping up to 4 guests ideal for families or small groups. Three large windows fill the apartment with natural light. Features a comfortable double bed, sofa bed for 2, separate lounge area with Smart TV, full kitchen, dining for 4, and modern marble bathroom. Located in authentic Kumkapı, 1 minute from Kumkapı train station (U3/T6 line) and walking distance to Sultanahmet, Blue Mosque, and the Grand Bazaar. AC, heating, fast Wi-Fi, washing machine.

reviews.text: Binanın bulunduğu konum güzeldi, evin içinde de her şey düşünülmüş eksik yoktu. Ve tertemizdi kendinizi evinizde hissettirecek bir atmosfer vardı. Ev sahibi her konuda yardımcı oldu, hızlı dönüşler sağladı 🙏🏻 Ev sahibine teşekkür ederim içiniz rahat bir şekilde tercih edebilirsin 🌸
Great, affordable, comfortable and accessible to major shopping locations
Beautiful apartments with everything you need and with an ideal location. Despite the proximity to the cultural centre, it is a very calm and quiet area. The host is very friendly and responsive
Ev tertemizdi ailemle konakladım ev sahibi inanılmaz ilgilendi herkese tavsiye ederim
I highly recommend - it's a well localised and comfortable place to stay

description:
With the metro and public transportation that depart from in front of this secure, full-suite apartment on the main street, you can easily reach the city's important commercial and touristic areas in short distances and enjoy a peaceful stay.
Sultanahmet 12 km.
Taksim 12 km.
Aksaray 8 km.

reviews.text:
Mr. Nouri welcomed us on the door with a big smile. The place was amazing and exactly as the photos with also providing everything in high quality.
The owner was so friendly and helped us immiedatly, and the metro next to the apartment made transportation a lot easier as there is several metro and tram stations around the building.
We were really happy in this place and we would book it again in our next trip to turkey. We truly recommend this place...

Nuri Bey giriş yaptığımız andan itibaren her türlü sorumuz ve isteğimizle anında ilgilendi. Çok kibar ve yardımsever bir ev sahibi. Ev, yeni ve içerisi tertemizdi. Lüks konaklama deneyimi yaşadık. This was a great host and studio apartment! I enjoyed my stay. I loved having a small kitchen and clothes washer!

description:
Istanbul oktay Houses is located in the centre of the old city, Just 300 meters from Blue Mosque, Hippodrome, Saint Sophia and 500 meters walk to the famous Grand Bazaar. Tourism information office, banks, restaurants, change offices, and other historical monuments are also with in a few minutes walking distance.



From our information desk you can find the answers to all your Turkey travel questions. From here you can also book a variety of Istanbul and Turkey tours.

reviews.text:
The room was quite small, but cozy. The bed wasn't so comfortable.
The bathroom was old and not so clean.
However, the host is very kind and helpfull.
He had given us a rich breakfast (not with the view shown in the photoes) before the fixed time (because we had to take a flight in the morning).
In the room there were towels and other accessories.
Overall, it has been a good experience.

I do recommend the place, while located in one of the most crowded part of the city, it is a quiet place and has access to everywhere and everything, from restaurants to grand bazaar and also supermarkets, cafe etc.
People are great, very friendly and helpful.

Humide room with no ventilation for bathroom, and no room service unless you ask for it.
Oktay is great and his assistants are very welcoming (dispite the fact that don't speak english) but the room definitely needs some work
security wise, the neighborhood and the hostel are 100% safe
Just don't make the same mistake as i did and book it for a honey moon stay
Great place! Oktay is a fin1e host and very knowledgeable and friendly. would definitely stay there again
Une personne très accueillante et serviable! Hôtel très proche de la station de tram T1 et de la mosquée bleu avec plain de restaurants aux alentours! Forte odeur d’humidité dans la chambre

description: The home is at the Istanbul historic centre peninsula, in Beyoglu a few steps away from Galata Tower. A comfortable,well designed, air conditioned, fast internet airbnb confirms the test of 1000mbps apartment and concept maintained with an amazing view of Galata Tower like unreal. There are well known restaurants, cafes, art galleries, boutique, vintage shops. Markets are a min away. All touristic attractions are in walkable distance. You will have more than what traveler needs.

reviews.text:
Wonderful host, met us at the front door. Great communication ahead of time, so greatly appreciated.
Apartment is so cute and charming. Clean. Water pressure is AMAZING. Bed is one of the most comfortable we’ve slept in. AC works great. Washing machine was nice to use. Lots of stairs but we knew this ahead of time, burned off calories. :) Everything had such a nice touch and lots of effort. Ironing board, hair dryer, stocked kitchen, converter, charging station etc.
Location is perfect, view is wonderful. Fairly quiet considering the convenience.
Thank You!

It really is that close to Galata Tower! This small studio has everything you need for a comfortable, pleasant stay, and the location really is excellent, very close to everything in the Galata Tower district and the commercial district that leads up to Taksim Square. The space is quite stylish in a historic building. As the listing mentions, there are some stairs to climb, but the view from the window makes it all worthwhile. Eyüp is an excellent host with great communication and is very helpful. The place was spotlessly clean and provided us with a delightful stay for our last few days in Turkey.

Eyüp is a great host, communication was prompt and simple. The apartment looks exactly like in the pictures, it is clean, comfortable and has a lot of nice details. Also when I arrived Eyüp brought some food, water, tea and coffee, etc that was especially nice after a long day. Location is perfect. It can be a little bit noisy, but it is not very annoying. I would defiantly stay here again.

The location is amazing. The view of the tower is exactly as depicted. While the area is very popular and crowded, we had no problem sleeping (with ear plugs). the noise from the crowd is quite dulled by the height, and there wasn't loud music late into the night - I think there is some kind of noise curfew. Slipping out of the crowd to look at the tower and watch the surrounding area from above was great.
The place has all the amenities you need. It is old, as is any place in a historic building, so if you want new & shiny this isn't for you, but it is clean and more spacious than I expected. Similarly, the stairs weren't bad, but there are 85...probably good after all the amazing food we were eating. Also, our host was great and his food recommendations were excellent. we appreciated being able to store luggage after check out!

Eyp’s place is in a fantastic and lively location! There are tons of shops and restaurants. The apartment is exactly as described and looks just like the photos. The bed was comfortable and the shower had good water pressure. You can easily walk to other neighborhoods and the metro station is nearby. The view from his place is incredible! Being able to sit at the table and look outside the window after a long day of exploring was awesome! He was also very responsive and proactive to ensure my stay was comfortable and going smoothly, which I really appreciated. His restaurant recommendations were also great! The neighborhood felt safe, even at night. I would definitely recommend staying here!

description: Located in the old part of Istanbul is 500 mt. to the Sultanahmet. It offers self-catering accommodation with free Wi-Fi, a flat-screen TV and air conditioning, kitchen & bathroom. The flat has simple furnishings.

reviews.text: Great location for exploring the sites in Istanbul by foot. It’s good to come home to good air conditioning and a nice place with a view of the water. Three markets right outside the door to purchase everything we needed for making breakfast at home each day. Went just a block away to a Turkish bath built in the 1700s for a real local experience. Really enjoyed Arches restaurant right across the street. Clean comfortable beds. Host was responsive. Easy check-in with the housekeeper who showed us how to use the dishwasher and clothes washer which were helpful. amidst our long travels. Great place.

Selim’s place was in a great location - all the major sites (Hagia Sofia, Blue Mosque, grand bazaaar etc) were within short walking distance. Great restaurants among the surrounding streets, although many are tourist prices and you pay more!
The apartment was clean and had everything needed for a comfortable stay. We didn’t use the kitchen much other than to make coffee but it had everything needed to cook a meal. The sun room with a view to the water was our favourite place to sit with a cold drink and enjoy the sunset after a long day of site seeing.
We did have an issue with the wifi but managed to reset it ourselves to get it working again.

We had a great stay at this apartment in Istanbul. Selim was very responsive and allowed us to check in earlier than the specified time due to our morning flight. The housekeeper was also very friendly and let us in, helped carry our luggage upstairs, and showed us everything in the apartment, including how to use the clothes washer and dishwasher. The only thing we didn’t anticipate was having to climb multiple flights of stairs, especially with our luggage. This apartment is on the 4th floor without an elevator, so keep that in mind if you have accessibility needs!
Otherwise, the apartment was clean and spacious with a beautiful sunroom. It was a short walk (~10 minutes with some hilly parts) from must-see sights like the Blue Mosque and Hagia Sofia. There is also a grocery store right downstairs and many delicious restaurants on the same street. Overall, a very comfortable and convenient experience!

The apt was very close to historical landmarks, very spacious, small groceries stores, shop & restaurant few meters away. Checking is easy someone was waiting for us. AC was working well in every bedrooms. Plenty of sun, quiet enough for sleeping. The 1st of 5 daily prayers start at 5:39am on speakers for a minute or so but that’s the charm of Istanbul. I didn’t realize Istanbul was a 16M population city and we needed to pay a bit more to get a nicer apt. Selim organized a Pick up & drop off for a fee to airport which was great as it’s 50 mins away. The service is with a company that assigne mini van.
The 1st pic for the apt is not the exactly the view of the sea, it might have been taken with a 125 zoom. Mattress in large bedroom are a bit hard, towels need to be replaced with softer one and there are holes in them. Apt is on 4th floor but not sure it’s worth it given the limited view. Need to fix the faucets and replace the head shower. 2 of the 6 sofa need cleaning or be replace

Selim's flat was fantastic! With three adults and two kids (8 and 10), we were thankful for the spacious rooms and living areas. The flat was clean, had A/C throughout, and had a full-sized kitchen with a dishwasher and washing machine. Basic necessities (TP, soap, detergents, cooking oil, spices) were provided-- a huge help for international travelers. It's on the fourth/top floor (no lift!) but the sunroom's view of the Sea of Marmara is worth it. There's a bakery a few doors down, and the nearby Arch Bistro and Rabbit Hole were great spots to eat. Did I mention it's only a 15 minute walk to the Blue Mosque/Hagia Sophia area?!
The place is managed by Selim's colleague and a site manager who greeted us, helped us park our car, and gave us a tour of the place. They took us to a grocery store to pick up a few items, and even got a cake for the kids-- an unexpected kindness that added to our warm feelings about our stay. Wonderful people and a great flat-- don't hesitate to reserve!

description: Newly renovated specially designed historical apartment in the heart of Taksim/Beyoğlu. Just 30 meter to İstiklal Street. Clean, secure, well equipped 85m2 (4 rooms) with high ceilings and sunlight. It includes AC, 2 kitchens with refrigerator, cooker, microwave, washing machine, LCD TV, 2 bathrooms and all necessary utilities to cook. There are 2 balconies. There are 2 double beds and 2 sofas that can be convertible to double bed so with a portable bed 9 guests can be hosted if needed.

reviews.text:
Erol is a great and very professional host. He responds to my messages quickly and was very kind to help us with our luggages. As the apartment is on the fourth floor, he helped us to carry our luggages upstairs. He also provided us a storage before the check-in time.

The apartment was exactly as described. It's very well equiped, clean and comfortable. It's very close to the Istiklal and Taksim. So has a good access to public transportation. The only thing that you need to be aware of is that the Istiklal street is always busy and noisy, especially during the weekend, so it can be loud at weekend nights.
It had two bathrooms and kitchens which was very convinient for 8 persons staying over. Also, you really feel secure at the apartment.
I am happy with this experince. It's highly recommended!

I had an incredible experience staying at Erol’s Airbnb! Erol was extremely supportive, helpful, and always accessible. He promptly resolved any issues we encountered, demonstrating his commitment to ensuring a comfortable stay. It was evident that he genuinely cared about his guests' experience and went the extra mile to make sure everything was taken care of.
The location was superb, and the place looked exactly like the pictures—clean and well-maintained. It was situated in a prime area, allowing easy access to various attractions and amenities. I found it to be incredibly convenient and was able to explore the city with ease.
I will definitely be returning to this wonderful Airbnb in the future. Highly recommended! Thank you, Erol for an outstanding stay!

The overall experience of my family in 8 nights at Erol's house has been totally positive and we had a very nice stay there. The pros and cons of the house in summery are as follows, hope it helps other guests:
Pros:
1- location is great, loads of cafes, bars, restaurants just downstairs, a few meters walking to Istiklal street, and 5 min walking to metro station.
2- the house was immaculately clean, higher than our expectation, spacious, we had a family of 8 without any issues.
3- Erol left some stuff for us which surprised us, ex: breakfast stuff, cleaning stuff, etc.
4- The house was well decorated, everything seems newly refurbished,
5- Erol respons to email has been quick, really helpful and polite. He accepted to keep our stuff in the house for couple of hours after check out before another guest arrived, which was really helpful for us, Thanks Erol.
Cons:
1- The house is on the 4th floor in an old apartment without lift
2- The night club and cafe noise may bother you at night especially over the weekend, Erol left some earplugs in that case. He was honest and had informed us about that issue in the ad.

Everything was great! This place is highly recommended! The flat was amazing with stylish furnitures and historical atmosphere. Great taste! Everything was new, very clean and tidy. Beds are very comfortable with high quality sheets and pillows. Kitchen is full of necessary utilities to cook. We also found free breakfast as complimentary (Thank you Erol) All the details were very well executed in a very quality way. The location was very central and safe. Finally our host Erol was great. He personally welcome and guided us for many things which made our stay a great experience.

We had a wonderful stay at Erol’s place! The apartment was so clean, cozy, and had everything we needed for a comfortable trip. The only minor challenge was the number of stairs to reach the 4th floor, but it's a small price to pay for such a great place. Additionally, Erol, the host, was incredibly helpful throughout our stay, which made the experience even better. Overall, I highly recommend this accommodation!!!

description:
Stay in a historical building near Taksim and Nisantasi for sightseeing and shopping.
Our flat is located in a historic building on the main street of Kurtulus, the area in
Sisli. It is near Taksim, Nisantasi, Bomonti and Sisli, near the bus station and 5 minutes
walk to the metro station. Everything you need is on the main street.
And it's only around 8 minutes away from Taksim by car. Also, many taxis drive through the street.

reviews.text:
This apartment is beyond amazing! If you want a genuine, very local yet accessible Istanbul experience, this neighborhood is the place to be. Although an Uber ride is always a minute away, you can easily reach the Osmanbey metro station which takes you to (e.g) Taksim Square and the Galata Tower in minutes. Endless shops, grocery stores and restaurants are within walking distance as well. The upscale neighborhood Nisantasi is 15min away and if you don’t mind a nice walk you can even go down to the Bosphurus and take the boat to Asia! :-)
As for the apartment, I was verg impressed with how accurate the pictures are. To be honest, in reality it’s even better! Very spacious, comfortable beds, all necessary amenities in the kitchen, a spacious and confortable living room/dining room, 1st floor access (which was great for my older family members!). There’s a cute little balcony in front and a larger balcony in the back. Oh and everything is brand new and superclean. I honestly can’t name a thing that I didn’t like!
Hulya is very fast with messages and she’s very hospitable. We felt very much at home which only added to the incredible week that we’ve soent in her alartment. I can’t wait to visit Istanbul again and I will definitely stay at her apartment!
Thanks Hulya (and Aunt Nezosh for staying up so late for us to pick up the keys!! :-))

Just as pictured, the flat is very stylish, comfortable, clean, and spacious for two. Location is a quick walk to nearby Osmenbey metro, and the neighborhood is definitely everyday, residential neighborhood with loads of cafes, shops, grocery stores, restaurants. Close to touristic sites by metro (one stop to Takism), but nice to be away from the crowds. Hosts were nice and accommodating, and we were greeted with a fruit platter and turkish delight. Would definitely return!

Me and my friends stayed in Hulya's appartement for almost 2 weeks and we can only recommend it! The flat was clean and cosy, we felt like home. The flat looks exactly like the pictures. The WiFi was great, we were able to enjoy our series in this lovely flat. We liked the location as it was close to the metro and we could easily find a taxi or Uber. Furthermore, there are many shops, restaurants and also a pharmacy nearby the flat. We had no problems with check-in and check-out and we could also reach Hulya at any time for any questions we had (she is a great host). We can only recommend this beautiful flat. We are already planning our next trip to Istanbul.

It will definitely not be our last stay :)!

We had a great stay at Hulya's place! She was very responsive and proactive, making sure everything went smoothly. The house was clean enough, and both the sofa and beds were comfortable.
The location was great with a bakery, butcher, and grocery stores just around the corner, making it convenient for our family reunion. The walk to Taksim Square was easy, and public transport was great, though we did experience issues with taxis and Uber refusing to take us back to the property almost from anywhere!
A couple of things that would have made the stay even better would be the addition of a toaster, microwave, some basic cooking ingredients like spices and oil, baking paper, dishwashing liquid and toiletries. Overall, we felt very much at home and had a good time!

Amazing place, very beautiful and cozy. We were staying with my family and we were very satisfied. Hulya is great, we had very good communication throughout, thanks for everything. The location of the apartment is very good, it is close to everything and there are many shops, restaurants and everything you might need just 2 minutes away. Advice to all who travel by car, book parking spaces in advance, because very often even they are full and you have to look for new ones, they are not expensive, but we visited 4 parking spaces and they were all full.

description:
It's a charming flat with Bosphorus view.
This is great place for a family or couples. Cihangir is a residential area right next to Taksim square, a sacred calm neighborhood that's rich with dining areas, pubs, parks and cats! :) The home is fully equipped for short and long stays. You may stay all day at home, have your coffee in the living room with a little view of Bosphorus or jump into the city life that's running just next to the flat.

reviews.text:
I've been a constant traveler via airbnb since 2014 and here is my honest review:
The pros:
Location is perfect, close to everything. Street full of cats! We've already missed the street:)
The apartment is huge
Bosphorus view
Very quite to sleep (rare for Taksim)
Cons:
The bathroom is tricky and you shower very carefully
The wifi does not cover the large bedroom :(
No space in the closet
But other than that everything was really good and I would recommend the place for a short stay.

I think it was my best airbnb experience ever 😁. Elif has a lovely cosy flat with a soul, ideally located and with a wonderful view! It has everything you need to live and enjoy Istanbul. A special thanks to Elif for the communication - it was perfectly smooth and fun, speaking two languages at once with you - English and French - one love 😄❤
Merci beaucoup pour tout! Your flat on the stairs is forever in the heart ❤

Elif’s place has spectacular views of the Bosporus and it’s in a quite amazing neighborhood of Istanbul - Cihangir - with full of coffeeshops and boutique stores.
Apt itself is very spacious with great amenities. Elif has been very responsive to our inquires and highly recommend her place for future travelers that want to stay in a non-tourist but yet central neighborhood!

Elifs apartment was the perfect Choice for our Trip to Istanbul. Cihangir is such a nice neighborhood with awesome cafés and restaurants and the apartment almost felt like home. You have to climb a lot of stairs in that area but being accompanied by all the cuddly ans charming cats it's so much fun.
Totally recommend this place!!!

Located in a quiet and residential neighborhood, full of very nice cafes and restaurants, it is close to everything and very well connected. But be prepared to go up and down stairs, both on the street and in the building

description:
✨ Welcome to Nişantaşı Life Residence Apartments ✨
A brand-new, earthquake-resistant building with 24/7 security and CCTV surveillance for complete comfort and safety.
Spacious, elegant apartments fully air-conditioned, with a modern elevator.
📍 Prime location in the heart of Nişantaşı, just steps away from restaurants, shopping centers, and public transport.

The perfect choice for families and guests seeking comfort and luxury in Istanbul.

reviews.text: Tarik's place is good, clean, and comfortable enough. The apartment matches the description and photos. Check-in process and communication with Tarik were easy and flawless!

Everything was perfect! From the location to the cleanliness and responsiveness of Rabee and Abu Harun, we had a great time! Highly recommended and definitely won’t be the last time. Thank you for making our time in Istanbul incredible!!
The stay was worth the money! Host is very responsive and the place is located in a nice neighborhood!

This place was presented as a hotel apartment and the pictures are promising the same it.
In reality, it is at best a 2-star motel.
The place needs a significant maintenance. Everything feels dirty, or broken.
Tarik is a nice welcoming host , place is recommended for a group of friends or a family !! Location is great !

description:
Our apartment has a modern and elegant look in the very center of Istanbul. You will discover the comfort of walking to all the city's major tourist attractions and centers of interest.

The interiors were furnished with your comfort and luxury in mind. Enjoy relaxing with comfortable bedrooms and a spacious living area.

Watch the breathtaking view of Istanbul from the large terrace of our apartment. You will be fascinated by the view illuminated by lights, especially in the evening. Make unforgettable memories.

reviews.text:
Host was very acoomodating.
Self-check-in was very easy, just had to speak with the front desk and let them scan your party's passports and they give you one key. Apartment is on the ninth floor with two levels inside. 5 separate beds total, three of them queens/doubles and 2 of them twins. There were also extra mattresses provided.
A washing machine was also provided in the upstairs bathroom. Although, the water throughout the apartment had an intense metallic smell. I wouldn't wash my face with it or brush my teeth with or anything like that.
There was a small balcony that was very nice, with a rack to dry clothes. Kitchen seemed well stocked, although we didn't use it.
The location wasn't ideal as there was not much going on around. There is one small market right accross the street for essentials, but nothing much to see or do within 5-10 minutes walking distance.
Overall would recommend if you have something to do in that specific area and need flexible stay. Nice views!

We really enjoyed our stay. We were hosting our parents (60+ years old with mobility problems) and we have a 3 year old and everyone was comfortable and had fun. Here is a summary of the good things about this place:
Excellent location, clean house, helpful staff, accessible (no step entry, no steps in the street, bedroom and bathroom on the main floor), taxi stops in front of the building, clean swimming pool, 2 elevators, excellent communication, several convenient stores across the street and and next door. 2 restaurants across the street and next door. all restaurants and stores deliver to Elysium Residence.
two points to note:
some taxis take you to Elysium Hotel, but you should clarify you are going to Elysium Residence (show them the location on your phone).
It takes 9 minutes to walk to Taksim. If you go up the hill you will get to Comhiriyat street (has bus stop right at the corner if you want to go to anywhere else). The rest of the walk is flat surface. if you have a bad knee take a taxi right in front of the building and will be 25-30 TL (less than $2) to get to Taksim. There is Metro station at Taksim if you do not like to ride a bus.
Cihan is very responsive and helped us with airport transport.

The apartment is as described in the advertisement, is clean, tidy, in the city center, within walking distance of Taksim Square, very easy to reach the station, a really good host, the house is very clean, the furniture is new and very stylish
Found the apartment to be exactly as described. Comfortable and clean. Lovely helpful staff and easy to get to metro and bus tours. My party really enjoyed their stay. Thank you

Absolutely loved my stay at Cihan’s Airbnb in Istanbul! Cihan went above and beyond to make our experience exceptional, kindly accommodating our early check-in request, which made our arrival so smooth. The apartment was spotless, beautifully decorated, and had everything we needed—including a fully stocked kitchen that made it feel just like home.
The location was perfect, super close to Taksim Square and surrounded by great local restaurants, so we were right in the heart of everything Istanbul has to offer. The building itself was fantastic; the pool was a wonderful bonus for relaxing after a day of exploring. The staff made us feel welcome, offering helpful suggestions on things to do and assisting with transportation.
Cihan’s attention to detail truly made us feel comfortable. He was always quick to respond. Staff was happy to help with local recommendations, which led us to hidden gems we’d never have found otherwise. I can’t thank him enough for his hospitality! 5 out of 5!!!!

description:
Close to some of Istanbul's most famous places such as the Suleymaniye Mosque (1.9 km) and Galata Tower (2.5 km), Berce Hotel is a great choice for tourists.
To make your stay more enjoyable, the boutique hotel offers concierge and rooftop terrace services. A buffet breakfast is also available. Guests arriving by car can take advantage of the free parking service.
You can have a good time by visiting Topkapı Palace (1.1 km), Sultan Ahmet Mosque (0.3 km) and Hagia Sophia Museum/Church (0.7 km).

reviews.text: It was our honeymoon and we really enjoyed the hospitality offered by Ramazan and his staff working at the hotel. Really loved the area of the hotel being close to the grand blue mosque area, the room with a balcony view, breakfast, and the ambiance. Would have been better if room cleaning service was done everyday but overall, the cleanliness of the room was great. Definitely a good place to stay for the price range.

Lilia and Ramazan were more than helpful. If you need any hints from a local, ask Lilia! The location of the hotel is absolutely perfect for a tourist who likes to walk(all the sightseeing are within 5 minute walk).The street is quit and beautiful. Authentic cafes with tasty coffee, food and what is more important- hospitable hosts - are next to Berce hotel. If we are in Istanbul, definitely will stay there again!!
It was incredible. The hotel was very comfortable with a good location and Ramazan was very nice and helpful. I definitely recommend this place.

Nice authentic Turkish room! Clean and bright. Next to the hotel is a market and many restaurants) located in a quiet cozy corner. The colorful houses reminded us a bit of the Bolat district. Ramazan was very attentive and friendly and offered help with the itinerary. Pet-friendly
Great location, everything was perfect, room was clean and check in went really fast.

description: It is possible to reach Şile, which is 60 km from Istanbul, in 1 hour by car. It is also possible to reach Üsküdar in 1.5 hours by public transportation. My house is a 5-minute walk from the bus terminal. It is a 15-minute walk from Kumbaba Beach. It is a 15-minute walk from the markets (Migros, Hakmar, Şok, Bim). My house is in a very pleasant location with a private pool surrounded by greenery. It can accommodate 6 people very comfortably.

reviews.text: Aslı hanımın evi, fotoğraflarda göründüğü ve açıklamalarda anlatıldığı gibi. Çoğunlukla dışarıda vakit geçireceğiniz bir ev. Biz uzaktan da kendi internetimizle çalışabildik. Ev girişindeki hol hem serin hem de oturma alanları çeşitli. Havuz başı tam bir keyif alanı, alan hem geniş hem de şezlong, masa/sandalye, salıncak, kabin, duş gibi alanlarla çok kullanışlı idi. Evde iki köpekle kaldık ve bizden yana bir sıkıntı yaşamadık (umuyoruz Aslı hanıma yansıyan bir durum da olmamıştır) Köpekle kalınacak yerlerde bahçenin büyüklüğü, serbest olabilecekleri alan önemli hale geliyor. Şile merkeze yakın, yeri çok rahat. Bir iki gün kafamı dinleyeyim, bir yerde kalayım, hiç çıkmayayım, hiç de rahatsız edilmeyeyim isterseniz bu ev, o ev. Aslı hanım çok ilgili, her detayı iletiyor, sorulara hızla cevap veriyor, daha da önemlisi hem esnek girmemizi hem esnek çıkabilmemizi sağladı. Bunun için çok teşekkür ederiz.

The pool was nice and the garden was well maintained. Only 5 minutes from the pedestrian stress of Sile, such is good.
The host was very responsive!
Host described place as the bottom floor of her house. In actuality, it was the basement and not the bottom floor. A bottom floor means the ground floor. Yet this was an underground basement. So listing needs to reflect this. Very little light.
There is strong humidity in this basement and the host admitted that to us which is why the windows had to stay open.
We had to wash the sheets a few times because the humidity made them feel always sticky.

Öncelikle ev sahibine herşey için teşekkür ederiz. Evsahibi iletişimi, alakası müthiş.Her konuda bize yardımcı oldu. Evin konforu temizliği korunaklı olmasi ve her ihtiyaca göre düşünülmüş olması harika. çocuklarla rahat güvenilir bir ortamda kaldik.Asli Hanım çok hoşgörülü ve her ne sorduysak hemen yardımcı oldu. Bahçe, havuz, evin her yanı çok kullanışlı. Bize giriş çıkış saatleri için de çok çok yardımcı oldu.Kesinlikle sıralamada her yönden tercih edilecek tatil evi.

Sevgili Aslı hanım o kadar ilgili bir ev sahibiydi ki her gün ama her gün yazdı hatta gün içinde iki üç defa yazdı durumumuzu sordu. İlgilisi mükemmeldi.açıklamaları, etraf hakkında bilgi vermesi çok hoştu. Hatta bayramın ilk günü market kapalı idi. Kendisi dilersek bize elemanının yardımcı olabileceğini de söyledi.
Gelelim eve. Ev resimlerdekinden çok daha güzel. Evin içi tablolar dekor vs. her şey güzeldi. Tam bir yazlık konsepti ile düzenlenmiş. Yataklar gayet konforlu idi. Telefon çok çekmiyor ama bu tamamen telekomünikasyon şirketleri ilgili bir sorun. İnternetimiz gayet iyi çekiyordu. Zaten gün boyu bahçede olduğundan sorun dahi olarak görmedik . Bahçe ve havuz şahane. Havuzun temizliği çok iyi. Mutfak banyo odalar tertemiz. Nevresimler mis. Mutfak eşyaları gayet güzel. Hatta Aslı Hanim baharat kahve ve temel olacak bazı malzemeleri bile bulundurmuş. Gerçi biz biraz yağını açmış olabiliriz . Hakkını helal etsin :)
Kabul görürse tekrar konaklamak isteriz
Çok teşekkürler :)

Bu tatil bizim için ilk airbnb deneyimi olduğu için, kafamızda bir dolu tereddütü de barındırmaktaydı. Eve gelir gelmez bu endişelerimizin ne kadar yersiz olduğunu anladık. Ev tertemizdi, bahçe ve ev fotoğraflardaki gibiydi. Havuz ve bahçe çok güzel ve temizdi. Çok keyifli iki gün geçirdik. Tam kafa dinlemelik. Ev sahibi Aslı Hanım bizimle irtibatı hiç koparmadı. Hep çözümcü ve pozitifti. Konukseverliği için kendisine teşekkür ederiz. Fırsat bulursak yine gitmeyi düşünürüz.

description: Genius Hotel Istanbul is literally located in the heart of Sultanahmet away from Hagia Sophia and Blue Mosque 200 metres. All the rooms are furnished according to quality hotel category and range in size from 16 to 30 m2.

reviews.text: We really enjoyed our week at this clean, quiet hotel. Our comfortable double room had a little balcony with two chairs and a table from which we could just see Hagia Sophia. We had a small fridge and kettle, tea and coffee which were all very helpful. The location is perfect; peaceful and away from the crowds but only a few minutes' walk from Hagia Sophia, TopKapi Palace and the Blue Mosque. A short walk takes you to trams and also the seafront where you can take commuter ferries across the Bosphorus. On reception Fahmet was particularly helpful giving us local information about nice places to visit.

The place was clean and simple. It is within 5 to 10 mins of walking distance to the Hagia Sofia and Topkapi Palace. The bed was quite comfortable. If you have some physical limitations, be aware that this room is on the 4th floor and the stairs are somewhat steep.
Fantastic location near Hagia Sophia, we loved it. Hotel for the price was excellent value for money. Emin very helpful and accomodating.

We spent a whole week at Genius Hotel. It has a great location in Fatih / Sultanahmet, just next to the Topkapı Palace.
Dear Mr. Emin,
I am writing to express my gratitude for the wonderful stay at Genius Hotel. My partner and I spent a week and were very pleased by your unbeatable beat. You and your staff have given us no room for complaintq. You did your best to resolve the misunderstanding concerning breakfast fees.
We wish to thank you deeply for your generosity that we sensend since the first day!! We enjoyed the quiet stay, cleaned room and excellent location of your hotel. This definitely added to the excellent service of the staff (special thanks to Ferhat) and your continuous guidance through reservations and recommandations (restaurant, show, hammam, shopping).
It was a pleasure to meet you and I highly recommend other guests to choose to stay at your place.
Best regards,
Jeremy Decot
Clean hotel, amazing location, we appreciated the calm street.

description: Featuring high ceilings, exposed brick walls, unique decor, high-speed internet, and air-conditioning, this centrally-located two bedroom apartment has been immaculately refurbished by a noted interior and furniture designer.

reviews.text: Beautiful flat in a great location, just as in the pictures. Very comfortable beds and spacious bathroom, though the shower could use an upgrade. We really enjoyed the decor and books in the place, and the thoughtful touches like the umbrellas. Seyda is a great host, very responsive and helped us with late check out. The kitchen is functional and basic, don't expect any heavy cooking. The location is very central and there is a store + great Sunday market downstairs

Ev ve ev sahibi belkide gereğinden fazla ilgili ve yardımsever,
Konum merkezi ve tam ortada sayılacak bir yerde Galatasaray lisesi karşısından düz gidip köprü altından geçin evdesiniz 200-300 metre anca mesafe,
Genelde 3-4 önemli beklentim olur öncelik aırasına göre
1: konumu / gayet iyi ve avantajlı
2: sıcak su ve ısınmasının iyi olması / çok iyi ve anında ısınıyor fakat gündüz su basıncı düşük olabiliyor
3: yatağın rahat olması / bu konuda vasat yatak taş bloğu gibi dinlenmek yerine uyanınca dayak yemiş gibi insanın beli ağrıyarak uyandırıyor 😜 acil değişmesi gerek
4: fiyat / genel ihtiyaçların tamamına bakınca gayet uygun
5: Otopark/ çevre ve bina önünde ücretsiz aracı bırakma şansı var
6:
Geneline bakınca 4 ile 5 yıldız arasında gibi görünsede iyi olanların baskın olması sayesinde 5 yıldız verdim ,
Evin dekoru güzel ama bana fazla kalabalık geldi , kadınlar İçin bolca fotoğraf çekme köşesi var elbette ama aynı tarz daha sade olabilir ,
Mesela banyo ile oda arasında duvarı boş bırakmamak İçin asılmış tahtaya odadan çıkıp banyoya. Girerken devamlı kafası çarpıyor insanın ,
😂

Good:
-Location is great if you want to be walking distance to Taksim
-Apartment design and decor is cool
-Parking seems to be easy (I parked there for one night)
-Seyda is very easy to communicate with and addressed most issues (some listed below) we ran into quickly
Bad:
-The listing says there is portable air conditioning. There is none. Only a fan. It is not a livable space when it’s hot. Especially after a walk back from Taksim in July/ August
-The apartment needs some serious maintenance work. While we were there two lamps stopped working, the bathroom light switch stopped working (stuck in the ON position), the toilet stopped flushing, and the shower was leaking and not draining
-The apparent needs some serious cleaning. From the hair dryer in the bathroom to the rugs to the furniture
If the place was clean, everything was working fine and there was air conditioning, I would give the apartment a 5 star. Until then a 3. Good news is that these are all issues Seyda can address and then have a great space to rent out!

Our stay was wonderful! The apartment has beautiful decor with rustic charm and wood detailing. The air conditioner was strong and the bathroom was large and clean. Şeyda was super helpful and responsive and even checked in to see if we made it in ok. I noticed that others have mentioned that the room facing the street is noisy due to street noise and the water boiler. The water boiler is only an issue when someone is using the water and ear plugs can fix the street noise so I would bring these if you plan on taking that room. The apartment is right near a lively and happening area but not directly in it, which was nice. All around a great place!

Pros: Gorgeous flat in Beyoglu. Looked exactly like the pictures. Spotlessly clean and cozy. Comfy beds and great shower.
Cons: You can hear street noise from the front bedroom at night so if you’re a light sleeper, choose the back bedroom.
Bonus: Seyda recommended the Kilic Ali Pasa Hamam, which is about a 20 min walk away. It was PURE heaven and we’d highly recommend to other visitors! Also a nice area for restaurants and boutiquey shops👍🏼

description:
1️⃣ Please specify the correct number of people who will be staying when booking. We cannot accept additional guests afterward. There is paid indoor parking for the car
2️⃣ Before check-in, we kindly request that all guests share their ID or passport photos.
3️⃣ The bathroom and toilet area are compact/small. Please carefully examine the photos in the listing to avoid surprises.
4️⃣ There may be occasional noise during the day due to ongoing renovation work in the next building.

reviews.text: Konum gayet iyi, gece etrafta aşırı ses de yok, Cuma akşamı kaldım. Ev gayet temiz, sadece aynı fiyata daha yeni bir daireyi tercih ederdim, biraz eski hissettirdi ve duşun kabinsiz olması bir dezavantaj. Onun dışında ev sahibi gayet iyi ilgilendi ve çift kişilik yatak konforluydu.

Konaklamamızdan çok memnun kaldık. Ev oldukça temiz, düzenli ve fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibiydi. Ev sahibi ilgili ve iletişimi çok iyiydi, her konuda hızlı dönüş yaptı. Konumu da oldukça kullanışlıydı. Rahat ve sorunsuz bir konaklama deneyimi yaşadık. Kesinlikle tavsiye ederiz, tekrar tercih etmek isteriz.
It's a great location. The apartment was clean and everything is as described. I was allowed to check in early which I appreciated.

a very friendly host and always available to answer your questions and help you out when needed!
only the accommodation was not clean and the bathroom had a suspicious smell which needs to be fixed for next guests.
the location is more than perfect! near the ferries, near the center of Kadikoy and Metro station.

The place was good as a base to sleep in. Wasnt somewhere I'd be super keen to hang out in for any other reason. As others said, the bathroom is small, and the host was nice. only real problem was an audible industrial humming at all hours that kept me awake, coming from a non-usable balcony which I think had a water heater on it. host was nice though and there is a secure lobby unit though you can leave your luggage in which was useful.

description:
A lovely Ottoman-era wooden house , located in the very heart of the historical peninsula of Istanbul.
Our flat is on the second floor of a traditional Ottoman house which was restorated in 2013. The place is located in the center of the historical peninsula of Istanbul. It's a few minutes walk to the metro and tramcar stations, Süleymaniye mosque and Beyazit Tower in the main campus of Istanbul University. Within a ten minute walk you will find yourself in Sultanahmet region and Grand Bazaar.

reviews.text:
I stayed in this charming wooden building for a few days in May.
The flat is at the top of two flights of stairs and is a quaint wooden styled flat. The floors and ceilings are nice to walk on and to look at too. The kitchen is clean and functional and the central heating was very effective. This flat is perfect for the colder months!
The bathroom is a little small but overall it's perfectly fine and clean, the sealant might need replacing. The shower is lovely with great pressure!
The location is very good for Sulaymaniye mosque, Egyptian Bazaar, Yeni Cami and the Fatih area. For Sultahnehmet area you can take the tram for 3 stops. The tram stop is about a 5 minutes walk so it's still close. The area is peaceful and quiet, lovely to relax in after a long day of walking and there are great restaurants and cafes nearby.
The host himself is very accommodating and let me check in early and check out later. He even offered to look after the luggage while I walked about.
A good stay!

Mr Erhan was very responsive from the start of booking, making us feel very reassured. Place was very clean and amenities are as described. It's at the top of a set of steep stairs but that has been made clear in the property details and we had no issue with it even with a 4 year old. The stovetop and washing machine worked well and fulfilled our needs. It is set in beautiful historic Sulaymeniye area with bustling student atmosphere and lots of food options. Mere minutes to Vezneciler and Laleli stations, making it a perfect base for exploring Istanbul. Mr Erhan kindly allowed us to stay longer until our evening flight. Would highly recommend!

Good apartment for a couple , but smaller bedroom is small for an adult. Golfer and Mustafa very helpful came and helped find a taxi etc . Apartment was clean and well equipped. Stairs up to apartment are quite steep and maybe not best if you have mobility issues . Good location

It was a truly amazing experience!
1. WiFi was perfect (50Mb+) and it was important for me because I had to work
2. Location was great! (5 mins walk to Suleymanie Mosque which is probably the most beautiful one in Istandbul). Grand Bazar was 10 mins walk, 20 mins to Ayasofia etc. Also 2 mins to Metro station helped a lot.
3. Amount of places to eat out nearby was descent with good food options.
4. The place was very clean and nice with all you need (washing machine, kitchenware etc.)
5. Host was amazing - easy check-in/check-out, responded in minutes whenever we needed something and didn't disturb us at all :)
The only issue we had (and it was not a surprise because it clearly says it's traditional wooden house) is noise from the street. Living in a wooden house - you can hear the noise around unfortunately. It was not a big problem for us but for people who want to have a calm stay - it's probably better to find something different and probably even move from Old City area (c'mon, you are in the city center - of course it will be noisy).
Thanks a lot for a truly great stay!

We loved our stay here! Super clean, wonderful host (who arranged a car to/ from the airport, gave local recommendations, and responded quickly to questions). Area is near the university, super walkable, near metro and light rail, and very safe. Back bedroom has air conditioning and is nice and quiet and comfortable. Wonderful place!

description: Spacious 3-bedroom duplex (160 m²) on the 2nd floor in the heart of the Old City. Just a short walk to Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, Grand Bazaar and the tram. Cozy living room, fully equipped kitchen, air conditioning in every room and fast unlimited Wi-Fi. Sleeps up to 8 guests. Markets and restaurants are nearby. Perfect for families and groups to relax after exploring Istanbul’s historic streets.

reviews.text:
Host available, helpful and kind, he replied very quickly. He organized an airport transfer at reasonable price.
The apartment was not in good condition. Many elements were broken such as the outside handle of a room, the handles of the kitchen cabinet, the broken shower glass which is stored inside the shower, mold in the corners of the bathroom, the bedroom ceilings…
There is a terrace, but it is dirty, nobody wants to stay there.
The apartment is ideally located in Fatih and it's only 10 minutes walk from the Sultan Ahmet Mosque, it's really walking distance to everything.
On the other hand, the streets are narrow and sloping, and down hills. If you are old people like us (68 on average), need to be very very sporty, otherwise…

I give this place 3 stars and it mostly goes to Hakki himself. He was a good host, very responsive and helpful whenever we needed help.
However the place and neighborhood were mediocre.
The alley that the building is located in is technically a one-way street, but because there wasn’t any one-way sign, cars could go either ways. You can imagine that it led to many honking and arguing every day.
With regard to the building, The toilet flush was weak, and the shower design was a bit stupid. The top head wasn’t working and you couldn’t close the door all the way through.
Unlike the pictures, 6 people could comfortably sit around the table not 8.
One of the bedrooms upstairs was super small that we couldn’t even fit our luggage there.
The stairs to the second level are dangerous , especially if you have kids.
The big clock on the wall wasn’t working and we had to buy dish soap, paper towel, laundry detergents and some necessities as they weren’t available.

Fantastic place and great host.
The appartment was clean. as described and walking distance to a lot of the touristic places.
Emir was extremely responsive, helpful and helped us to Book the airport transfer and good price.
Definitely a 5 Star place and host.
Thank you Emir and looking to book again in our next visit to Istanbul.
Note - we were a family of five and it was a great place for the family.

As an Air bnb owner myself and someone who uses Airbnb regularly, this was probably my worst booking. I chose it based on its walk ability sites but I didn’t realize that the area was not desirable. The apt smelled of cigarette smoke and was very noisy both from outside and inside the building. The water would not run on occasion and would slow to a trickle a lot. Hakka was an accommodating host and met us to help us carry our luggage up to the narrow spiral staircase up to the 3rd floor and came immediately when the Wi-Fi stopped working. It was very “bare bones” for amenities eg. bedding was lacking (our duvet on the queen bed barely covered the edge) , one pillow each.

We had a lovely stay here. The apartment was lovely and clean and a great location. Walkable distance to all the main spots and mosques and the cafes, restaurants and shops are 2 minute walk away which is so convenient. Everyone in the area was so friendly. The aircon worked amazingly and the rooms were big and clean. Bathroom more modern than the one showed in the picture, the lighting could have been better and thick towels could have been provided but host was super helpful and responsive to all our needs. Super friendly host and waited to greet us even though we were very late due to passport control and traffic. There was 5 of us altogether and we had more than enough space. Would only say that terrace could have been more clean and the stairs is probably not suitable for young children or older people. Can be a little noisy in the night but nothing crazy- i would recommend to others and i would stay here again! Honestly you won’t beat this location! Thank you for a lovely stay!

description:
This place is centrally located in the most famous area in Istanbul.
It has 2 bedrooms with double beds and one couch which turns into a double bed. You can book it for up to 6 people.

If I am being asked 100 times where would you live in Istanbul? I would definitely say Cihangir. Sure tastes differ. However, if you love browsing around and finding hidden gems such as; antique shops, dashing homey restaurants, pubs, tons of stores and art galleries this is your home.

reviews.text:
The good: The apartment is clean with great amenities and a comfy bed. It’s also in a quiet neighborhood that’s very central.
Things to consider before booking:
Noisy neighbors - The downstairs neighbor often listens to TV/music loudly during the day and night. (They’re a bit unstable: Sometimes, they scream violently.) Su (the host) asked them to quiet down several times and they did get much better, but they were still audible at times.
Some amenities & services are extra - Communication was sometimes hit-or-miss regarding responsiveness and transparency, and I was also disappointed with Su's management company’s fee policy. I stayed for 8 weeks and paid a high rental rate, but was only given one full roll of toilet paper and no laundry detergent for the duration of my stay. Drinking water is extra. Cleanings are extra and don’t include changing towels/sheets. (That’s an additional fee *on top* of the cleaning fee.) I was only informed about these fees after I booked my second cleaning. When I expressed my surprise, her reply was, “Why should I pay extra for you?” (Yet other Airbnbs in Istanbul I stayed at included towels/bedding in the cleaning fee.)
Be sure you ask what’s included/not included BEFORE you book so you’re not surprised.

We had an amazing stay for a week at Su’s apartment. It is in every bit as described on the site. Clean, calm and in a great location. The house itself has anything you might need for a great stay.
The flat is located in an amazing neighborhood. You are 5 minutes away by foot from Taksim square and M1 metro line or alternatively to one of the main tramway line in Istanbul giving you access to nearly anywhere you may want to visit from historical sites to the ferry or shopping centers. The neighborhood itself has some amazing restaurants and bars that are open until late in the morning. Therefore if you want to have an easy access to anywhere you may want and still be in a great neighborhood I definitely recommend Su’s place.
Su herself is an amazing host. She is helpful and very responsive. From before you arrive until you leave you can always reach her easily. She can also arrange a ride from the airport for you which I recommend and taking a taxi without knowing prices or Turkish!

Great location, 5-10 minute walk to anything you need (metro, grocery stores, restaurants, shops, ferries, etc) the only thing to keep in mind is it’s on a busy street so it can get pretty loud. A/C only worked in the living room so the bedrooms got hot at night even sleeping with the windows open. Overall it was a good value, I think you could find cheaper options in similar areas but it’s a beautiful clean place, easily accessible (only one flight of stairs), and in a convenient, safe location. The host was also very friendly and helpful!

I got in a bit late yet she was there and welcomed me very nicely.
We second thought as there was no reviews at the beginning yet it was worth the second thought. The experience was worth it. This place will be %100 popular very soon.
Everything was thought from all the aspects. The bed was relaxing and the pillows were so comfy.
There was a cozy spacious balcony in which you can have your coffee with your loved ones.
We were 2 people yet you can stay there for up to 4 people as the sofa in the living room can be turned into a double bed.
Kitchen was fully equipped. All the necessary things were there.
The curtains were double layered so your required light comes in and you can sleep like a baby with the second layers on.
The artwork in the bedroom was so cool and gave us a nice atmosphere.
You don’t need to climb up in the stairs in order to reach the house.
Netflix was a plus. And the internet was fast enough.
The dining table can be used as a desk. If you are working from home like me.
In total the house was so chic, cozy and certainly clean. Right after you get out the house there is a coffee shop round the corner and mins away from the restaurants, pubs etc.
Very close to the main coffee shops and attractions. Mins away from Istiklal Street/Taksim and public transportations.
We thank you Su. Our stay was genuinely one of the best. Hope that we can stay in your house some time soon.

It was a nice stay. The flat is pretty decorated, clean and well equipped. The living room area gave us the feeling of being in home. Terrace and windows were also nice to get an overview of the outside. The neighborhood is also very cozy and quiet (But expect some stairs). Su was very responsive. She ordered drinking water and offered airport service.
There were some minor issues that hopefully they will be fixed: the toilet flush is so slow to reload. The armchair was partly broken on its handle and the small bedroom door frame needs to be glued.

description:
I have 11 apartments where I can host my guests. If this apartment is not available on the dates you want, please check the other apartments in my profile. You can find all the reviews about me on my profile.

My apartment is within walking distance to Istiklal Street. Thus, bus, subway etc. located in Taksim Square. you can easily reach public transportation vehicles. It is also very close to Karaköy and Beşiktaş. You can shop from stores in the street and eat and drink in cafes and restaurants

reviews.text:
The place is clean and in a wonderful location. I thought I'd add my comments to some of the issues raised by others:
NOISE. Nothing that would wake you up at night. The apt is on the 1st floor (one flight up), and the streets are narrow, so you do hear when a car drives by. But I wasn't bothered at all.
KITCHEN. Only one pot, and the non-stick coating is coming off. I used it to heat up food in pouches but not to actually cook stuff in it. There's a few shallow frying pans, and those look OK.
BATHROOM. Yes, after one shower the bathroom is flooded. It might be an issue if you're sharing the apartment, but I wasn't.
Hosts were friendly and accommodating (early check-in, thanks!) and responded immediately when I asked for more laundry soap and a clothes hanger. I didn't mind buying a sponge and more toilet paper myself. I'm sure they would have brought me the stuff but I didn't feel like asking.
Bed was comfortable.
Overall It was a pleasant stay in a very vibrant neighbourhood.

We had a wonderful stay in this clean flat, which was in a great location and close to everything we needed. All our needs during these 14 days were well taken care of by the host and the apartment’s cleaning service. I would definitely recommend this place to everyone. I should just mention that the apartment is a little smaller than it looks in the photos.

Very warm, clean, and cozy place. It has all the essentials for a long stay: a comfortable big bed, Wi-Fi connection, kitchen, and washing machine. Great location and the host is very welcoming and helpful.

“Konumu çok iyi , mekanlara yürüyerek inebilirsiniz ama çıkmak için bayağı efor gerekli . her yer yokuş. Bölgede nostaljik bir hava var. Alışveriş,yeme içme ve market konusunda seçenek bol.Aracımızı koyabileceğimiz ücretli otoparklar vardı,sorun yaşamadık.Ulaşım konusunda sorun yaşamazsınız ,taksi bol ve toplu taşıma seçenekleriniz mevcut.Ev temiz,düzenli,yataklar rahat ve temiz.Ev hareketli bir bölgede gece cam açık uyunmaz.Ev sahibi iletişime açık ve yardımcı.Biz memnun kaldık ve istediğimiz her yere gidebildik.Tavsiye ediyoruz.

Amazingly amazing experience!!
Exactly same as pictures and few minutes walk to taksim and metro stations and above all everything is just few steps away from appartment i.e restaurants, cafes , grocery stores…
Oguz is super friendly and responsive host and helpful in every way … Appartment is exactly same as pics and very neat n clean appartment and it’s situated in very peaceful area …
Wonderful time spent in this Appartment👍👍👍👍Highly recommend to everyone 👍👍👍👍👍

description:
Wifi internet. Located in the heart of Istanbul. Right next to art galleries, museum, theater, concert halls and movie theaters located at Beyoğlu, the heart of Istanbul, awaits to welcome its new residents. Walking distance to places such as Nisantaşı, Taksim and Cihangir.

Have elevator and garage. New and high quality furniture. Good for couples. Has a city view, please check photos for details.

reviews.text:
The building is newly built and has elevator which is a considerable point in the old Istanbul. However the front of it was under the construction and my parents had a hard time passing it and entering the building.
In my opinion the most inconvenient point about this apartment is the neighborhood. Getting to the Istiklal street takes around 20 min walking through an uphill crowded street which I do not recommend it if you travel with elderly people. Taking taxi is another frustrating process and you may not find a taxi to take you to Istiklal/Taksim! Public transportation is also not that much convenient in this neighborhood.
The most positive point about this apartment is being new, clean, and classy. If you like walking long distances you will like this apartment.
The host (Duygo) was friendly and flexible during the checking out process.

We really liked the place. It's comfortable and located close to the center, at the same time the area is pretty quiet. You have everything you need in room and you can use gym and swimming pool in the building,
Nice apartment in a new building , ideal for executives, great internet speed, well equipped with you may need for a long stay.

Duygu hanıma teşekkürler çok hızlı cevaplar verdi
Evde temiz ve konforluydu
Cleanlinesa is very good

description: Everything you want to explore is right outside the door of this place.

reviews.text: The greatest thing about the place is it's location, it's in a walkable distance from a lot of things in the center. The place itself is on top of a restaurant which you have to go through in order to get to the apartment that's two floors above it. The apartment is quite small, a bedroom and a bathroom. It was fairly clean however we did find some things leftover from the previous guests is presume. There is no small refrigerator as shown in the photos, also the AC is there but it doesn't seem to do much other than to blow air. The bedroom is surrounded by windows from 3 sides that have courtains. Also the hair dryer in the bathroom doesn't work sometimes. WiFi is pretty bad in the sense that it often breaks up. The biggest problem with the place is that for the most of the time we didn't have warm water in the shower. All in all an ok place to stay for a shorter period of time if you don't mind a cold shower.

Great location with very friendly hosts and a nice restaurant just downstairs. This is a relatively new Airbnb and as such the owners are still working out the kinks. The wifi is kind of terrible -- it's fine in the downstairs restaurant, but very spotty in the upstairs apartment. During my stay the AC was having major problems (it would spit out ice and come to a grinding stop!), there was a persistent ant infestation, and the mini fridge was very loud. Instead of a fitted sheet for the mattress, the bed had only a flat sheet that was a bit too small for it so it would constantly come off the bed. For a few days I had only a hand towel because the bath towels were getting laundered. But the hosts were very kind and accommodating and did their best to address the issues they could address. And I believe they're continuing to work on this apartment, including replacing the AC with a newer model. This place will work for you if all you need is a simple and basic place that's affordable and in a great location.

Ismail was an excellent host. The hospitality received from Ismail and his staff made our short stay in Istanbul one to remember! Such a legendary group of people who went out of their way to make sure we were comfortable, had what we need and were more than happy to give us local recommendations and have a laugh.
The food in the restaurant was amazing and the location was In walking distance to all the sites and sounds of the city. The room was comfortable, clean and provided everything we needed. Great value at a very reasonable price. We hope to visit again!

İsmail was a Great Host. He friendly and helpful, and the staff as well.
The place was nice, comfort, and clean, same exactly like in the picture. Great services and hospitality.
And he own the restaurant below the apartment, it The Ottaman's Kitchen Restaurant, you guys must try the Turkish cuisine there, all the food i was try taste so delicious.
I will go back, when i visit Istanbul later.
Thank you Ismail for your Great Hospitality.

SO grateful for the Turkish hospitality we experienced here!!!! After reading other reviews we went with realistic expectations and were not disappointed! Super, super location!!! Close to so many sites - Blue Mosque, Aya Sophia, Grand Bazaar, coastline and restaurants - right in the heart of the old city (therefore recognize you are choosing a busy area, later street noise, being invited in to each restaurant you walk by). Historic building!!! Beautiful stone walls, windows that open wide to the street, updated bedroom/bathroom and comfortable bed (you are choosing an older building with narrow stairs, no elevator, little soundproofing to street, difficult internet in area (Airbnb wifi was strong), and tricky hot water that Ismail is working on). The meals at Ottoman’s Kitchen were delicious and you should definitely eat here!! 100% it was being treated like family by the Ottoman’s hospitality that made this stay such a pleasure!! We cannot recommend it highly enough!!!!

description: Welcome to our charming garden duplex in the heart of Istanbul. With 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, a comfortable living area, fully equipped kitchen and private garden, the apartment comfortably accommodates up to 6 guests. Its central location makes exploring Istanbul easy, while the private garden offers a peaceful place to relax and unwind after a day in the city.

reviews.text:
Gokhan's apartment is an excellent choice to spend some days while visiting amazing Istanbul:
.clean, wonderful bathroom with convenient shower, and many other comfortable highlights.
.centrally located (supermarkets, restaurants, convenience stores)
.near subway
It's a very quiet basement with a lot of light coming in, two floors down with working elevator great for suitcases and shopping.
The patio is wonderful and so appreciated.
Gorkhan is a responsible and attentive host, who contacted us in advance and gave us a complete list of places to eat around the apartment and answered many questions.
Considering that many Airbnb places in Istanbul are walk ups without elevator and/or don't have hot water, this is a very nice place.
Highly recommended.
