I have had several experiences with Airbnb and this one was by far one of the worst compare to the others.
Here I note the reasons.
1- Before I book the property, I asked the owner if we can check in in the morning and he said it is fine. On the day of arrival, he texted me 8:00 AM in the morning and said the check in is postponed to 3:00 PM! Which is not acceptable.
2- When we got there we were a little bit surprised, because pictures were way more better than the reality.
3- The toilet floor was dirty when we got the house. And also the shower was not clean the way we expected.
4- The fan in the toilet was making a horrible noise when we turn the lights on so we had to go to the toilet with lights off because of the noise during the night.
5- There was a disgusting smell in the toilet (since the fan was not working properly) so we had to open the toilet's door so that smell goes away.
6- The apartment is 2 level under the ground with elevator not working at all.
I hope it helps.

We spent a week in this apartment, and it felt less like a holiday and more like survival training.
The host insisted on another for all communication — because apparently Airbnb messaging is just too mainstream. Check-in was a treasure hunt for codes, and when we preferred to stay on Airbnb, his answer was basically: “Well, that’s your problem.”
The apartment itself? The photos promised style; reality delivered a plot twist:
• Cleaning? Let’s call it creative. Dust, hair, and a toilet that had souvenirs from previous guests.
• Bedroom: fine, except the TV remote had no batteries and the TV was locked like Fort Knox.
• Living room: damp walls, broken terrace lock, and a TV that eventually died of despair.
• Kitchen: two teaspoons, four mugs, and a dishwasher. Minimalism, redefined.
• Terrace: a dusty table and a bold bird-art exhibition on chairs and tiles. Clearly curated over months.
• Grill: so filthy the host suggested we “just use it.” We spent our own time cleaning it —

We recently had the pleasure of staying at Gokhan’s flat that exceeded all our expectations. From the moment we arrived until the day we left, every aspect of our stay was fantastic.
The host was incredibly welcoming and attentive. He went above and beyond to ensure that we had a comfortable and enjoyable stay. His communication was impeccable, responding promptly to any questions we had and providing detailed instructions for check-in and check-out. The accommodation itself was outstanding. The listing accurately represented the space, and it was even better in person. The kitchen was fully equipped with good appliances. The cozy living area was perfect for relaxation.
The location of the flat was superb. Situated in a safe and vibrant neighborhood, it was within walking distance of Tram, shops, and restaurants. The host also provided excellent recommendations for local hotspots, ensuring that we experienced the best the best the area had to offer. Thank you.

Ghokan is a wonderful host, and his apartment is an opportunity to get an authentic local experience in the magical city of Istanbul. The apartment is a 35-minute walk from the tourist center's hustle and bustle (and prices). You will find everything you need from supermarkets, shops, hairdressers, restaurants, and clubs to discover and enjoy Turkish life here. The apartment is spacious, well-equipped, and a peaceful homestead from the hectic pace of the capital. Good Wifi, Netflix, and speakers for rainy days/remote work. Particularly suitable for long-term stays. Ghokhan was a considerate, helpful, and super-communicative host. The cleaning service was excellent. Thank you and hope to see you again!

description:
Our house in Beşiktaş Abasağa Park is very central. It is a 5-minute walk to the bazaar and a 10-minute walk to the ferry station.
It is a fully furnished 1+1 apartment with a balcony.
Detailed cleaning service is provided after each guest.
Our house in Beşiktaş Abbasağa Park is quite central. It is 10 minutes walking distance to the beach and the market.
Our house is 1+1, fully furnished and has a balcony.

reviews.text:
Good value for money in a quiet nieghbourhood at the top of the hill beside a nice park.
Only issues were the shower (no holder for the shower head, and no shower curtain) which the hostel maybe will solve. And the TV (was broken at the time and the host said he would replace but never did and just ignored me when i followed up about it). Regardless of these issues it's still 5 stars because the value for money was still very good.

Unfortunately, the apartment did not meet our expectations. It is in poor condition and clearly in need of renovation. The bathroom, in particular, was in very bad shape, with a significant amount of mold. The mirror was damaged and appeared to be held together with tape. The kettle was extremely dirty, and we found hair and pet fur throughout the apartment.
Despite the booking being for four people, bedding was only prepared for two, and the rest of the linens provided were not clean. There were only three pillows available in total.
I would not recommend staying here until the host makes the necessary repairs and improvements to bring the apartment up to an acceptable standard.
As described, nice communication and everything as expected
fiyat performans acısından tarminkar konum ve ev sahibinin ilgi ve alakası çok iyi olduğu için ikinci kez tercih ettim tesekkürler
fiyat performans harika beklentisi yüksek bu ev semte gelmesin. ev süper ev sahibi harika tekrar tercih ettim. buranın otel olmadıgını anlayıp ev diye gelirseniz hiç pişman olmazsınız can insanlar ♥️

description: I do need to say that you are looking into Galata which is one of the best oldest neighborhoods of Istanbul, and important cultural center for local people and foreigners that located at the North of the Golden Horn, towards Taksim Squere that

reviews.text:
Just because the owner insisted that I leave a review, I do it. I didn't want to lower his rating since I only leave honest reviews.
The loft would have been perfect if it weren't for the dirt. The location and communication with the host were excellent. BUT, it's dirty and smells bad. Garbage at the entrance, unwashed floors, spilled water, and a messy bathroom. The bed linen and towels were dirty, smelly, and damp. My wife and her friends had to clean the bathtub and use their own bedding. The untidiness overshadowed the good location and worn-out furniture.
They had also agreed in advance to stay at his place for an additional day, but since the host did not have a reservation for only one night in the system, we agreed to pay cash for the extra night
But when the time came, he ditched us, saying that he forgot about it. He found some other flat but it wasn't worth it. So I had to go out on a limb to find an apartment for the girls when there was almost no time to do it.

This was my very first experience with Airbnb and it was really a pleasure to stay in Ersan's lift for three days.
It is verr good located where you could avoid the tourists' noise from the sultanahmet district during the night and it's also way too comvenient to get to that district cause it's just five minutes walk from the Galata bridge in the new europe part side.
The loft is well designed, simple but cool, and there's some smart design which you really have to experience it yourself. I'll tell you that the picture is exactly what the loft really is so you could trust the picture if you are into Ersan's loft.
Ersan is a friendly and trusted host even we just met one time at our arrival. He waited us there till midnight and still warm to welcome us. He even checked if everything's alright by SMS during our visit which is lovly and appreciated.
Ben..I'd absolutely recommend Ersan's loft for everyone cause you all deserve a great stay in Istanbul.

Ersan was a great host, the check-in/-out went smoothly and during our stay he offered advice where to eat and nice places to visit. The location is in a touristy area, but on a side street not frequented by many people. Be prepared to walk up & down a lot. Ersan's apartment is exactly as described and has a lot of personality. Balcony has no roof, but dries quickly (under August's sun). There is a lot of turkish food to be found around, many Kebap places. We found that best food is located in smaller shops away from busy areas, such as Dürüm in a corner between Grand Bazar and Nuruosmaniye Mosque. It's about 10-20 minutes to a ferry and 30 minutes to reach the nice seaside promenade at Kadikoy. Avoid restaurants under Galata Bridge. ;) Recommended, we'd definitely like to come back to Ersan's loft.

Very nice host, thinks with you and helps. For the price it’s very worth it, it’s near Galata and Ersan is a nice host to think with you and let us check out later, got us a cheap taxi and always answers your questions. Thank you Ersan! The place is also in a quiet area and the bed is soft. Greetings Laila.

I arrived quite late to the property and Ersan was happy to meet for Check-in.
The airbnb is exactly as described and Ersan was always available to help with anything.
The location is very nice as not too far from touristy areas but also offers local areas to discover turkey better.

description:
Enjoy that “I’m home” feeling with this luxury apartment

★Central Location + Free Parking + Smart TV + Netflix + Free WIFI + Air Conditions + Fully-Equipped Kitchen and Bathrooms★

More than a home...

The flat is just walking distance from public transportation ( metro, bus stops, metrobus and others). You’ll find a great variety of restaurants, cafes, and shops near by your home.

reviews.text:
Finding a reasonably priced place for a family of six in Istanbul isn’t easy, but Yildirim’s place had everything we needed. The apartment is in a modern building with a lift and parking, with three bedrooms that comfortably sleep six people, two bathrooms, a spacious living room, and a well-equipped kitchen. You also have access to the gym, which is a nice bonus. There are also several grocery shops, bakeries, and other useful amenities nearby.
Yildirim was a very kind and helpful host. We had an issue with one of the fuses during our stay, and he quickly arranged for an electrician to come and fix it on the same day. We had a very comfortable stay and would happily recommend the place.

The home's location is good (But not luxury), and the flat has a beautiful view of the street during the day and nights. Shopping is close by in minutes and less. Apartment is secure with the lobby's guard man and cameras as well.
Although the house had some missing stuff (especially in the kitchen) and some minor issues that may be related to new building's built, we enjoyed our stay and Yildrim's home would be one of our serious options for the next travels to Istanbul. The reason is that Yildrim was always available, honest and helpful even for the topics that were not related to his rental. It was important to us that he always was trying to do his best and never hide or exaggerate anything!
I selected 5 stars for Yildrim and I recommend him and his place to everyone who looks for a family place. Yildrim is a nice and honest person and his flat is brand new and clean.
We stayed for almost 16 nights in the Yildrim's rental and at the end we were happy with our selection between many Airbnb homes and owners in Istanbul.

Yildirim's place was perfect for my family and I. The appartement was spacious and clean. Beautiful views in every room. The parking lot was great for us to leave our car, and we had direct access to the highway. Highly recommend this location if you are coming as a larger group!

Very good value for money.
Clean, spacious, and comfortable place.
The host, Yildirim, was very accomodative. Our flight was in the night, and we requested a late checkout to which he readily agreed without any extra charge.

Spacious clean apartment in a good location, in a modern building. Many shops and small restaurants close to the building. Perfect check-in and check-out, perfect communication with the host. Thank you, Yildirim.

description: This private place is a 5-minute walk from the metro station and makes it easy to plan your trip.

reviews.text:
We stayed there for 13 days. upon arrival Unal was welcoming and helped us get to the room. place was clean. the only issues we had was there was no shampoo, toilet paper or water upon arrival close to midnight so we had to spend dollars to get what we needed for the night. it was cold inside so it took a day for it to warm up, make sure to ask to turn in the heater or AC a day before your arrival to have a more pleasant first night/day.shower hose had a hole in it and he replaced it the next day. its very close to lots of shopping stores, restaurants,and just walking in public.Unal the guy in charge was always around and ready to help. host was always responsive. nice street view to keep you busy all day. internet was fast.building was always clean and smelled like cologne.
i will stay there again and would recommend it to anyone.except few small issue which can be solved prior to your stay.
Thank you Erkan.

we had this apartment for two weeks we had to pay $200 cash deposit which was never returned to us as they accused us of breaking a bed base which was not us! furthermore they knocked at our door at 1130pm woke up our baby and others sleeping to investigate wether we should get our deposit.
the pictures look like a 5 star luxury but really this is a 3 star apartment and block of flats.
everything in the flat is very old or faulty ie shower water doesn’t go down well and water all gathers underneath you.
washing machine doesn’t always spin you have to keep repeating cycles.
our tap in the bathroom was broken (upon arrival) and for three days and every day we kept getting told Tommorow tommorow.
both bedrooms are very small every time you get out of bed you hit your feet on the wardrobe legs about a foot long away from the bed
This apartment is not worth the price at all.
I will never book a place again with not more than 50 reviews as many things can go wrong.

Everything was super.
The apartment is like photos.
Erkan is a super host.
Ünal the guy who is working in the building is very helpful.
Go ahead and book it!
Erkan and his staff were very friendly understanding and helpful and the place was comfortable and very suitable for our family
Great Apartment, and super clean.

description: Central, new, stylish studio flat close to Taksim Square and Nisantasi

reviews.text:
Honestly for this price I couldn’t have asked for anything better than this cozy and clean place! Close to bus station, very clean, nice toilet service & shower. Could be an amazing place to study or work on your laptop or something. Close to two coffeeshops, 1 hookah lounge, some banks, Starbucks in 7 mins by walk and more, not the closest to Taksim but like 10 mins with a cab!
Ps. Adnan is a very cool and warm dude and helped me with my early check-in request as well!

I stayed here for the second time and once again, I was very satisfied. It is very close to Taksim metro station, the neighborhood is very pleasant, and in the apartment you can find everything you need in a clean and comfortable atmospher. Host is very kind and responds quickly.

The studio is in a great location, very close walking distance to Taksim. It's on the ground floor, so no problem with carrying luggage. Communication with Adnan was very smooth, we also checked in early, which was convenient. The price is very good.
The downside is that the street the flat is on, despite it being a side street, was extremely noisy duirng both nights, with people fighting, screaming, repairing cars etc. Since there's no aircon, there's a trade off between open windows and noise and closed windows and heat.
All in all, i would recommend the flat, just bear in mind the noise in case you are a light sleeper :)

Good location, well cleaned and suitable place for two people. The AC is great in summer, and the balcony door allows fresh air. They are friendly and allow for easy self check ins. Definitely recommend if you like to be close to Taksim. Has many small stores for groceries nearby as well.

The apartment is located in a very good spot. There is two parks in walkable reach and numerous restaurants and stores. Despite that flat is on the first floor, I haven't experienced any troubles with noise.
The kitchen is equipped with everything to make a good meal. The apartment is small but cozy. The internet connection is good. You can use washing and drying machine in common space on -2 floor.
The owner is very accessible. Response time is very fast. Overall it was a great experience.

description:
Welcome to my childhood home since the 1980's. Newly renovated as of 2022 with all modern appliances. If you are looking for an authentic Istanbul experience, away from the hustle-and-bustle of the Old City & European side, our home on the Asian Side in the charming Çengelkoy neighborhood is just for you!

2 floors which can be separated into a private Duplex. 8 minute walking distance to the main boulevard of Shops, Restaurants, Markets & the magical Bosphorus Sea.

reviews.text: This property is so quaint with multi levels which was nice for my family to have their own space. The kitchen, bedrooms and bathrooms were all well equipped and so clean! There's a great outdoor dining area for a BBQ which was fantastic to grill up the fresh seafood and lamb we got locally. The seafood restaurant and butcher was walking distance in the small town that's located right on the water! The Owner/Manager was extremely helpful, informative and responsive. I enjoyed my stay at this property and the area so much, my family and I fell in love with Turkey even more! Can't wait to stay here again - I would highly recommend!!

Everything was exactly as described in the listing—clean, comfortable, and well-appointed. The host was incredibly responsive and communicative, making the check-in process smooth and stress-free. The location was perfect, offering easy access to local attractions and amenities.

Staying at Jacki & Seyit’s place made our visit very comfortable. The house has the old Istanbul feeling along with 21st century luxuries. Strongly recommended to everyone who wishes to experience a bit of history but not sacrifice from things like air conditioning : )
The location is very convenient to access amazing boat rides, Cengelkoy, Bebek, Besiktas and many other sites Istanbul has to offer.
Jacki has been super accessible and helpful during our stay. Our interactions with her made me feel we were understood. She took all the necessary steps to communicate with us in a professional and helpful way.

We had a wonderful stay at this beautiful historic home in Çengelköy. We were a multigenerational family with two guests in their 80s and a 2-year-old, and the house worked very well for us.
The host welcomed us personally and brought fresh fruit. The home was spacious, very clean, and exceptionally well stocked with essentials, towels, bottled water, shampoo, baby shampoo, and snacks. The patio was fantastic for our toddler. The main floor was also convenient for our older guests, with only a few steps from the entrance.
The location was one of our favorite parts. About a 7-minute walk to the ferry and 4 minutes to bus stops, Çengelköy feels authentic, peaceful, family-friendly, and much less touristy than central Istanbul, with plenty of shops nearby.
Our only significant issue was the dishwasher, which was broken and apparently had been for some time. This wasn't communicated before arrival, and washing dishes for a large family was inconvenient.
Overall, we really enjoyed our stay.

We had a wonderful stay with Jacki and Can. They were incredibly kind, welcoming, and responsive throughout our visit. Communication was excellent from the moment we booked until check-out.
The property was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. We especially appreciated their hospitality, attention to detail, and willingness to help whenever we had a question.
Our family truly enjoyed the stay, and they made us feel at home. We would happily stay here again on a future visit to Istanbul and highly recommend this place to other travelers.
Thank you, Jacki and Can, for making our stay such a pleasant experience!

description:
Very comfortable flat for one or two person. You can go everywhere in Kadıköy or access all of the transportation by walking. The area is very chilly and quiet.

You have the apartment all to yourself and It’s because I live in the apartment in general you can expect some of my stuff around but don’t worry you’ll have your space for your clothes etc.

You can reach me for any questions anytime.

reviews.text: Demir was an amazing host, always helped out whenever i needed anything and gave amazing suggestions. The apartment was perfect, such a beautiful location thats close to all public transport stations and in a very good area. Very comfortable and well organized living room and a very clean kitchen, bedroom and bathroom. I will definetly be staying here again whenever I am in Istanbul!

Demir’s place is a real home, very comfortable even for extended stays.
It’s a well-designed, cozy, and clean apartment. You have everything needed - even two coffee gadgets so you can have the coffee you like 😅
The location is perfect - near the seaside, parks, and all the cafes and bars, but on a quiet street.
Demir is a great and careful host, always in touch and ready to help ❤️

The apartment is very comfortable and Demir Cem was super responsive and helpful in recommendations and instructions for checking in. Great location for Moda — very quiet area but a quick walk to lots of great cafes, restaurants and shops.

Demir’s apartment is definitely a gem! It’s located in one of the most beautiful neighbourhoods in Istanbul. It is very close to the sea—you can go for a run or walk by the sea while watching the sun set over the European continent— and there are many cafes and restaurants nearby that you can try. As a person who stayed at countless airbnbs in Istanbul over many years, I can say that the apartment is the best value for the price. It is new, modern, and it has everything that you need for a long term stay.
And Demir is definitely the best host ever! He was extremely helpful and accommodating throughout my stay.
Great place, clean, comfortable, new. Great value for the price!

description:
We're now offering a highly discounted price for stays of 100 days or more; perfect for longterm travelers, remote workers or guests looking to settle in for a while! For questions & clarification contact the host directly via MESSAGES to discuss availability.

BELLA HOME is a spacious flat with modern interiors that lets you live like a true local in an old historic Beyoglu neighbourhood of Istanbul. Located within 5 to 15 minute walking distance to Taksim Square, Istiklal Street, Galata Tower!

reviews.text:
First of all I would like to thank the host Dilan for her friendly welcome and support. She was following up with me to come exactly at the apartment and when I arrived she welcomed me and all my family. Also the flush was not working so she didn't leave until she fixed it and this thing is rarely to find from the host, so thanks a lot. The apartment was very nice, and it was exactly as described. Everything was lovely, and the decoration was superb. The furniture was all brand new. If you want a large apartment with a large bedroom, I recommend this one. It was close to Taqsim and public bus to go every where. Also near to good restaurants and Starbucks. Most around groceries open after 12 am and at very local price not expensive. On Sunday, there is a local bazaar just in the front of the apartment which is very nice and I enjoyed this moment having the grocery and other things from this bazaar.
There were a few things I didn't like about my stay, and they are as follows:
1. There were no air conditioners, and the weather was so hot during my stay that I couldn't sleep many nights. It should have at least provided a fan so that one could stay during the hot weather.
2. The location is on a very strong up incline hill and is not suitable for families, necessitating the use of a taxi at all times.
3. The apartment has one window that can be opened to get some fresh air from outside, but the other windows have an unclean around and may allow flys to enter the house.
4. The apartment's entry was dirty during my stay, and some wood was blocking my door, making it unsafe for my family.
5. The building was noisy during the day because there were many labors working to fix the apartment.
6. Because the neighborhood is very old and poor, walking around may be dangerous.

Dilan is a great host, proactive and friendly.
The neighbourhood is close to everything but is in an inner city area, which might feel a bit daunting at first, but it quickly grows on you once you open up to the lovely neighbors and local community. It might look a bit dirty but it is safe. In fact, there s even a police station on that street.
The building lacks a bit of maintenance, it is clean except when male cats go inside and mark their territory… but it is cleaned up regularly. It is located on a steep street, sharp slope/incline. But I personally enjoyed the workout.
The apartment is fine, might feel cold but the heater works very well. There’s little light, but that’s mainly because it is located on the first floor.
You can find in there all necessities except kitchen appliances (no oven, no microwave, no toaster, and a gas stove complicated to use). But that’s fine if you’re planning on eating outside all the time.
I would go back there ;)

Dilan was an amazing host, very helpful and always responded to our inquiries.
The apartment is cozy and clean as the it looks on the photos ..
location wise it’s pretty close to everything there’s few small grocery stores within a walking distance..
Only thing to consider is that the apartment is stated in an uphill so it might be difficult to walk for people with children or elderlies because it’s a bit of a steep hill
Other than that the stay was perfect for us

The best host ever in My life!!
The house is so nice and clean
recommendation of places!
comfortable beds! nice Shower room
near by main tourist street like 10mins away
and located in local places, so quite calm and silent place
Definitely i would choose this place again when i come back

Dilan was nice and flexible as a host. She let us check in earlier and check out later than usual. She was checking on us regularly and gave local recommendations.
The location of the place was fine, but as soon as you step in the neighborhood you get disappointed as it is very dirty. The bigger disappointment though is when you step in the building, the door doesn’t fully open, it smells like pee and the flat is dark (the photos are manipulated and brighten up!).
Your feet would get black and very dirty when you walk barefoot and there are live and dead cockroaches everywhere.
The bathroom was full of black mould and disgusting. I wrote Dilan about the issue, she claimed that they tried to get off, but couldn’t. This definitely didn’t seem to be true.
We were bitten by some bugs during night.
The fan and was also broken and was very noisy.
There were not enough shampoo and toilet paper for 4 people for 1 week, so we bought extra.
All in all, never again!

description:
This is a cozy private room with bathroom, located in the quiet part of Sultanahmet area. You can easily reach the main square within 5-6 mins on foot, and have the chance to visit all the major attractions of the Old City.
we have a 24/7 front desk agent to assist you with anything you might need.
there is a airport shuttle bus (HAVAIST) stop is only 100meters away from the hotel.
Istanbul Airport to Sultanahmet and return .
This is the easy way from IST airport to Sultanahmet.

reviews.text: The room was clean and exactly as described. It was easy to check in and I got good information when I booked it. The location is really nice. It's a quiet neighborhood but at the same time you have a short walk to Sultanhmet where you could see Hagia Sofia and the Blue mosque. Would definitely recommend this place.

The accommodation did not meet my expectations, and I decided to leave and book another place the same night.
The check-in experience was not very welcoming. I was accompanied by a friend who speaks Turkish and was only assisting with communication. Although it was clearly explained that he would not stay overnight, the staff contacted us several times within a short period and later came to the room to ask him to leave, which made the situation uncomfortable.
The room was very small with limited space for luggage. I noticed human hairs on the bed and pillows, raising concerns about cleanliness. The lighting was insufficient, and only one bedsheet was provided, which appeared old and was kept in the closet. In the bathroom, only two towels were available, one of which appeared worn. The heating was not working, and the room was cold.
After staying for about one hour, I left to find alternative accommodation. Despite this, more than half of the booking amount was charged.

Nice hotel in quiet area, very close to main attractions as blue mosque or grand bazaar etc.
Friendly staff, room was big, cleaned everyday and air condition+room fridge as standard.
Would recommend for everyone who look for cheap and well located place to stay in istanbul !

beklentimin üstündeydi rahat temiz güvenli sezsiz tam trüstlik merkezin göbeğinde ve fiyatta çok uygun yatak çarşaflar banyo tertemiz
ayasofya. sultanahmet cami. yeraltı sarnıcı. sultanahmet meydanı. topkapı sarayı. 50 metre yakınında
Ben rahat ettim. İyi uyudum. Her yere yakın, sakin, temiz ve hesaplı bir yerdi. Fiyat performans açısından oldukça iyi olduğunu düşündüm. Teşekkürler.

description:
Set in the heart of Istanbul, Diamond places you steps from Istiklal Street and Taksim Square yet the moment you step inside, the city fades away.

Rise above it all on your private rooftop terrace, where Istanbul's skyline becomes yours alone.

This 3-bedroom duplex is designed for those who appreciate the finer things: Smart TV, Nespresso, lift, and high-speed Wi-Fi.

The preferred address for film productions, corporate stays, and travellers who travel with taste.

reviews.text:
One of the best apartments I have ever stayed in. Everything was exactly as described — clean, comfortable, and very well maintained. The location was excellent, and the overall experience exceeded our expectations.
A special thanks to the staff — they were extremely professional, responsive, and helpful throughout our stay. Their support made everything smooth and stress-free.
Highly recommended without hesitation.
Just a small note: if you are renting a car, there is an independent paid parking area directly in front of the apartment. It costs around 1200 TL for 12–24 hours.
Would definitely stay here again!

Cihan is an excellent and very kind host. We had one issue during our stay, and he resolved it overnight, which was greatly appreciated.
The apartment is very nice, and we had a very comfortable stay throughout.
The location couldn’t be better — Taksim Square is very close, and if you enjoy walking, you’re only a short stroll from many great areas. The Old Town is also just around 15–20 minutes away on foot.

Wonderful Stay!
This Airbnb was fantastic! Clean, cozy, and well-equipped. The host was welcoming and responsive. Perfect location—quiet but close to everything. Highly recommend!
The apartment is old and needs maintenance. The sofa is uncomfortable, the cleanliness is poor, there was a stain on the bed, and an electrical short circuit occurred in the bathroom.

Great location a stone throw away from Taksim square. Lots of restaurants in the neighborhood. The host provides recommendations for the restaurants. We tried two breakfast recommendations which were outstanding

description: Enjoy a simple and comfortable stay in this quiet, centrally located place. A small room in the textile center of the world, two stops from the subway, five from Nişantaşı, one from Taksim. A small room in an ideal location for those coming for business or shopping, cultural trips. 24-hour hot water and wifi. The kitchen, living room and other areas are not shared, only the room is available. Please do not insist on changing the rules. It has an electronic key and there is a janitor living in the basement, a safe building.

reviews.text: My stay at Hakan's Airbnb in Osmanbey was an absolute delight. He was incredibly friendly and helpful, even offering to wash my clothes. The location was fantastic, with easy access to transportation and nearby shopping markets. The room itself was comfortable, with a lovely large window. However, the lack of an elevator on the 5th floor was a challenge, and the smoking policy allowed for a pervasive smell in the apartment. Despite these minor issues, Hakan's hospitality and the fantastic location made the stay enjoyable. I would highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone visiting Osmanbey.

I feel like being at home! Hakan is a very kind person, I like his introduction to me & and his tips about what should I do here and visit. He is a very helpful and kind man, and he speaks English very well.
The location as described and very near to metro. So it’s worth every penny!
If I will back soon to turkey. 100% i will stay here again.

The best place to accommodate while you're having a trip. The location is really good and convinient. The host is quite friendly, kind, hospitable, caring, trustable, and talkative. The room is clean and comfortable. I'd definitely consider booking this room again.

Great men Hakan, best host that I met in Turkey. Very good location, close to markets, close to Taksim. Recommended to smokers. A very clean building and flat. Room is quiet. Bed was good. Nice to stay there, I will come back with pleasure if I will be on Istanbul

Hakan abim dünyalar tatlısı bir insan çok misafirperver . Evin konumu harika her yere sıkıntı çekmeden çok rahat bir şekilde gidebildim . Evin iç dizaynı ise harika nostaljik bir atmosferi var ve temizlik konusunda kusursuz bir daha istanbula gelecek olursam ilk işim hakan abiye yazmam olacak :)

description: A truly unique and extraordinary two floor loft style apartment featuring a private entrance, your own patio and an open gallery between the upper and lower living areas. This home boasts antique reclaimed internal stone stairs connecting the two levels and is full of charm and history. Original stone walls dating from the mid-1800's are found in the main bedroom as well as in the "hammam" style bathroom, something not to miss along with the open fire place well located in the TV cozy room.

reviews.text:
Safety
Perfection. We never felt unsafe day or night. The windows also have bars / grills.
Communication
Aaron is so awesome at communication. We had many questions before our stay and then we needed to extend our stay. Aaron accommodated us so well, thank you!
Comfort
The apartment bedroom, kitchen and living space is upstairs and the master bathroom with tv and a second living/library space is downstairs. There is a small half-bathroom next to the bedroom.
Kitchen & Food Needs
The kitchen has utensils for any chef. Aaron has a french press, coffee brewing machine, and electric kettle. If you don't want to bother, there is an AWESOME convenience store a few mins away.
Bed
There is netting around the bed, which keeps any insects out. The bed is super comfy.
Location
This location is perfect. The Galata tower and Istiklal Caddesi / Taksim area is 10 mins away. Easy downhill / uphill walk to tram/bus.
Cleaning
The apartment was overall clean.

This is the coolest place I have ever stayed. If this is what I could live in all the time, I would. The care that went into this renovation is readily apparent. It was extremely comfortable and was a welcome respite at the end of each tourist day. The location was exactly what we needed; close to everything. The walking in this area is not for the faint of heart...hills galore! But if you know that, this place is right in the heart of it all. The bed is extremely comfortable, which is something important to my bad back. Internet is top notch which is unfortunately required for working away from home. And the apartment was as described, extremely clean and provided everything we needed. I would whole heartedly stay here again!!

Perfection. The space itself is stunning: pristine, well decorated, comfortable and spacious (even larger than the photos portray). The bathroom is incredible and the kitchen is perfect and well stocked if you like to cook. Probably the most beautiful space I have ever stayed in. The neighborhood is fantastic, full of vintage shops, cafes, and fantastic restaurants. It’s also a 10 minute walk from both the tram and a beautiful hammam.
Aaron was super responsive and helpful, he provided clear instructions/directions for check in, recommendations for restaurants/things to do, and checked in regularly. His colleague, Alaattin, met us for check in and was so kind. He also helped arrange a taxi for us to the airport.
We can’t wait to return, both for the space and the hospitality. 10/10. Stay here!!

The flat is quirky ( e.g. master bedroom and master bathroom/shower/tub) are on different levels, but fun and comfortable. Beautifully furnished and lit. Clean. Great variety of materials....wood, stone, brick and glass. Private internal courtyard. Can hardly be better located. Fantastic part of town. Easy to find, close to Istiklal Caddesi, Galata Tower, Bosphorus. Wonderful shopping nearby and a zillion restaurants. Owner Aaron is very very responsive and proactively helpful, and building caretaker Alaattin is fantastic.

Wow, what a place!!! Truly one of my favorite Airbnb stays EVER.
Location- PERFECT. 5 min walk to Galata Tower. Close enough to touristy things that you will get to explore what you want to see in Istanbul, but still in a very local and authentic neighborhood. Tons of quirky antique stores and great restaurants nearby. 2 markets within a 5 minute walk. 5-7 min walk to tram station where you can take a quick tram for less than $1 over to Sultanahmet
The Airbnb- PERFECT. The host, Aaron, lived here himself for 5 years and you can tell- the home has absolutely everything you could ever need to be comfortable. We stayed for a week and would have extended if it had been available! Wifi worked great. Washing machine worked great. Smart TV was perfect for streaming Netflix on chill nights.
The host- Aaron was amazing. He met us at the home and made sure everything was perfect. He was incredibly responsive and accommodating. He offered local recommendations and was just great!!

description: Welcome! Get ready to experience a holiday in this magnificent accommodation where luxury and comfort converge. This stunning accommodation unit is perfect for large groups and families, offering spacious and comfortable 5 bedrooms that can accommodate up to 11 adult guests. Situated in a central location, this accommodation unit provides easy access to the city's main tourist hubs. The rooms feature a modern and stylish design, ensuring your comfort and convenience are prioritized.

reviews.text:
We stayed at this place for first 12 days of October for a family reunion and had a fantastic experience. If I could give it over 5 stars, I would.
First of all, Hakan was one of the kindest human beings you could meet. His lovely family was helping at times as well with his daughter when present to do some translation. He was very helpful and accommodating on our requests and always available. He always has a smile on his face with his phone along using G00gle Translate to communicate very effectively. Communication was not a problem.
Hakan and family live on the first 2 levels completely isolated with its own entrance through the yard. The rental unit is completely separated with its own entrance at the street level. Some notes about the place:
- It is a newly built unit and very well furnished. Clean and comes with all of the amenities.
- It is away from the pollution of the city and in a tranquil area. It is a plus. Very accessible and not a touristy area. You will find the true Turkish hospitality (from interacting with local merchants) and way of life.
- Nestled in the forest hills overlooking Bosphorus Strait. Beautiful unobstructed view of forested hills around and waterway with lit bridges across the waterway. Perfect for morning coffee and late night tea or your favorite sip!
- Plenty of room: a huge bedroom with 4 single beds, its own ½ bathroom perfect for family with kids, 2 other bedrooms with 2 single beds each, 1 bedroom with a double bed.
- 2 bathrooms with showers in the common areas, an office with large desk (2 of the rooms also have desks), a laundry/utility room
- Large open living room, dinning and kitchen area. Full kitchen with all of the required appliances including dishwasher. There is cloth washer and dryer.
-Large balcony on the side of the house with gorgeous views. On the balcony, there is a long table for 10 people (using all of the chairs) for any of the meals. We were lucky with the weather to enjoy outside dining. There is also a small table with 2 chairs for relaxing and having coffee/tea while enjoying the view.
- 10-15 minutes walk to HACIOSMAN (pronounced Haji Osman) terminal (the last station on the green line). The green line takes you to all of the Istanbul major attractions at the fastest time (avoiding traffic when you take the taxi). I have bad knees so sometimes I took the taxi to the terminal using BiTaxi app for less than $2. With Istanbul Card ($3), you will pay about $0.40 per trip on the metro. Very cheap and convenient. On your way to the station there is a market on the left side of the road that sells the card and lets you load the card via cash or credit. You can load it at the stations too.
I would definitely go back to Hakan’s place.

At first I was a little hesitant to rent this place due to its location but one of the reviews explained how metro station was very close and a walkable distance also how easy it was to get a taxi then I decided I should rent this place and I did.
The house is very clean and comfortable. Faces the forest and one of the famous Istanbul bridges. It is a walkable distance to the metro station where takes you one ride to get to the major touristy places such as city center, grand bazaar and etc.
Mr Hakan is definitely a super host and is kind, respectful, understanding and communicative. He definitely went out of his way to help us and we appreciate it a lot.
My family and I enjoyed staying at this house and if we go back to Istanbul we will definitely stay here again.
Thank you Mr Hakan for all your help and hospitality

9 kişilik bir ekip olarak kaldık. Gayet keyifli vakit geçirdik. Ev temiz ve fotoğraflarda gösterildiği gibiydi. Isınmada herhangi bir sorun yaşamadık, ev gayet sıcaktı. Konumu ve manzarası çok güzeldi.
Ev sahibi çok kibar ve yardımseverdi, iletişimi güzeldi. Tüm sorularımıza hızlı cevap verip, ihtiyaçlarımıza çözüm buldu. Hiç bir sorun yaşamadan konaklamamızı bitirdik.

Hakan and his daughter very supportive and anything you requested they respond without delay
The villa is very clean and full load with water and snacks When we arrived, we got surprised full of toilet and bathroom items same as five stars hotel
Also it was full of surprised to find huge balcony with the view of forest and Bosporus with bridge view
Final and great thing, the windy you get you will fill very relaxing
We have family of 8 and the villa was big enough to accommodate all of us
Keep up consistent Mr Hakan for quality services
I will recommend with all family accompanying to take this villa

ev sahibi hakan bey çok kibar ve iyi biri çok yardımcı oldu. ev muhteşem, konum süper, manzara süper.
evde be isterseniz var, evdeymişiz gibi rahat ettik.
Teşekkürler hakan bey 🙏😊

description: Enjoy a stylish, comfortable, and air-conditioned experience at this very centrally located spot.

reviews.text:
Muhammet is a friendly, accommodating host who is proactive in inquiring about well-being. He also gives helpful tips. He is always available.
To the flat:
The apartment is as in the pictures and as in the description. Fast WiFi.
The living room is great, very comfortable couch and good TV. The kitchen has everything you need, although a little more crockery would be nice. The fridge is big enough, the dishwasher is good.
The bedrooms and beds are very comfortable, there are enough sheets and clean towels. Good washing machine available. The bathroom is small but perfectly adequate.
Location: The apartment is on the 2nd floor in a side street in Besiktas. Due to the very good location in the city center, it is unfortunately also a bit noisy, but you are in the heart of Besiktas.
Children: New cot and high chair available. Child-friendly apartment. We would come back to Muhammet's apartment anytime.

We stayed here for 40 days and had an incredibly comfortable experience. The apartment was clean, well-organized, and had everything we needed. The internet was excellent, and the location was perfect—just a short walk to the sea and surrounded by great restaurants, cafes, bars, and a large Migros supermarket. Tarık was very responsible and responsive, always quick to reply and helpful. Highly recommended.

This was my second time staying at Tariq's place, and once again, everything was absolutely perfect. I stayed for a month and couldn’t have asked for a better experience. The apartment is clean, comfortable, and fully equipped with everything you need for a longer stay. The location is also fantastic, convenient, safe, and close to everything. Tariq is a wonderful host: responsive, helpful. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a great stay. I’ll definitely be coming back again!

It is a very nice well maintained and clean apt. Mr.Talha would respond to messages right away and he would even show up within minutes if you need him to.
A very very understanding and accommodating host.
Location was what I exactly looking for and will comeback here next time for sure.
Recommend this place or any other places hosted by Mr. Talha as it is a very pleasant experience.

We stayed for 4 weeks around new year. I recommend this place overall specially for short stays.
The positives:
1. The location is great, at the heart of Besiktas with loads of restaurants and cafes at the door step. Also a very short walk to Besiktas bus station and port. We really liked it for that
2. Talha is very friendly and responsive. He helped us with placing online orders, booking taxi, etc.
3.The flat is reasonably spacious. All consumable products were provided including dishwashers tablets and laundry powder.
The negatives:
1.The apartment is on 2nd floor with a curved narrow stairway. Very difficult to move luggage. No lift. But after all it probably goes for all houses in the area.
2.The bathroom is small and damp and poorly ventilated with traces of mold. Note we were there over winter so warmer seasons may be better.
3.The floor is squeaky so anyone going to bathroom at night will wake up everyone.
4. Kitchen utensil are minimal. Probably ok for just 2 ppl

description: Wake up to breathtaking panoramic views of the Bosphorus, Maiden's Tower, and the Bosphorus Bridge from this unique duplex penthouse in the heart of Ortaköy. Hosted by Homie Suites, this two-bedroom apartment features a spacious private terrace, thoughtfully designed interiors, and everything you need for a memorable stay—just a short walk from Ortaköy's lively waterfront, cafés, restaurants, and boutiques

reviews.text:
classic tourist trap.
This penthouse’s condition are nowhere near the price or the listing photos. The interior is worn: a swollen floor, terrace furniture past its lifespan, and a bathroom window that doesn’t close, leaving the space freezing cold. Basic supplies were missing (three Nespresso capsules, no salt, two little bottle waters), and the front-left gas burner is unsafe.
The biggest issue is access& safety.
The house is between steep slopes, reachable only via steep, unsecured paths. On 4 of 6 days, it was inaccessible by taxi — not Uber, not 3 local companies. In ice and snow, getting down from the upper road is dangerous. I had to balance barefoot on ice for several minutes. Arriving unharmed was pure luck. In snow or sun this place is not reachable.
With these issues, I requested compensation. What disappointed me most was my Airbnb support as I wasn’t taken seriously. Large-scale hosts are protected over traveler safety. Never AGAIN Airbnb for pricey trips.

Unbelievable view from living room and terrace, Bed was comfortable. Host are very responsive.
For nearly 400$/CAD per night during the low season, the place is little outdated, furniture is old and there's not much in the condo. They could definitely invest more to buy higher quality products. Kitchen ventilation wasn't working so all the house would smell food if you cooked. there's no dryer so it takes days for clothing to dry. Livingroom A/C unit suddenly stopped working and I couldn't get it to work. Decided to open the front panel and I was shocked to see how much it was dirty, I don't think they ever maintained it.
This is not a baby or kid friendly place, terrace, the stairs and even the livingroom windows are dangerous.
The apartment has no elevator, and stairs are very tight. The place is almost impossible to access without a car because of how much hills and ramps there is.
you cannot go anywhere without driving but when you come back, there's no parking.

It was an amazing stay, the view was incredible.
We loved everything about the apartment.
It was more beautiful than described.
The host was so helpful and responsive.
The only inconvenience we had is with the location. It’s a bit difficult and the building
has no elevator.
But over all was a great stay and I will sure recommend it💛

We were lucky enough to stay in this apartment for 2 weeks. The view from the terrace and the living room is just a dream. Waking up every morning and taking a look over the city and the bridge.
I already miss it and this is my first day home again.
Our host Tunc took great care of us. Questions were answered immediately and if something was missing, the host helped us immediately and really took his time. It doesn't get any better!
The apartment is on a fairly narrow street and hill, which is not a problem. Only some taxi drivers don't want to go there because the streets are too narrow. But taxis and Istanbul alone is an experience in itself.
You can walk to the nearest supermarket in about 10 minutes, but it is a very steep and bumpy path! But a little walking never hurt anyone!
I would not recommend it for people with leg injuries / disabilities and wheelchairs.
It's very clean and everything you need is there. The cleaning service once a week does a wonderful job and you enter your apartment like on the first time.
All in all it was a great stay. We even extended our stay by a few days. Everything went smoothly thanks to Tunc!
We will definitely come again!
Once again I would like to say a big thank you to our host Tunc.
Thank you my friend! You gave us great tips and you were always available to look for a solution and helped us to make our trip more comfortable!

My stay at Homie was great its the first time I booked an appointment by Airbnb and it was awesome.
Before I arrive Tunc contacted me and he made everything easy and comfortable from check-in to check- out he was very flexible in check- in and check-out.
The penthouse was wonderful and the view was FABULOUS! I can’t forget that view. The rooms were clean and nice. There’s slippers and clean towels exactly like a hotel 5 stars stuff.
Tunc didn’t make me need anything even the adapter I found 2 more cuz Turkish electrical outlet different of my country electrical outlet and that helped me a lot and didn’t make me buy new one save time and money .
Homie was a perfect choice for me in Istanbul. ❤️

description:
We are looking forward to hosting you, our esteemed guests, with our loft located in Beyoglu, one of the historical districts of Istanbul. We are ready to do all we can to make your stay the best and comfortable. Enjoy your stay in our easy-to-reach loft.

With easy transportation, you will be able to make your stay the most comfortable and with the family environment, you will feel at home.

reviews.text: We really enjoyed our stay. The place was exactly as described, spacious, very clean, and comfortable, making it easy to feel at home. The host was friendly, welcoming, and easy to communicate with. The location as well was convenient, a short walk to a bus stop that made getting around simple.

We had a wonderful stay! The place was exactly as described — clean, comfortable, and well-equipped. The location was perfect for exploring the area, and communication with the host was smooth and friendly.
Great place to stay in Istanbul. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and well located. The host was very friendly and helpful throughout my stay. Highly recommended!

Necmettin was very nice and friendly and responsive. He was also very helpful in any aspects with all means. The neighborhood was nice with access to groceries and local food and sweets within walking distance of 15-20 minutes. Also, a good place for shopping for clothes made in Turkey was nearby. We had an easy check-in and check-out and an easy transfer to the airport as we had arranged a transfer with Necmettin. His apartment was very clean and had a lift which was very good. We enjoyed all the chats together and lots of information about Turkey etc.
I strongly recommend Necmettin´s listing and I would stay there again and again.

First of all necmettin is a very responsive host . He helped us throughout the trip contacting us and helping us with anything we asked for. He let us check in at 4 am due to our flight being so late. His house was so clean and included all the amenities. Bedroom was good and the balcony has a good view. The bus stand is very close to the house but the buses are kind of difficult to understand. You can walk to closest metro station which is shishane but it takes a lot of time and tracking. I advise anybody who plans to live here to first understand how the buses work here then take the bus to shishane and rest is easy. Im hoping to stay again here in future 👍🏻👍🏻

description:
You'll be amazed by the colorful and historical streets of Balat.
Our hotel is located in the most famous street, center of Balat and you can reach cafes, shops, historical places in a few minutes.

Some touristic places nearby are:

COLORFUL STAIRS
HISTORICAL MUSTAFA PASHA BATH
CIBALI GATE

COLORFUL DOORS
