PRIVATE GREEK HIGH SCHOOL
SVETI STEFAN BULGARIAN CHURCH
TAHTA MİNERE MOSQUE
YANBOL SYNAGOGUE
AHRİDA SYNAGOGUE

reviews.text: Wonderful place! Clean and large room with an amazing balcony. Perfect for a short or long stay. The area (Balat) is a vibrant bohemian place with lots to do and see. The hosts are also very nice. The only downside is that the bathroom is outside the room and one floor below, however for the price, Bengi’s place is perfect!! Thank you for a wonderful stay
Beautiful suite comfortable beds I loved our stay !! The only thing was there was no shampoo and shower and if you plan to cook there is no spices .
Rezervasyon yaptığım oda ile kaldığım oda aynı değildi. Benim bilgim olmadan odamı başkasına vermişler Odalar çok ufaktı temizlik açısından da kirliydi tavsiye etmiyorum .

The host is super friendly and willing to help all our needs! The place is also very interesting! Very delicate decorations with private balcony to see sunset and listen to Mosque calling each day! Perfect place to stay!
Temiz ve düzenleydi

description: Located 500 meters from Taksim Square in Cihangir, 900 meters from Galata Port Shopping Center, 300 meters from Kabataş Findikli Tram line, in a brand new building with underfloor heating, all the kitchen equipment, washing machine, dryer, refrigerator, etc. you need are available in the apartment.

reviews.text:
Overall, we had a good stay. Esra is an excellent host and very responsive. The apartment was clean, well equipped for a two-week stay, and located in a safe building complex. Esra promptly arranged extra pillows and organised a reliable airport transfer driver.
There are a few areas for improvement. The bedding had a very synthetic, slippery texture and tended to come loose from the mattress, and although the rain shower worked, the handle was broken and needed maintenance. The apartment was also significantly smaller than expected. While the location is very close to Taksim Square, there is a very steep hill on the way there. If using the metro for your airport transfer, we recommend taking a taxi for the short journey to avoid struggling with luggage.
Ahenk Market on the ground floor was extremely convenient and reasonably priced, with all the essentials needed for a longer stay. The Kabataş ferry port is also just a few minutes' walk away and was very convenient!

Wonderful Istanbul Stay
We had a wonderful stay at this beautiful flat in Istanbul. The apartment was exceptionally clean and comfortable, from the bedding to the wardrobes and storage areas, which were all spotless and very convenient.
The location is excellent—close to a lovely shopping center and only about a 10-minute walk to the port and the sea. The neighborhood also has a very authentic local atmosphere, which made our stay even more enjoyable.
Our host was absolutely wonderful. She responded to our messages very quickly and was always kind, helpful, and very cooperative whenever we needed anything.
What we especially appreciated was that the apartment was exactly as described and shown in the Airbnb pictures—no exaggeration at all. Everything was true to the listing.
Overall, it is a beautiful, clean, comfortable, and very convenient flat for a holiday in Istanbul. We truly enjoyed our stay and would happily recommend it to anyone visiting the city!

We stayed at Esra’s place for 3 nights and it was a very comfortable stay. The apartment was clean and exactly as shown in the pictures. It had enough space for the two of us. It’s very well located at a walking distance to taksim square, İSTİKLAL street, metro, tram, taxis and everything is available in the vicinity.
The only drawback for the entire area is that there are steep roads that would be a problem for some people to walk with luggage.
Esra is a good and responsive host! Would recommend her place for a stay in Beyoglu.

The apartment was nice - great location (highly recommend Cihangir/Beyoğlu part of Istanbul for vacation), clean building, the apartment itself was new and clean too! Easy to check in and out, hosts were responsive and polite, there is an air conditioner, dishwasher and washing+drying machines in apartments. Good water pressure in the bathroom. It might be noisy at night due to the building being on a very lively street, but we loved our stay there anyway, big thanks to Esra!

I’ve stayed in this lovely place 2-7 Mar 2023. I was in Istanbul before and I know a bit the city. This apart is located very close to my fav spots — Galata Port and Cihangir neighborhood. Apartment was clean and well equipped! Everything according to description.
Esra was very friendly and supportive host who helped me with all my requests. I’m very grateful for her help, it’s priceless!!!
Highly recommend this apartment, best service!

description: Enjoy your holiday in our comfortable and luxuriously designed apartments in the center of Beyoğlu, where you can watch the unique Golden Horn view. In our historical building, where you will not have any transportation problems with its location within walking distance of Taksim, Istiklal Street and Pera, which are the most famous places of Beyoğlu, we combine historical texture with modernity and we are waiting for our guests.

reviews.text:
Not Worth the Price – Disappointing Stay
The apartment looks just like the photos, including the view – but that’s where the positives end.
The bed and sofa are low quality and very uncomfortable. The kitchen is basic, missing even essentials like salt and pepper. The bathroom ventilation seems linked to other units – we constantly smelled unpleasant odors.
Noise insulation is very poor; you can hear neighbors clearly. As a civil engineer, I suspect extremely thin walls.
From the third night on, the hallway smelled strongly of cigarette smoke – only when a certain night guard was on duty. Despite addressing it, nothing changed. Combined with the bad bed, both my wife and I developed headaches.
The elevator broke down on the second day and, although it was fixed within two days, it added to the overall inconvenience.
I’ve stayed in better Airbnbs in this price range in Turkey.

The apartment is located in the heart of Beyoğlu with a magnificent sea view, within walking distance of Taksim and Istiklal. one personel is inside the building everytime. Having a night security guard is a huge advantage, it made us feel safe. The staff are smiling and friendly. They were very polite. The apartment is exactly the same as in the photos. Cleanliness was simply impeccable. The interior design of the apartment is very luxurious and really beautiful. Istanbul is a place where you can stay and you will definitely be satisfied. I would recommend it to everyone.

We really enjoyed our stay here. The house is comfortable and perfect for a family. The location is strategic and easy to access. The house is fully equipped and well maintained.
The staff were friendly, kind, and very helpful. Everything was exactly as described in the listing.

The apartment was really nicely located to Istikal street which was a 10 minute walk and had shops and lots of people around the area which you felt safe. The apartment was clean and we had AC which was really nice. The view was amazing from the living room as you could see various landmarks and the sea.
It would of been much better if we was able to check out a little bit later the day we was leaving but overall was really happy with the apartment and everything was professional. Okan was really helpful and responsive when needed something. Would be happy to stay here again! Would definitely recommend to others. Thank you Okan!

Okan’s place is well worth the stay… the apartment is new, furnished well. Elevators are a plus!! I could not imagine lugging up my luggage up the stairs. :)
He was super flexible with the check in constant communication throughout. The place was freshly cleaned. Although I showed up early his team was extremely accommodating. Would sty again if I’m in Istanbul.

description:
Our place is located in a bustling area with a shopping mall, restaurants and cafes, beauty salons, and a mosque nearby.

You’ll be able to enjoy the convenience of having everything you need within walking distance. Our home is cozy and comfortable, with all the amenities you need for a relaxing stay. We look forward to hosting you!

reviews.text:
This review will be lengthy so please do read with patience. When we checked-in Akdlnn came and helped us with keys, lifts, luggage, instructions etc. He was so friendly from the time we came to his house till the time we checked out. He was there for us whenever we needed him for example he went to places near us to exchange our money to turkish lira several times, he also went to the pharmacy and got me my meds, he came to the house whenever we needed any help. Akdlnn always responded to our messages and calls on time. He was so loving to my baby and always played with him and held him. whether it was 6am in the morning or 2am at night he always responded to us. we really didn't feel like he was our host we felt like he was this big brother you need in a country that you're not too familiar with or know the language.
The house was very clean, neat and tidy, very spacious, open concept and everything was around us such as bakeries, pharmacies, restaurants, mosque, shops, markets

The flat looks exactly like the pictures. It was comfortable and a great view of the city and a Mosque. What made the trip so easy was definitely Mohammed. My husband came on a different flight than me and all his luggage was lost. Mohammed assisted him with getting food and drinks. When I arrived he assisted me as well. Helping me to maneuver through grocery shopping and getting items delivered. Mohammed was truly a godsend. Also the guards who let you in are worth getting to know. They helped anytime they seen us and offered great places to eat.

The place was much more than we expected,
it has al the amenities and a fully equipped kitchen, like home.
The spa/gym area is clean and never crowded.
There are many shops and restaurants around the building and there's a beautiful mini park with a water feature in front of the entrance.
The staff was always helpful and friendly, especially our contact person Mr. Mohammad who responded promptly to all our demands.
Also a big thanks to Mr Bektas who fixed our balcony door.
I would recommend this place to every family who is looking for a cool and affordable place in Istanbul.
Herşey fotoğraflardaki gibiydi, check-in yapmadan önde iletişime geçildi ve nasıl check-in yapılacağı konusunda baştan bilgilendirildim. Kapalı otopark olması en büyük avantajlardan bir tanesi.

The location was decent, and I did feel very safe, which is a plus. That said, it wasn’t the most convenient — buses were hard to catch. The soundproofing was poor; we could clearly hear our neighbors being intimate, which made things uncomfortable. The couch also felt a little dirty and worn out. Overall, nothing really stood out, wasn’t bad stay either 6.7/10.

description:
Our apartment is thoughtfully designed to make you feel right at home. From comfortable beds and fresh linens to a fully-equipped kitchen, LED TV, air conditioner, washing machine, dishwasher, oven and high-speed Wi-Fi, we've thought of everything to ensure your stay is comfortable and enjoyable.

Situated in a central area in Kadıköy that provides easy access to public transportation. Perfect for business or pleasure. (Newly built according to earthquake regulations. Documents can be shared)

reviews.text:
Sedef and Mustafa are very attentive hosts. They really know how to make one feel like at home.
I checked in quite late, but Mustafa was waiting for me without a word of complaint about my delay.
The house is not too large, but very cosy and has everything you might need; as I was a sole traveler, it was more than enough. I believe 3-4 people can stay in a very comfortable way.
I think the place is brand new (or maintained in an extremely good way) as there was not even a scratch or a particle of dust 😊
All necessary equipment was available and the location is very convenient, just a minute to Bagdad street and a few minutes walking to the sea side. There is a shop nearby, as well quite a good choice of restaurants and the train station is just around the corner.
I will surely stay at this place too next time I come to Istanbul

I have stayed in Sedef 's and Mustafa's place with my family for 8 nights in April 2023. We absolutely loved it! The apartment is new and very central. It was spotless clean. Many restaurants, markets, butchers, fish monger, bakery, groceries, coffee shops in walking distance (Evce is my favourite to grab home made snacks!). it's a very local neighborhood despite being central and accessible. The communication was very good and Mustafa was very helpful from the check in to check out, I would definitely stay here again .

Excellent modern apartment in a new house with all the amenities. It was a pleasure to live, it was nice to come back to the apartment after sightseeing in the city. The house is clean and comfortable. Especially want to highlight the excellent bed in which you sleep like a baby. Responsive and friendly owner. You won't find a better apartment!)

The flat was really nice and Mustafa was helpful and responsive to our msgs. The air conditioning was broken on the first night which Mustafa chased and fixed it the day after. I’m giving one star less as the linens were not the best quality really and they were bubbly, same with the towels that were a bit knackered. There was no salt, pepper or oil or tea which usually you can find in airbnbs. The shampoo bottle was finished but again Mustafa replaced it as soon as we texted him. There was turkish coffee and welcoming bottles of water which was nice.
The shower wasn’t draining properly as it was clogged with previous guests hair which we needed to sort it ourselves.
Maybe if the linens and the towels were higher quality, and the shower drain was clean i would have given 5 stars, cause the rests are minor things.

It's a very nice apartment, comfortable quiet and clean. Our host Mustafa was very friendly and accommodating. We enjoyed our stay here very much. I would recommend this place and this host and would definitely stay again.

description:
Bomonti is a neighborhood in the Şişli district of Istanbul, named after the Bomonti Brewery founded in 1890 by the Swiss Bomonti Brothers.
Our apartment welcomes you in the heart of Istanbul, in the most beautiful part of the neighborhood. It opens the door to countless enjoyable experiences with its lively neighborhood life.
Get to Taksim, Beyoğlu, Şişli and Beşiktaş in 5 minutes from our apartment next to Bomontiada and Hilton with its central location.
Our apartment is a duplex 2+1 in a decent site with 24/7 security.

reviews.text: does not match the price-quality ratio. The air conditioner broke on the 3rd day and was never fixed. The shower door didn't close. The furniture itself is not bad, comfortable mattresses and pillows. There is a workplace. The gym is terrible, only 2 cardio and 2 machines

Konum olarak harika bir konumda görselde gözüktüğü gibi ev
sorunumuz banyonun temiz olmaması ve evde bir koku vardı
Yine de fiyat performans açısından oldukça başarılı

nevresimler ve banyo temizdi. mutfak gereçlerinde neye elimizi atsak yeteri kadar temiz degildi, her kullandığımızı öncesinde yıkamak zorunda kaldık. ev sıcacık, temiz ve düzenliydi, sessizdi ve girişi kolaydı. duşun giderinden su cok zor gittiği için sular duşun kapısından dışarı çıktı, 5 dakika duş için 15 dakika banyo suyu temizledim. bu sorun ACİLEN düzeltilmeli. Miraç bey giriş çıkış saatleri için kolaylık sağladı. teşekkür ederiz.

We stayed at this apartment for 6 nights with my family. Great location. Close to main spots and nice restaurants 15 mins away walk. A taxt stand right across from the apartment that made it so convenient to go around. Very clean and equipped apartment perfect for 3,4 people. 24hr security. Highly recommended!
Evin konumu gayet iyi metroya 10 dakika yürüme mesafesinde aracıyla gelen için binanın karşısında otopark mevcut. Mutfak araç gereçleri tamdı.

description: FAMILY RUN BUSINESS – 24 HOURS RECEPTION (Less than 1 minute distance) – FREE MINI BREAKFAST (Less than 1 minute distance) – 4MINS TO ISTIKLAL STREET – MARKETS & PATISSERIES VERY CLOSE – SAME FLAT IN THE PHOTO

reviews.text: Clean and comfortable stay. Apartment matched the photos. Location close walk to Istiklal street. Helpful and friendly staff. The mini breakfast was a plus!

For the price, this is a great find. The host was very communicative. I appreciated the water in the fridge and the bathroom sandals. The room is small but you have everything you need and a nice street view. I didn’t try the breakfast but it’s a nice gesture. However, the windows are thin and not well insulated (with a crack in at least one), so you will hear everything that happens outside. The host keeps replying to reviews saying that this neighborhood is quiet. It’s true, there is no nightlife, but cars still pass right by the windows and the problem is not the noise, it’s the lack of sound proofing. There is also a street light directly outside the window that shines a bright orange light into the room all night, and the curtains are thin and don’t block it. I can’t say I had a great night’s sleep but it’s a cute little place, I would stay here again. You are close to Cihangir. The neighborhood is working-class and somewhat conservative/traditional, very lively.

A nice place to stay for the price. Clean bed linen and air conditioning. The narrow street is quite noisy until midnight. The host is very responsive and helpful. It was great to have breakfast included.

Yapılan diğer yorumlar tamamen doğru. Gerçekten çok kaliteli ve çok güler yüzlü bir işletme. Üstelik kahvaltı olanağı olması da müthişti. Evin giriş ve çıkışı da çok rahattı. İlk girerken evi gezdirmeye gelen arkadaş da çok iyi ve sevimliydi. Cafesinde çalışan çocuk da çok arkadaş canlısıydı. Ev ise konumu güzel ve fiyat performanstı. Gayet temizdi, wifi hızlıydı ve kliması da sorunsuzdu. Kesinlikle tekrardan kullanacağım. GÜLERYÜZ VE DÜRÜSTLÜK KAZANDIRIR DOSTLARIM :) ♥️

The host was extremely helpful once I arrived he came straight to me with the key took me to the room and showed me around and explained everything, supplied the WiFi password and took my phone number to make sure if I needed anything to message or call him. My checkout was at midday however my flight was 9PM so I asked if I could leave my luggage at reception and they locked it in a safe room the whole day and was safely returned to me before I left. The flat was exactly as shown on the picture the place was clean and peaceful and I felt safe with the lock on the inside of the door.
Reception is 24/7 if I’m not mistaken and they provide you a free breakfast card before they leave the room tour.
This host was very friendly and I highly recommend this host. Thank you for your service 🙏🏼

description:
Our thoughtfully designed apartment is fully equipped with everything you need for a comfortable stay. With air conditioning in every room, high ceilings, and two additional ceiling fans, the space stays cool and refreshing throughout the day.

Located in a prime area of Kadıköy, the apartment offers quick access to the seaside, popular cafés and restaurants, local boutiques, and multiple public transport options, including ferries, metro, and buses, making it effortless to explore Istanbul.

reviews.text:
Place is awesome, you will not find another one like this. Very spacious and comfortable.
Super clean, stuffed with appliances (AC in every room, that’s something), quiet but well located (3 min to the street full of restaurants, 5 min walk to the entrance to moda park). Nice private balcony. Elevator!
Place is always booked, so check in/out time is not always flexible, but host will do his best to make it more comfortable if possible.

I had a wonderful experience renting Demir's apartment with my wife and six-year-old daughter. Demir was highly organized and attentive throughout the entire process, ensuring a seamless check-in and continuous support during our stay. The apartment perfectly matched the description and was impressively spacious without any unnecessary clutter. The presence of an elevator in the building was convenient. The two bedrooms overlooking the peaceful courtyard provided a tranquil environment for a restful sleep. The kitchen was well-equipped with everything we needed for cooking. The apartment's prime location offered easy access to cafes, restaurants, shops, and public transportation. The cleanliness was remarkable, and overall, we were extremely pleased with our stay. I highly recommend this rental for families or anyone seeking a comfortable and enjoyable experience.

Demir’s place is truly an oasis of comfort in the city! We were impressed from the moment we walked into the building (there’s an elevator!) and with every detail of the apartment (even bigger and nicer than in the pictures!). Communication with Demir was always timely, kind, and professional - and the welcome snacks and water we received were such a treat after a long day of traveling. We really enjoyed our stay and highly recommend the host to anybody looking for a place in Istanbul 🙌🏼

Ev aynı fotoğraflardaki gibiydi. Konum kadıköyde merkezi lokasyondaydı. Dışarda hava çok soğuk olmasına rağmen ev sıcacıktı. Binanın hemen yanında otopark olması otomobilinizi park etmek açısından çok kolaylık sağladı. Yatak odaları sessizdi, çok iyi bir şekilde dinlenmeye olanak sağlıyor. Evdeki eşyalar yeterli. Ev sahibi Demir bey çok hızlı sorulara yanıt veriyor. Bu konumda tercih edilmesi gereken bir ev. Fiyatını sonuna kadar hak ediyor.

I highly recommend Demir's Airbnb. As a host, Demir could not be clearer, more responsive, or kind in his communications. In terms of the AirBnB itself, I found it to be an even better space than the one captured in the photos, which rarely happens. So if you're looking for a clean, comfortable, spacious, stylishly furnished, and centrally located place to stay on the Asian side of Istanbul, Demir's Airbnb can't be beat!

description: Keep it simple at this peaceful and centrally-located place.

reviews.text:
Burada ikinci kalışım ve yine çok keyifli geçti. Oda, yatak/çarşaflar, banyo, her yer tertemizdi ve konforluydu. Gerçekten güzel bir oda, apartmanın içi de çok bakımlı, rahatlıkla tercih edebilirsiniz. Konum Moda sahile çok yakın; sessiz sakin, ağaçlı, huzurlu bir sokakta. Ulaşım/toplu taşıma araçlarına da yürüme mesafesinde.
Ayrıca Birol Bey çok kibar ve nazikti, giriş çıkışlarda da kolaylıkla iletişime geçebildik.
Çok seçici biri olarak söyleyebilirim ki nezih bir yer ve güvenle kalabilirsiniz, insan kendini evinde hissediyor.

Birol bey güler yüzlü ve iletişimi güzeldi. Daire ilanda gösterildiği gibi temiz ve düzenliydi fiyatının karşılığını veren bir yer. Daireye giriş çok kolaydı ve dairenin konumu da mükemmel tekrar görüşmek dileğiyle..
Lokasyon harika, otopark mevcut. Sahile 2 dk yurume mesafesinde. İletisim ve temizlik iyiydi. Fiyata gore harikaydi.

Konumu çok iyi. Daire Çok rahattı giriş çıkışlarda herhangi bir sorun yaşamadık. Bina içerisi iyi ve sakindi sessizdi güvenliydi. Birol Bey tüm sorularıma hızlıca ve güzelce cevap verdi teşekkür ederim. Bir daha tercihim olucak

Otel gerekiyor konumu gerek oda temizliği kphısında çok güzeldi. Otel sahibi Birol bey ise çok sıcakkanlı ve içten birisiydi. İstanbul Anadolu yakası için ihtiyacım olduğunda sürekli kullanacağım diyebilirim.

description: A modern flat in the hippest neighbourhood of Istanbul, where you may discover Moda, Kadikoy or rest after a day of sightseeing beautiful İstanbul . The flat is newly renovated with brand new apliances, ideal for couples, comfy bed, private bathroom, complete kitchen, 1000 Mbps wifi, private garden and just steps away from countless cafes, bars, restaurants, and public transportation. Experience Istanbul like a local, make your reservation today for a vacation you will always remember!

reviews.text: We love Moda/Kadikoy location. Lively party atmosphere at night. Great restaurants, coffee and shopping. Home was very clean and comfortable. Bed firm (we slept great) water pressure great, kitchen well stocked. AC nice and cool and a fan is also provided. Thank your for recommendations. We had a great 5 night stay!

The apartment is new and artistically decorated. Everything was clean, the itchen had everything you need for a short and long stay. The host left water, wine, fruits, turkish sweets and snaks for us, which was very nice. There was a large collection of tea, coffee, olive oil and balsamic vinegard. - We did not have to buy it. The apartment is at the heart of Kadikoy, with a lot of bars and restorants around. - It is a great place to stay. It it very close to a ferry as well as to the metro station (5 min of walking). Inner garden space is amasing! - We had a breakfast and a dinner there every day. We absolutely love it and definetely would come back. Amasing host! Fantastic place to stay!

Very nice place and host. Kitchen was very nicely stocked, everything was truly great. I hope to stay in this AirBnB again. I loved the way it was designed, and it was very cozy. Good place to hang out if it’s cold, and if it’s warm you will be near to many fun things to visit. 10 out of 10 :)

We stayed 3 nights at Gülsev’s place and everything was as described and more.
She is a good host and communicates promptly with detailed information about the property.
Place is very tastefully decorated, very clean and relaxing.
We enjoyed our staying here and we would definitely stay again.

It was simply fantastic! The apartment is beautifully furnished, modern, qnd meticulously detailed. It felt really comfortable and i just didnt want to leave:) The terrace, in particular, stole my heart-a dreamy spot to unwind in the evenings. The location is excellent! Right in Moda, with bars and restaurants within easy reach. Public transport connections are also very easy to reach. Communication with Gülsev was excellent. She‘s open to questions and provides information about the accommodation and directions. The bed and couch are very comfortavle. I especially appreciated that the apartment is equipped with a coffee machine, toaster, kettle and a smoothie maker. Coffee, tea and herbs were also provided. Many thanks for the wine that i enjoyed on the terrace:) I highly reccomend this apartment and wish u a great time in Moda.

description: Welcome to Sunway Bosphorus Suite 4, where breathtaking Bosphorus views meet luxury. Wake to the Istanbul skyline, then step out to explore Taksim Square, the Historical Peninsula, and Galataport—all within easy reach. Filled with chic décor and modern amenities, Suite 4 offers a prime city stay. Experience the best of Istanbul from Suite 4, your home with a view.

reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay! The apartment was very clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was great, and everything was easily accessible. The host was very friendly, helpful, and always easy to reach. We felt very comfortable throughout our stay and would definitely stay here again. Highly recommended!

Good affordable apartment, steps away from galata port. Everything was great from location to the apartment itself to amenities, cleanliness and host responses, wifi speed, water pressure, mattress / beddings etc…
I would’ve rented longer but the steep stairs from the street to reach the apartment made it a bit of a hassle. (About 5 flights of stairs )

The property was exactly what was advertised. It was clean and tidy, and great value for money. Location is good for the Besiktas Stadium, and Taksim Square. Nice view of the Bosphurus. It is positioned well for public transport -Metro/tram a few minutes walk away, and ferries even closer. Harun was an exceptionally responsive host, provided great information for finding the property, and always available if needed. The property isnt suitable for people that are unhappy about walking up steps, but Harun made this very clear in the property details, and in this area of the city, steps, or at least walking up hills is always going to be feature you cant avoid.

Harun is a very helpful and responsive host with a great clean apartment in a nice area of the city, it’s just like the pictures. There are quite a few stairs to get to the apartment but that was fine for us

We really liked the place. It’s in a great location, close to Taksim, and not far from the ferry terminals or the tram. From there, it was easy to get anywhere in the city. There are plenty of places to eat nearby. There were three of us staying there, and the space was comfortable for us. It was quiet at night. They were always available to answer any questions we had. People have mentioned the stairs many times before; I don’t think it’s a major issue, but it’s probably best for older people or those with children in strollers to avoid this place. The window offers a view of the Asian side of the city.

description:
The heart of the city is in Kadıköy, in its most central place.

Private suite room in designer Airbnb home.

The 2nd floor is quite bright and spacious.

Private bathroom and kitchen.

Self entry system.

45 minutes by bus from the airport

Possibility to reach all parts of the city,

Walking distance to Metro - Metrobus - Ferry - Marmaray - Buses.

20 minutes away from historical and touristic areas by ferry ( Taksim, Sultanahmet, Eminönü, Sirkeci)

Historical places, Shops, cafes

reviews.text: The apartment was generally clean, comfortable, and pleasant. Its location is right in the heart of Kadıköy, very central. The check-in time at 6 PM is a bit late in general; it might be tiring for guests with morning flights who have to wait. However, Mr. Hakan kindly allowed us to check in one hour earlier. There was some noise in the mornings due to construction across the street. Overall, it offers great value for money. Thank you to Mr. Hakan for everything

Had a great time at this apartment! It was so nice I extended my time here . it is centrally and convienently located. Ferry terminal , busses and train are easily accessible from here but it is walkable to most places in Kadikoy. the apartment was very neat and clean and it is so nice to go back after a day out in the heat to AC and just chill. there are endless restaurants, cafes, bars and an outdoor market in the area.
The host was very pleasant and responsive if I had any questions .
Thank you Mr. Hakan !
I Highly recommend!

Everything was according to the photos and description.
Perfect and flawless.
It was clean and everything was ready for a 7-night stay.
Mr. Hakan was always responsive and patiently guided.
Considering that I know Istanbul almost completely, I can say that from this location you can access anywhere in Istanbul by metro and metrobus, which is only 5 to 10 minutes away from Mr Hakan home.

Host was responsive and helpful. I enjoyed my stay. The apartment is as described. I did not have any issues. Location is great. I did not have any sound/noise problems even though it was really central.

Konum harika, odanın boyutu iki kişi için gayet yeterli. Genel olarak yorumlardaki gürültü problemine katılmakla beraber benzer konumda daha az gürültülü bir yerin olmasını beklemek de gerçekçi gelmiyor. Bu nedenle ben sorun etmedim. Yalnızca kalan kişilerin temizlikte sıkıntı olmadığını, fakat binanın ve odanın eskiliğinden dolayı o “tertemiz” görüntüyle kalamayacaklarını bilmeleri iyi olabilir. Yatak eğer yapılı olan 2 kişi kalacaksanız küçük gelebilir, bize yetti. Her şeyi değerlendirince fiyat-performans denecek bir oda, konumu da her şeyi daha iyi yapıyor. Hakan beye de teşekkür ederim ☺️

description:
Antoine Galata is located in the 160 year old Grade II Listed Urgliavich Building next to the Galata Tower.
The building was fully renovated in 2012. All apartments are luxuriously refurbished with top-of-the-line amenities.
Galata Neighbourhood is where the heart of the City beats with some of the best restaurants and cafés in town very conveniently located.
Shopping for daily amenities, souvenirs and other needs is very easy and safe in the neighbourhood.
Location is extremely central.

reviews.text:
We spent 9 days in this lovely apartment directly opposite the Galata Tower. The location halfway up between Galata Bridge/Karaköy Iskelesi (where several ferries dock) and the beginning of the Istiklal Caddesi (modern shopping street) is great.
There are several excellent restaurants and rooftop terraces within 5’ walking distances. And a decent supermarket is just below the Galata Tower. In the morning you can observe the sunrise above the Bosporus and in the evening the hustle and bustle outside on the square below. The windows are thick, so the noise is mostly blocked out.
The spacious, south-facing apartment is on the fourth floor (with elevator), well equipped and nicely furnished with a parquet floor and a spacious bathroom with a good shower.
Naz personally welcomed us and gave us valuable tips. The interactions with her were professional, friendly and fast.

This was our third stay in Istanbul. The Galata Tower area was much busier than a decade ago, but as others have said, the windows do an incredible job of shutting out the crowd noise. The only noise that tends to come through is vehicle noise. Naz was easy to reach and responsive. Having an elevator was great, and the building felt very safe. The apartment was spotless, and having the combo W/D was helpful. There's plenty of closet space, and room to relax (and admire the incredible view). The bed was super comfy. There are two markets really close by so we could buy items like paper towels, more coffee pods and shampoo, snacks and drinks. The only thing to note is our drivers had trouble both time finding the apartment, so if you're calling for a taxi or Uber suggest using one of the restaurants next to the apartment instead. My husband has affirmed we'd totally book one of Naz's apartments again if we return to Istanbul. Thank you Naz!

I had a great stay! ♥️ Is it possible to find a better view from the window? Full immersion in the atmosphere of Galata. There are many excellent cafes nearby where you can have a delicious breakfast. The apartment is very comfortable, there is an elevator, Naz has always been in touch. Thank you for a comfortable and impressive stay, and for the high level of service 🥰💫

Our stay was impeccable! The host was flexible and very responsive to our needs and the apartment is charming and beautifully furnished . Very clean and a fantastic location ! Can highly recommend to anyone . Thanks for a great stay!

Fantastic and beautifully designed apartment with amazing views and light and sunsets. Totally Romantic. Lovely bathroom, bedroom, kitchen and living room. This is the second of her apartments we stayed in. So lucky to have found the place. Naz is so helpful and kind. We would happily stay again. It gets 100% from both of us. Naz even booked us a taxi pickup and departure. Absolutely delightful.

description: You can have a stylish experience in this centrally located place. Our apartment has been renovated and is suitable for short-term rentals. It is easy to get to and centrally located. It is about 1 minute from Pangaltı Metro and close to transportation such as buses, taxis and minibuses. It is also located in an area rich in food and drink and social activities. A combi boiler, natural gas and other white goods are available. It is within walking distance to Taksim. Wifi is available.

reviews.text: Nice and clean small apartment in Şişli near metro. Very convenient location for walking or getting around via metro, Uber or taxi. However parking can be a challenge if you have a car. It had everything needed. Host is very responsive, friendly and flexible. Building is safe. Many cafes, restaurants, and stores nearby. Great for couples or solo traveler.

It was the best decision to choose this apartment. Everything was the best. Soft sofas, Modern furniture and utensils. Clean and comfortable bed.. The best place. Close to metro, transport. Everything you want to buy is close by. It's quiet and it's a safe place, You can return home safely at any time. Hasan is very considerate, 24/7 he is online and you can ask any question. He is always ready to help you.
. So I recommend everyone to book this apartment, you won't regret it. I will definitely come back.

Hasan was always quick to response. He helped us to transport luggages and even bought us a special Turkish dessert. Comfortable and clean apartment. Convenient and quiet neighborhood. Highly recommend.

During my stay at Hasan's place, for around 10 nights, I didn't have any issues coming and going, the location is very central and it is easy to commute anywhere thanks to M2.
The biggest issue was the constant renovation happening in the next building, they work from Monday to Saturday and use construction tools. If you have to stay or work during the day time, noise could be disturbing.
Other than that, it has a lot of nice local restaurants, bars, pubs, and meyhane's around. I would definitely consider going back depending on my priorities.
Very good host. Apartment is ok but very good location in Istanbul

description:
Relax in our recently refurbished, modern rooms decorated in earth-tones. Hard-wood floors, natural light shining through floor-to-ceiling windows offering remarkable views, and fine linens and plush pillows, all enrich the comfort you feel at our apartments.

Choose among rooms that offer stunning views of the Sea of Marmara and across to Asia, or our rooms with the picturesque views of the old city and Sultanahmet district.

reviews.text: This place was great if you want to visit the attractions like the mosques and bazaars! Taxis are not cheap so if you’re looking to party I would look into the newer side of Instanbul! There are no clubs walking distance or close to this location. There’s also a karaoke bar that sits right next door and you often hear it at night. It didn’t keep us up but definitely worth noting. You can also hear outside noise but it’s to be expected due to the location being so close and historical! Overall, I loved this place! It was a great place to stay to see all of t he e history Faith had to offer! We walked everywhere and met so many locals it started to feel like home! The owner is super responsive and made it super easy with our late flight! Will definitely be back! Thankyou!

Nice place, location being the great plus. Not proper ventilation in the bathroom, but a bearable minus, since one can let windows open.
Decent matress & cleaness are also on the bright side.
Communication with host went smoothly and timely (via AirBNB app; they also left us a phone number). Easy check in, no need to meet the host, the same applying to check out. When leaving, we were able to leave the luggage in the hallway, and to pick it up latter, and we strolled unconstrained through the city until leaving to airport.
Taking an Uber/taxi is difficult: there is a gang of drivers 100 meters from the building. They try to keep you captive into their network on Uber and biTaksi (the local app), and insist to force you to pay extra fees outside the app. With patience one can escape them and catch an honest driver. Otherwise, Uber proved to be the best option (time/money) for going to/from airport or for long haul drives (e.g. 10-14 km into the Anatolian part of the city).
Good position, clean room, comfortable bed. Definitely worth the money. I can't wait to come back to amazing Istanbul.
Good value for money. Clean and comfortable. Next to lots of restaurants and shops although you don’t hear anything at night which is great!
The room was just as the photos promised and location is perfect; just a short walk from Sultanahmet square and all the main sights.

description: Jacuzzi & Fireplace This stylish room with river and garden views creates a fashionable background for your stay.

reviews.text: ulaşım olarak kaoly bir konumda fotoğraf da ve anlatımda olduğu gibi herşey temiz ve nezih bir yer güzel bir gece geçirdik teşekkürler
Temiz düzgün ve yeni bir yapı bu yüzden herkese tavsiye ederim cok rahat ve temizdi
Temiz ve guzeldi. Nehrin hemen kiyisinda olmasi da cok hostu. Dogan bey her istegimizi kirmadan yerine getirdi. Mutlaka tekrar gelecegiz.

Doğan Bey başından itibaren çok ilgiliydi. Ne ihtiyacımız olursa anında karşılandı. Oda çok temizdi ve yeni bir yer olduğu için mobilyalar vs her şey yepyeni ve tertemizdi. Bu güzel deneyim için Doğan Bey e tekrar teşekkür ediyorum.
Ses izolasyonuyla alakalı sorun vardı. alt kattaki sesler hepsi geliyodu. şömine kırıktı sorun ama ısınmayla alakalı sorun yaşamadık. jakuzi çok temiz değildi.

description:
Discover comfort and rich history in this centrally-located room near Taksim Square and İstiklal Avenue. Experience the best of Istanbul while enjoying the amenities of this well-designed space. Explore the most popular restaurants, shops, and attractions of the city. Relax and unwind in this cozy urban retreat.

Turizm Amaçlı Kiralama Yetkisi

08.05.2024/34-743

reviews.text:
The place is much very small, dirtier than the photos. The location is in one of the more unpleasant parts of Istanbul: it’s very dirty and loud.
Next to the metro but that’s it
On the bright side: the host is very responsive and helpful and the linens were very clean and pleasant.
Maybe it’s ok for its price but I’ve found nicer options for this money

Clean and quiet place. We stayed here for two nights. Room is small but we were not spending any time, just sleeping there, so it was ok. Bed was comfortable, internet was fast. Check-in was easy, instructions were very clear and it’s easy to find the place. It’s located close to airport bus station, so it was convenient for us as we had to take early bus.

I had good experience with this apartment. First of all, the host was replying very quickly that is very helpful.
The room is very clean and also location is great. Direct downstairs there is a kiosk which works at night as well.
I think the price is quiet matching with the performance👍🏻

Happy and Mert thank you for hosting me. The stay at your clean, cosy and stylish place was certainly without any hassle.
Hardly 7 minutes of walk from Taksim square, so very centrally located, clean, and same as that of the shared pictures. Like everything else the check in and check out guidance was clear. I would definitely keep them on my list for future travels to IST.
Thank you!

We had a great stay! The apartment was very clean and comfortable, and the location was perfect — right in the center and close to shops and everything we needed. The hosts were very friendly and helpful throughout our stay. Highly recommended! 🌟

description: Enjoy a calm island stay in this comfortable 2-BR apartment located on Büyükada. Designed with soft tones and natural light, the apartment offers a cozy living area, open kitchen, modern bathroom, and thoughtfully furnished bedrooms. Guests can also enjoy access to a shared garden, surrounded by greenery and seasonal flowers. Situated in a peaceful neighborhood, yet within easy reach of the island center, this home is ideal for those seeking tranquility and authentic island life.

reviews.text:
Not recommended. The apartment has a serious humidity and mold problem: there was no shower curtain, so water spread everywhere in the bathroom after every shower, adding to the already high humidity, and within days, mold appeared and spread on the walls of the bedroom next to the bathroom, even though I aired out the apartment every morning and evening. Previous reviews show the same problem has been reported since April 2025.
The internet also worked very poorly all week (no video calls possible).
The host took 5 days to reply to my messages, then refused my request for an amicable resolution, so I had to escalate to Airbnb customer service.
Very disappointing for such an expensive apartment.

Adaya gittiğimizde henüz saat 13.00 idi ve bizde ev sahibinden çantalarımızı bırakıp çıkmak için ricada bulunduk. İyi ki rica etmişiz çünkü ev dehşet bir haldeydi. Banyo rezaletti, salonda çöp poşetleri bırakılmış, çarşaflarda lekeler ve daha niceleri. Arayıp söylediğimizde ise ''Böyle bir şey olamaz, eve başkası mı girdi acaba'' diye bir geri dönüş aldık ve kısa süreli bir şok yaşadık. Ev sahibi check-in saatine kadar temizleneceğini belirtti çıktık evden. Ertesi gün (cumartesi günü) sabahın 09.00'unda bina da yapılan tadilatlarla güne başladık. Saatlerce kafamızın içinde çekiç sesleri, oradan oraya çekilen merdivenin gürültüsü ve bağırıp çağıran kişilerin sesleri evin içinde yankılandı.. Dinlenmek için gittiğimiz yerde bütün bir günü baş ağrısıyla geçirdik. Ev sahibi girişte yaşadığımız olay için geç çıkış yapmamızı sağladı bu olması gereken bir şeydi ama hoştu. Ev fotoğraflardaki gibi; yerleşimi, mobilyaları yeni ve temizdi fakat tekrar tercih edeceğimizi asla düşünmüyorum.

Ev fotoğraflardaki gibi, konum olarak merkezi bir konumda. Yürüyerek birçok yere kolaylıkla ulaşım sağlayabilirsiniz. Genel olarak temiz ve düzenliydi fakat birkaç eksiklik vardı örneğin nevresimler temizdi fakat koltuk, pike vs. yeterince temiz değildi. Yıkanmış durmuyordu. Yastık kılıfı götürebilirsiniz(öneri). Bahçesi güzeldi, çiçekler içinde harika bir bahçe keyfi yapabilirsiniz. Giriş çıkışta bir sorun yaşanmadı. Ev sahibine teşekkürler.

The appartment was clean, according to description and the communication with the host was really easily. Location is really ideal close to the center without being too exposed, with a nice terrasse. Only the shower was a little inconvenient, but that really is a detail. I definitely recommend the place.

3 kız arkadaş 2 gece kaldık hiç bir sorun yaşamadık konumu iskeleye ve minibüslere çok yakındı, ev geldiğimizde temizlenmişti, valizlerimizi bırakmamız için erken giriş yapmamıza müsaade ettiler. Odalar yeterliydi bahçesi çok sakin ve güzeldi sadece eleştiri olarak duşta kabin ya da duş perdesi olmadığı için banyo çok ıslandı ve banyo haricinde evde ayna yoktu odalardan birine ayna konulabilirdi hazırlanırken biraz zorlandık bunlar haricinde çok güzel ve rahat bir tatil oldu bizi ağırladıkları için teşekkür ederiz tekrar gelmeyi planlıyoruz.

description: 24-hour hot water with combi boiler, air conditioning, unlimited internet, smart TV, Netflix. Very clean, brand new furniture.

reviews.text:
Volkan's place is like the photos. He was very quick to respond to any questions that I had. The apartment is spacious and generally quiet, (especially the bedroom which is in the rear of the building) which is surprising due to it's central location.
I do have to acknowledge that there is an extremely strong smell of cigarettes from the air conditioner in the bedroom. I was fully aware that the accommodation allows smoking when I booked. But I assumed that once a thorough cleaning was done between guests that the smell wouldn't linger. Well, this was true for the majority of the apartment. But as soon as you turned on the air conditioning it was as if three people were smoking cigarettes in the room with you and with the high temperatures, sleeping without the air conditioning wasn't an option. Maybe the filter needs to be changed.
If you are smoker yourself, I doubt this will be an issue for you.
Overall I had a good stay and Volkan gave me a good contact for an airport taxi.

biz sadece bir gece kaldık, ve aşırı memnun kaldık. konum harika ve bu konuma göre fiyat çok iyi. Ev aynı fotoğraflardaki gibi. sadece yatak odasında bir pencere var ve apartman boşluğuna bakıyor fakat ev havasız değildi hiç. evde çoğu imkan var ve volkan çok hızlı yanıt veren bir ev sahibi. tavsiye edilir.

Öncelikle fotoğraflarda gösterildiği gibi güzel bir stüdyo daire idi. Temizdi, sıcaktı ve giriş çok hızlı sorunsuz oldu. Her şey en ince ayrıntısına kadar düşünülmüş çamaşırınızı yıkayabileceğiniz deterjanlara kadar her şey mevcuttu. Kesinlikle fiyat performans diyebilirim konumu da çok iyi rahat bulunabilecek bir yerde. Olumsuz olarak söyleyeceğim birkaç yönü ise daha kaliteli bir yatak konulabilir. çok sağlıklı tok bir his vermiyordu yatak. İkinci eksiklik olarakta saç kurutma makinesi değilde daha güçlü bir fon makinesi koyulmalı bence. Genel anlamda memnunum teşekkür ederim.

My partner and I had a great stay at Volkan’s house. The flat was clean, easy to find, and surrounded by plenty of shops and restaurants. Despite being in a convenient location, it was super quiet at night, and we had everything we needed for a comfortable stay.
Volkan is a very friendly and helpful person. He responded to our needs immediately and made us feel very welcome. The bedroom was especially quiet, and we had a great night’s sleep. We truly felt at home.
The cleaner lady was also very friendly and kind.
I highly recommend staying here and would definitely come back again!

The check-in was very weird. The host texted me to go pick up the keys at a nearby (300m) hotel. Once I arrived there I waited 10-15 minutes in the lobby. Someone else had to bring the keys. Apparently another guest who booked an accommodation on the second floor was also waiting there. Once the keys was brought by a girl, the guest who rented a accommodation on the second floor told me to follow him and walked to the accommodation. It was very confusing for me and it almost looked like a scam. I still did not have the keys to enter the apartment. Apparently the keys were laying on top of the gas meter. The host did not communicate at all with me.
The apartment and especially the bedroom smelled heavily like cigarettes. It was my mistake own mistake because I didn't read/know it was allowed to smoke inside. I had to leave Istanbul the next morning so I didn't bother. If you love the smell of cigarettes, I recommend this place. If you don't, please look for another place.
